translation: And if they seize him on the road, on his account be careful and bring the textiles in and give them.

translation: Ashur-shamsi and Ashur-bel-shadue brought 6 talents 3 1/3 minas of tin and 84 textiles into Purushhattum.

translation: His instructions came to Ennum-Ashur son of Anninum, Kuzia son of Buzizi, and Lipti-Ishtar son of Dagan-malkum.

translation: Regarding these matters, the colony of Uhshushana, small and great, gave us to the court and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Ashur.

translation: To Ashur-malik, Itur-ilum, and Ashur-malik speak: thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e.

transliteration: i-na 13 ma-na KÙ.B qá-tí ša-ak-na-at

translation: Alahum, son of Nur-Suen, holds the silver in my stead.

translation: In Durhumit, he will weigh out copper.

translation: Regarding your tablet of the Timelkiyan, we opened your safe-box.

transliteration: ṭup-pu ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ni-iš-e-ma la1-šu-ú
translation: We searched for the tablet of the Timelkiyan, but it is not there.

transliteration: É Bu-zu-ta-a ù Šu-Ku-bi-im ni-iš-e-ma ù áš-ra-kam la1-šu-ú
translation: We searched the house of Buzutaya and Shu-Kubum, and there also it is not there.

transliteration: a-ta a-ma-kam hu-ta-sí-is-ma ṭup-pí-kà a-šar té-zi-bu té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
translation: Think about it there, where you left your tablet, and let your report come to me.

transliteration: A-šùr-DÙG a-na Tí-me-el-ki-a i-la1-ak-ma a-ma-la1 me-eh-ri-im ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ša ta-dí-nu-šu-ni KÙ.B ša lá-qá-im i-la1-qé
translation: Ashur-tab is going to Timelkiya and according to the copy of the Timelkiyan that you gave him, he will take the silver that is to be taken.

translation: Look, he will set the remaining days for them and he will renew their tablet.

translation: Because your tablet is missing and so that your silver is not delayed, for that reason we have written to you.

transliteration: i-hi-id-ma té-er-ta-kà iš-tí pá-ni-im-ma li-li-kam
translation: Take care and let your report come to me with the very first messenger.

translation: Speak to Ashur-malik, Itur-ili, and Ashur-malik: thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-li-bi4 Šu-zu-zu aṣ-ba-at

translation: Write to Kanish to your father's representatives so that they make him pay the silver.

transliteration: i-zi-za-ma KÙ.B ša-áš-qí-lá-šu

translation: Pay attention and send me the silver and its interest.

translation: Take the half of the tin which you set aside for the nails.

translation: Claims for 1 mina of silver, 2 kusitu-garments, and 600 nails have been laid against you.

translation: I will give (them) and then I will write to you.

translation: Give 2 shekels of silver to Ilushu-rabi, who is bringing the tablet to you.

translation: Speak to Alahum, thus says Ili-dan, Assur-imitti, and A-uken.

transliteration: um-me-a-nu-kà : mì-ma ša ma-at e-li-tim a-na ba-áb DINGIR : ú-šé-ri-du ù ni-a-tí : GÍR ša A-šùr ú-ša-aṣ-bi-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Regarding your creditors: they made us take the dagger of Assur concerning whatever they brought down from the upper country to the Gate of the God.

transliteration: KÙ.B 1 GÍN ša ta-dí-na-ni az-ku-ur
translation: I declared the one shekel of silver which you gave me.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma : sà-al-ú
translation: They said: "Lies!"

transliteration: a-na A-limki : i-li-ku-ma
translation: They went to the City.

transliteration: 12 ma-na KÙ.B ša Šu-Nu-nu ta-bé-el
translation: You possess 12 minas of silver belonging to Shu-Nunu.

translation: We beseeched them, saying: "Take 5 minas for your sacrifices for his debt."

transliteration: ú-la1 kà-la1-šu-ma a-šé-lu-tim : ak-la1-šu
translation: Or I held back all of it for the third parties.

transliteration: a-wi-lu : ú-la1 im-gu5-ru-ni-a-tí-ma a-na A-limki : i-tal-ku
translation: The men did not agree with us and they have gone to the City.

transliteration: šu-ma : a-ší-a-ma-tim : ta-ša-kà-nam : i-ṣa-bu-tù
translation: If you deposit it for me for purchases, they will seize it.

transliteration: um-ma Ta-ha-ša-i-li-ma a-na A-šur-be-el-SA.TU ù A-šur-ma-lik qí-bi4-ma
translation: Thus says Tahaša-ili: to Aššur-bel-šadu and Aššur-malik say:

translation: 1 1/3 minas of silver, its nishatu-tax added, under my seals, which your fathers deposited with me.

translation: Hadāni and Šalim-belī are bringing to you 1/3 mina of silver under my seals for Nanaia and 12 shekels of silver under my seals for Šimat-Ištar.

translation: Entrust it to any agent who is going to the City so that he may bring it to your father.

translation: I gave 1/3 mina and 4 1/3 shekels of silver to Adadā.

translation: And 35 minas of copper, the price of one donkey, are owed by him.

transliteration: ù a-na Ša-lá-tù-wa-ar i-ta-lá-ak
translation: And he has gone to Šalatuwar.

transliteration: I-tur4-DINGIR a-na A-šur-be-el-SA./TU iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma A-lá-hu-um DUMU Nu-ur-ZU A-šur-ma-lik a-hu-šu i-za-zu
translation: Itur-il seized us against Ashur-bel-shadu'e, and Alahum, son of Nur-Suen, and Ashur-malik, his brother, were present.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-be-el-ša-du-e-/ma KÙ.B ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu ša-bu-a-ku
translation: Thus said Ashur-bel-shadu'e: 'I am satisfied with the silver and its purchases.'

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na 12 GÍN ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu ša ku-nu-uk A-lá-hi-im ú A-šur-ma-lik ma-ah-ri-ni i-du-ku
translation: The tablet of 4 minas 12 shekels and its purchases with the seal of Alahum and Ashur-malik was invalidated in our presence.

transliteration: 8 ma-na AN.NA a-na Na-qí-du-ú a-dí-in
translation: I gave 8 minas of tin to Naqidu.

transliteration: a-na Šu-Ku-bi4-im ù Bu-zu-ta-a qí-bi-ma um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: Speak to Shu-Kubum and Buzutaya, thus says Alahum.

transliteration: a-na-kam a-wa-tí-a iš-tí um-me-a-ni-a ag-ta-mar
translation: I have finished my business here with my creditors.

transliteration: ma-lá e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni iš-tí DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim ša KÙ.B 1 GÚ iš-tí-šu i-lu-ku 30 ma-na.TA KÙ.B iš-ri-ša-ma a-na É be-tí-a šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: Whatever I left with you, send to my house 30 minas of silver each in ten shipments with a reliable agent with whom 1 talent of silver is traveling.

translation: And if you see that later 5 talents of silver will travel with a reliable agent, send to me the 1 talent 20 minas of silver, the two half-packs which I left with you in my house, including their wrapping.

translation: If they do not accept them with the wrapping, unpack and entrust the packets and the ephods (to them).

translation: You are my brothers; here they have taken 1 talent of silver without cause.

translation: Do not release the interest to anyone according to my certified tablets.

transliteration: En-um-DINGIR ṭù-ur-da-nim
translation: Send Ennum-ilum here.

translation: Thus says Alahum: speak to Ashur-malik, son of Ashur-bani, and Ashur-malik, son of La-qepim.

translation: Ashur-malik should take the copies of my certified tablets there, and he should seize my creditors and bring them to you.

translation: Make them pay whatever is to be paid.

transliteration: ú a-šar ta-da-ga-lá-/ni ma-lá ta-le-e-/a-ni ep-ša
translation: And wherever you see fit, do as much as you can.

transliteration: ú ṭup-pè-a ha-ru-mu-tim pì-tí-a
translation: And open my certified tablets.

translation: If there are creditors to be paid, you are my brothers; pay attention to my instructions.

transliteration: ú a-na-ku a-wi-il5 gi5-mì-li
translation: And I am a man of favors.

transliteration: ki-ma Pí-lá-ah-Ištar <<i[m-x]>> im-hu-ur
translation: He received (it) instead of Pilah-Ištar.

translation: Šalim-Aššur took 130 (units) of Iddin-Suen, son of Sabasia.

translation: Speak to Itūr-ilim, Enna-Suen, Nabanata, and Šalim-ahum; thus says Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: šu-ma a-hu-a a-tù-nu
translation: If you are my brothers.

translation: If you are my lords.

transliteration: a-na-kam ki-a-am tám-kà-ri-šu i-ta-na-lu-ku
translation: His creditors are constantly going about here in this manner.

transliteration: áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ku-nu-tí-ma té-er-ta-ak-nu ma-tí-ma lá i-li-kam
translation: I keep writing to you, but your report has never come.

transliteration: Da-ri-ku-da il5-qé 7 ½ GÍN
translation: Darikuda received 7 1/2 shekels.

translation: Shahishhalaga received 7 1/2 shekels, his hire.

transliteration: Du-za : il5-qé 7 ½ GÍN ig-re-šu
translation: Duza received 7 1/2 shekels, his hire.

translation: Thus (said) Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur: "If I produce Sakliya for you, you will weigh out 1/3 mina of silver to me."

translation: I gave 3 3/4 textiles to the office of the karum.

translation: The load of tin decreased by 2 1/2 minas each until Purushattum.

translation: To Tagan, Ummi-Ishhara, Nimar-Adad, Muza and Gazubi say: Thus says Shakimurutum.

translation: Here, Assur-šamši, the husband of Assur-ṭab, heard and he put your silver into his silver.

translation: Because of the silver, twice and three times I poured dust on my head and went to the karum.

translation: Thus said the representatives of Assur-ṭab: 'Go, enter the house of your father and bring out the silver of your father.'

translation: He must not carry away the silver; the man's word is not honest.

translation: Because of this, the representatives of Assur-ṭab and I entered our house and we brought out your silver.

translation: The man stood to catch me and, without reason, 160 minas of copper fell upon me.

transliteration: ù ší-be a-hu-um a-na a-hi-im ni-iš-ta-kán
translation: And we have set witnesses against each other.

transliteration: ší-bu-ú-a da-nu
translation: My witnesses are strong.

transliteration: a-bi4 a-ta a-ma-kam a-we-dí-im e ta-áp-ṭur4
translation: You are my father; do not release the individual there.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-ú-a ù ší-bu-ú-a da-nu ṭup-pu-šu-nu ha-ru-mu
translation: My tablets and my witnesses are strong; their tablets are certified.

transliteration: [a]-na A-sà-nim qí-bi-ma um-ma Ma-lik-en-nam-ma
translation: To Asanum speak, thus says Malik-ennam.

transliteration: i-na dUTU-ši ša a-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na e-ru-bu 10 u4-me-e lá i-lik
translation: On the day that I entered Wahshushana, ten days had not passed.

transliteration: a-na KÙ.B ša iš-tí I-šar-A-šùr a-na ṣí-ib-tim tal-qé-ú-ma ṭup-pí-i ù ṭup-pí-kà a-na ša-pár-tim : ta-dí-ú šu iṣ-bi-tí-ma sí-ki 10 u4-me-e ú-kà-i-il5-ma : a-na kà-ri-im ni-li-ik-ma um-ma né-nu-ma
translation: Regarding the silver that you took for interest from Ishar-Ashur and for which you placed my tablet and your tablet as a pledge, he seized me and held the hem of my garment for ten days, and we went to the colony and said as follows.

transliteration: a-na dí-nim a-na kà-ri-im : a-li-ik-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma DAM.GÀR a-pá-ni-a a-na Tí-me-el-ki-a i-li-kam-ma
translation: I went to the colony for the legal case and I said: 'The merchant came to Timelkia before me...'

transliteration: TÚG.HI.A AN.NA ù e-ma-ri a-dí-šu-ma : ú-ša-bi-šu-ma
translation: I gave him textiles, tin, and donkeys and I satisfied him.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk DAM.QAR ša ša-ba-e : al-qé-ma
translation: I received a tablet with the seal of the merchant regarding the satisfaction.

transliteration: i-nu-mì A-šùr-be-el-ša-du-im a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim e-ru-bu-ni
translation: When Ashur-bel-shadu'im entered Purushattum.

transliteration: ANŠE a-na 40 ma-na iš-tí DUMU Ku-ku-a al-qé
translation: I bought a donkey for 40 minas from the son of Kukua.

transliteration: 1 ANŠE.HI a-na 20 ma-na ša A-šur-DÙG al-qé
translation: I bought 1 donkey for 20 minas from Ashur-tab.

translation: I bought 2 donkeys from the guest, 1 donkey at 40 minas.

translation: I bought (them) for 1/2 mina and 6 shekels from Kudadum.

transliteration: a-na A-šùr-DÙG qí-bi-ma
translation: To Ashur-tab say:

transliteration: um-ma Ta-ha-ša-li ù A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: Thus says Tahashali and Alahum:

transliteration: A-lá-hu-u[m] a-na Pu-ru-[uš-ha-tim] uš-té-ri-ib
translation: Alahum has brought it into Purushattum.

transliteration: i-na 25 [TÚG.HI.A] ŠÀ 22 ku-[ta-ni] a-na Ta-h[a-ša-li] e-zi-i[b]
translation: Among 25 textiles, he left 22 kutānu-textiles for Tahashali.

transliteration: [3 TÚG.HI.A] A-lá-hu-um il5-qé
translation: Alahum took 3 textiles.

transliteration: iṣ-ba-sú-nu um-ma a-na-ku-ma
translation: He seized them (and) I said as follows:

translation: Additionally, Ennum-Ashur your father and Ashur-dugul son of Shuli owe 4 minas 11 shekels of silver to my father.

translation: Nab-Suen, the packer of Ashur-malik, will make payment for their price.

translation: I did not take any of their price.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ki-a-am sà-ah-ra-ku
translation: For this reason, I have been delayed.

transliteration: ŠUNIGIN TÚG-tí-kà 46 TÚG ta-ad-nu

translation: The textiles which I released, I gave at 11 1/2 minas each for trade.

transliteration: ší-im-šu-nu ú-ša-áš-qal
translation: I will have their price paid.

transliteration: e-zi-ba-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: I left and I am coming.

transliteration: té-er-tí i-a-tum [k]à-áš-da-k[u]
translation: I have arrived with my message.

transliteration: a-dí ku-a-tim as-hu-ur
translation: I delayed for yours.

translation: Send one of your servants so that he may await our observations.

translation: Give 3 minas of shiku-copper to Ashur-rabi for the traveler who is going to the City.

translation: All of this is at your disposal.

translation: Iddi-... is bringing it to you.

translation: Ashur-nasir, the attorney of the house of Idi-abum and the sons of Shu-Hubur, seized us against Puzur-Ishtar, son of Shu-Hubur.

translation: Thus said Ashur-nasir to Puzur-Ishtar: "Behold, I did not take any of the 11 1/3 minas of tin for myself—which we took from Anina, son of Liptanum—but for the sons of Idi-abum, the sons of Shu-Hubur, and the wife of Shu-Hubur."

translation: You are indeed providing for them.

transliteration: a-ta : lá ṭá-hu-a-tí
translation: You are not involved.

translation: Regarding these matters, the karum of Kanesh gave us as witnesses; before the dagger of Ashur we gave our testimony.

translation: Thus say Qatata, Ashur-malik, Nakiliat, and Ashur-resi; to Puzur-Ashur and Buzutaya: To Buzutaya speak:

translation: Puzur-Ashur owes 8 shekels of silver to your brother Shalma-Ashur.

translation: We seized Puzur-Ashur here.

translation: And Buzutaya himself took it.

translation: He gave us 5 shekels of silver here and we sent it to your brother.

transliteration: a-na 3 GÍN KÙ.B dan-na-tám ni-iq-bi4-šu-um
translation: We spoke to him strongly regarding the 3 shekels of silver.

transliteration: šu-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.B tal-qé ta-er-šu-um
translation: If you took the 5 shekels of silver, return it to him.

translation: You went in person and you are carrying away my jewelry.

translation: And now I have paid my rings to the eponym.

translation: I have given my toggle-pin for the wool and he keeps making me come back and forth.

translation: He is adding to my rations.

transliteration: GÉME ṭé-i-ta-am lá ni-šu
translation: We have no grinding maid.

transliteration: GÉME šé-ri-am
translation: Send me a maid.

transliteration: ú-ul té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma GÉME li-iš-ú-mu
translation: Either let your instructions come to me so that they can buy a maid.

transliteration: 12 ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša a-na A-šùr-DÙG A-mur-DINGIR i-du-nu-ma
translation: Amur-ili will give 12 minas of refined silver, its nishatu-tax added and its shadu'atu-tax paid, to Ashur-tab.

transliteration: 24 ma-na KÙ.B A-šùr-DÙG a-na A-mur-DINGIR i-ša-qú-lu
translation: Ashur-tab will pay 24 minas of silver to Amur-ili.

transliteration: KÙ.GI me-he-er-šu A-mur-DINGIR ša-bu
translation: Amur-ili is satisfied with gold as its equivalent.

translation: Amur-ili will not raise a claim against Ashur-tab and his sons for anything whatsoever.

translation: To Alahum say: thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e:

transliteration: A-šùr lu i-de8
translation: May Ashur know!

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma : né-ma-lam ú-ša-ar-ša-kà
translation: Thus you said: 'I will make you gain a profit.'

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma : ú-lá ú-ba-šu
translation: Thus I said: 'I will not be ashamed.'

transliteration: pá-ni áš-ta-kán
translation: I have set my face (I am resolved).

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim i-na Za-al-pá i-na be-tí-kà ta-am-šu-ha-ni
translation: All this you have robbed me of in your house in Zalpa.

transliteration: i-na pá-ni-a pu-zu-ra : ta-ṣa-ba-at
translation: You are taking refuge from me.

transliteration: ⅓ ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.B li-tí SIG5 i-ṣé-er En-na-Sú-in DUMU A-šur-DÙG A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Aššur-ṭāb has a claim on 1/3 mana and 1 shekel of good quality lītu-standard silver against Enna-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša I-dí-/a-bi4-im a-na 2 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
translation: He shall pay within two months from the hamuštum-period of Iddi-abum.

transliteration: a-ma-sú Ta-ga-na-ba-ta ša-pá-[ar]-tum
translation: His maidservant Taganabata is the pledge.

transliteration: a-na Puzur2-A-šùr : qí-bi-ma um-ma Bu-zu-ta-a-ma
translation: Speak to Puzur-Ashur, thus says Buzutaya.

translation: I made Ashur-malik hear your message, and he said:

transliteration: ku-a-tí : lá i-de8-kà
translation: I do not know you.

transliteration: Puzur2-A-šùr šu-um-šu KÙ.B ha-bu-lá-ma ša-áp-ra-tí-šu ú-kà-al
translation: A certain Puzur-Ashur owes silver and I am holding his security.

transliteration: a-ma-kam iš-tí a-wi-li-kà at-wu-ú
translation: Discuss it there with your representatives.

transliteration: ú i-na KÙ.B ša li-bi-kà KÙ.B lá tù-ṣa-ha-ra-am
translation: And do not deduct silver from the silver which you owe.

transliteration: a-ma-lá a-wa-tí-ni : KÙ.B ur-ki-tí šé-bi-lam
translation: In accordance with our agreement, send me the later silver.

transliteration: KÙ.B ša DUMU Ì-lí-a lá té-zi-ib
translation: Do not leave the silver of the son of Iliya behind.

transliteration: a-ma-lá na-áš-pè-ra-tí-a ša a-na Kà-ni-iš ú-lá-pí-ta-ku-ni : e-pu-uš
translation: Proceed in accordance with the messages I wrote to you for Kanish.

transliteration: URUDU ša ta-dí-na-ni 10 ma-na : ⅓ ma-na URUDU a-li-bi4 KÙ.B i-dí-ma : šé-bi4-lam
translation: Regarding the copper which you gave me, put 10 1/3 minas of copper on the account of the silver and send it to me.

transliteration: i-dí-in kà-ri-im ṭup-pá-a[m] ša ša-ba-e a-na ITU.3.KAM Ma-lik-en-nam ú-ba-lam-ma kà-ru-um ú-ša-ha-az
translation: Malik-ennam will bring the tablet of satisfaction to the karum within three months and the karum will give instructions.

transliteration: le-ru-ub-ma : ṭup-pè-e : li- ip-té-ú-ma ṭup-pì lá-al-qé
translation: Let him enter and let them open the tablets so that I may take my tablet.

transliteration: a-na A-lá- hi -[im qí-bi4-ma]
translation: To Alahum, speak:

transliteration: um-ma I-dí-dI[M-ma]
translation: Thus says Iddin-Adad:

transliteration: li-ba-kà i-d[e8]- e?
translation: You know.

translation: Since the silver has been sent with the merchant, I have sent the silver to you.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.B 1 GÍN li-li-a-/kum
translation: I said as follows: "May one shekel of silver come to you."

translation: Why has your report not come to me regarding as much merchandise as you bought for me?

transliteration: lu KÙ.B a-na pá-ni-a a-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na li-im-hu-ra-ni
translation: Let the silver indeed meet me at Wahshushana.

translation: My report is in Shalatuwar after these travelers.

translation: To Alahum and Šu-Kubum speak, thus says Iddin-Adad.

translation: For each 4 minas of silver, its nishatum-tax is added and its šadu'utu-tax is paid.

transliteration: a-na-ku ù En-na-a-ni nu-šé-ba-la-ku-nu-tí
translation: Ennani and I are sending it to you.

translation: We have sent 8 minas of refined silver to the City for purchases to Šu-Kubum, Ilum-bani, and Šalma-Aššur.

translation: May your report come to me.

translation: If it is not recorded in the merchant's tablet and in the merchant's textiles, do not touch the textiles.

translation: Regarding these matters, the karum of Kanesh gave us (as witnesses), and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Ashur.

translation: Concerning the fact that Ennanum brought me a tablet, thus you said: "Send me 2 kutānu-textiles."

translation: For two months I was laid up in bed, and my representatives did not even ask after me.

translation: 9 minas 15 shekels are with Usur-sha-Ashur; from the hamuštum-period of Ashur-nada and Ememe, month of Qaratum, eponymy of Amur-Ashur, he shall add interest at 1 shekel per month per mina.

translation: From this tablet, Ashur-idi and Ashur-nada his son will take 1 1/3 minas 9 1/3 shekels 15 grains of silver and its interest.

translation: 14 minas of silver are with Ashur-tab son of Usaria; from the hamuštum-period of Ashur-bel-awatim and Amur-Ishtar, he will pay in 45 hamuštum-periods.

translation: I said: Is it true? Will an honest man of my father's house take care and pay out even one shekel of silver?

translation: Ashur-lamassi is bringing you 6 kutānu-textiles of average quality.

translation: Identify the fine textiles under the seals of Dada and Garria, my representatives, and let him give you 6 textiles.

translation: You and he, give him one textile.

translation: Please, give the textiles, get ready and come here.

translation: Thus Ili-dan, Ashur-imitti and Au-ken:

translation: Your creditors brought down whatever from the upper country to the Gate of the God.

transliteration: A-lá-hu-um DUMU E-lá-lí a-na A-lá-hi-im DUMU Sú-ku-hi-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma : um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: Alahum, son of Elali, seized us against Alahum, son of Sukuhi, and Alahum said as follows:

translation: Why do you hold my hem and property?

translation: Thus Alahum, son of Sukuhi, said: I hold you according to the mouth of your tablet.

translation: Thus Alahum, son of Elali, said: Let me hold that which you swore by the life of the City and the prince.

translation: 42 minas of copper are with Numhi.

transliteration: 46 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Šu-mì-a-bi4-a
translation: 46 minas of copper are with Shumia-abia.

transliteration: 35 ma-na URUDU SIG5 iš-tí Puzur2-BE-Ištar
translation: 35 minas of good copper are with Puzur-beli-Ishtar.

transliteration: 26 m[a-na UR]UDU iš-tí Ha-dí-ni
translation: 26 minas of copper are with Hadini.

transliteration: 12 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Zi-ba-a-li
translation: 12 minas of copper are with Zibali.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.B ni-is-ha-tù wa-ṣí-tum DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-k[i š]a DAM.QAR a-na A-lá-hi-im DUMU A-de8-lá-at áp-qí-id
translation: Two minas of silver—the nishatu-tax and export-tax being added and its shaduattu-tax satisfied—I entrusted under the seals of the merchant to Alahum, son of Adelat.

translation: He brought it to the City, to Ikupia son of Il-bani and to him himself.

translation: And if you see that later 5 talents of silver travel with a reliable agent, send the 1 talent 20 minas of silver, the two half-packs that I left with you in my house, together with their wrappings.

transliteration: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.B ša A-šur-bé-el-ša-du-e ša Ištar-ma-lá-ak ub-lá-ni : ni-is-ni-iq-šu-ma 1 GÍN im-ṭí 1 ½ GÍN da-tám
translation: From 1 mina of silver of Ashur-bel-shadue, which Ishtar-malak brought, we checked it and 1 shekel was missing and 1 1/2 shekels was the road-tax.

transliteration: ⅔ ma-na 1 GÍN A-šùr-ma-lik il5-qé
translation: Ashur-malik took 2/3 mana and 1 shekel.

translation: I gave 3 manas of sickles and 1 shekel of silver in Tegarama where the goods were.

translation: They are bringing 1 donkey of my brother, which belongs to Iddin-Ishtar, and those sahudu-garments to Purushhattum, and his representatives will satisfy me with the silver.

translation: Write to Labanada, Alahum, Ashur-andul, and the creditor whom you are paying, so that they may settle his affair.

transliteration: té-er-tí i-lá-kà a-ša-me-ma
translation: My report will come and I will hear.

transliteration: ú KÙ.B 10 ma-na il5-qé
translation: And he took 10 minas of silver.

transliteration: ú-za-kà a-pá-tí
translation: I will inform you.

transliteration: ù a-na-ku AN.NA-kà a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim ú-šé-ra-áb-ma a-na KÙ.B ú-ta-ar-ma
translation: And I will bring your tin into Purušhaddum and turn it into silver.

transliteration: A-šùr-be-el-SA.TU-e a-ṭá-ra-da-kum
translation: I will send Aššur-bēl-šadû to you.

transliteration: a-bi4 a-ta té-er-tí áb-kà-ma
translation: You are my father, send me my report.

transliteration: ù lá-at-bi4-a-ma lá-tal-kam a-na-kam lá sà-ah-ra-ku
translation: And I will get up and come; I am not delayed here.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-qá-qá-ad šál-me-šu-nu ra-ki-is

translation: Puzur-Ištar, son of Dadia, settled the affairs of Šamaš-tappā’ī.

translation: Puzur-Ištar shall pay 30 minas of good copper in one month to Mannum-ki-enia who acts as the merchant.

translation: 28 kutānu-textiles, 5 5/6 minas of tin for his hand, 1 black donkey—all this Ashur-shamshi son of Amua is bringing to you.

translation: If you are my brothers, take care! Let your report come to me regarding as much of my share of silver as is collected and recorded in the office of the colony.

translation: 6 textiles which are recorded in the name of the merchant—send me their silver so that it may be available.

translation: Say to Alahum: 8 1/3 minas 4 shekels of silver are accruing interest for you.

translation: Belum-bani seized us against La-qepum and Belum-bani spoke to La-qepum as follows:

translation: Here the tablets of our fathers are released.

translation: There you have silver, whether the price of his tin and 2 textiles that they sent in the presence of Alahum, son of Nur-Ishtar, or for fodder for the donkey.

translation: He should not tarry for five days; send him here.

translation: Of the 78 textiles for smuggling, we placed 2 fine textiles as shadu'attu-tax into his hand.

translation: Or upon his coming up from the City, he shall give him a hand-quality kutānum-cloth.

translation: Thus says Ashur-sululi: speak to Ashur-tab!

translation: Regarding Alahum, about whom you wrote to me, three months of the period of my certified tablet have not passed.

translation: I made him pay as much silver as was at his disposal.

translation: I made Alahum pay all this silver from my certified tablet: 1 1/3 minas 8 1/6 shekels of silver, the price of gold; 15 shekels of silver, the price of an ox; 2/3 minas 5 shekels for Ashur-malik son of Ashur-bani; 1 mina for Amur-Ashur son of Idi-Ashur; and 2/3 minas 1 1/2 shekels for Shu-Belum.

translation: I gave the remainder of the silver, 1 mina 5 1/6 shekels, to Enu-Belum my brother, saying: 'Pay the silver and release my tablet!'

translation: Let your instructions come to me so that I may pay the silver to your representatives and give my tablet to my representatives.

translation: Alāhum took 11 Akkadian textiles.

translation: Aššur-nada took 16 šurūtu-textiles, 14 Akkadian textiles, 1 kutānu-textile instead of 2 garments, and 3 kutānu-textiles of Ilšu-rabi.

translation: Eight years are completed; you are my brothers.

translation: 1 mina of silver and 23 minas of fine copper are charged against Alabi, son of Shu-Tibar; Puzur-Ana is the guarantor; he shall pay in 3 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Laqep and Shamash-bani.

translation: 1 1/2 minas of silver are charged against Ashur-ishti-kal, son of Ashur-sipa; he shall pay in 4 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Anninum and Imdi-ilum.

translation: 1 mina of silver is charged against Ashur-tab, son of Puzur-Ashur; he shall pay in 25 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Alahum and Nab-Suen.

translation: They have never made us pay the export duty.

translation: When we inform the colony, you wrote to me: 'Send (it) to me personally.'

translation: Wherever you look and there is silver to be taken, cancel as much of the interest as you can and take the silver.

translation: Your silver is under your seals until you come.

translation: Adad-reṣi owes 3 minas of silver to Šu-Kubum and me, and separately 1 mina 15 shekels of silver to me.

translation: Seize him and make him pay the silver!

translation: To Ashur-bel-shadu'e and Shu-Nunu speak, thus says Dan-Ashur.

translation: As for the 5 shekels of silver which I paid on your account to Ennanim son of Azuta, you and Ashur-bel-shadu buy one šakṣu-garment there for me to wear and send it to Purushathum.

translation: Zupa will send four minas of silver, with its nishatu-tax added and its shadu'utu-tax paid, to the City within five months from the hamushtum-period of Laqep and Nab-Suen.

translation: Thus said Ashur-malik to Shu-Ishtar: 'You will be cleared with the guide of the merchandise, and regarding the refined silver and the arumurani, I and the attorney did not press you.'

translation: They brought 4 talents of tin and its additions under your seal of the City, 35 kutānu-textiles, 10 šurūtu-textiles, and 5 heavy textiles.

translation: Alahum, son of Nur-Zu, brought 5 talents of refined copper, (at) 10 shekels added to 10 minas, returned, into Purushattum.

translation: Four minas of silver are on your account: you shall pay two minas within ten hamuštum-periods, and you shall pay two minas within twenty hamuštum-periods.

translation: The Kanish colony, small and great, rendered a verdict before the dagger of Ashur.

translation: To Ilum-malak and Ashur-malik speak: Thus says Tahshael.

translation: I gave 6 minas of fine copper to Alahum, son of Adelat, to buy a garment.

translation: Concerning the tin which I sent to you to the employee, you wrote to me.

translation: The tin is a votive offering of Ashur; I shall bless you before Ashur.

translation: He sent 5 shekels to Šar-Suen and 2 shekels to Ennum-Aššur when they performed their victory ceremony.

translation: To Alahum say:

translation: When I sent (him) from Wahshushana, he brought (it).

translation: Thus I said: "Bring them into Purušhattum together with your instructions."

translation: Will you swear by the dagger of Ashur that 160 minas of copper are indeed missing or full?

transliteration: Pu[zur4]-Ištar DUMU Im-dí-DINGIR a-na A-šùr-ma-lik DUMU A-lá-hi-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-m[a]
translation: Puzur-Ištar, son of Imdi-ilum, seized us against Aššur-malik, son of Alahum, and spoke as follows:

translation: The son of Amuraya: 1/2 mina of silver, working capital of Idi-abum.

transliteration: ša ṭup-pì a-ni-ú-tim KÙ.B ur-ki-tí e-zi-ib
translation: Apart from these tablets, he left silver to be paid later.

transliteration: ú a-ta tí-de8-e ki-ma 8 TÚG.HI.A SIG5-tim i-it-bu-lu-ni
translation: And you know that 8 fine garments were taken.

transliteration: a-lik-ma šu?-ma KÙ.B ša-qá-lá-am lá i-mu-a
translation: Go and if he refuses to pay the silver.

transliteration: KI Ša-ba-ú-ni 30 ma-na U[RUDU]
translation: With Šaba-uni are 30 minas of copper.

transliteration: 12 GÍN [K]Ù.GI i-ṣé-er E-lá-lí A-šur-D[ÙG i]-šu
translation: Elali owes 12 shekels of gold to Assur-tab.

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.GI i-ṣé-er Ú-zu-a A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Uzua owes 5 shekels of gold to Assur-tab.

transliteration: 12 GÍN KÙ.GI i-ṣé-er A-šur-dUTU A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Assur-shamaš owes 12 shekels of gold to Assur-tab.

transliteration: ⅓ ma-na KÙ.GI i-ṣé-er Puzur4-A-na DUMU Nu-bur-LUGAL A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Puzur-Ana son of Nubur-sharru owes 1/3 mana of gold to Assur-tab.

translation: Enumea and Amur-Assur owe 1/3 mana 4 shekels of gold to Assur-tab.

transliteration: 1 ½ GÍN KÙ.GI i-ṣé-er DÙG-A-šur A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Tab-Assur owes 1 1/2 shekels of gold to Assur-tab.

transliteration: ½ ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er Nu-bur-LUGAL A-šur-DÙG i-šu
translation: Nubur-sharru owes 1/2 mana of refined silver to Assur-tab.

transliteration: 6 GÍN a-na 2 ša-na-at i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay 6 shekels in two years.

transliteration: 6 GÍN a-na 3 ša-na-at i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay 6 shekels in three years.

transliteration: 12 GÍN a-na 2 ša-na-at i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They will pay 12 shekels in two years.

transliteration: 12 GÍN a-na 3 ša-na-at i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They will pay 12 shekels in three years.

transliteration: a-na 6 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay in six months.

transliteration: um-ma I-dí-A-šur-ma ke-na ⅓ ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.B a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a ta-dí-nam ú ½ ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.B a-na ṭup-pé-e ša ší-bi ha-ru-mì-im ša É A-šur-DÙG (erasure) ta-ag-mu-ur (erasure)
translation: Thus spoke Idi-Ashur: "True, you gave me 1/3 mana 6 shekels of silver for my food, and you spent 1/2 mana 5 shekels of silver for the tablets of the certified witnesses of the house of Ashur-tab."

transliteration: TÚG-ba-tí SIG5 lu i-a-ú-tum lu ša A-lá-hi-im i-Za-al-pá
translation: The good textiles, whether mine or Alahum's, are in Zalpa.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na u4-me-šu-nu ma-al-ú-tim lá iš-qú-lu 1 ½ GÍN.TA a-ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu a-dí KÙ.B i-ša-qú-lu-ni
translation: If they have not paid by their due dates, they shall add 1 1/2 shekels of interest per mana per month until they pay the silver.

transliteration: ITU.KAM ma-hu-ur-i-li li-mu-um ša qá-tí A-mur-A-šùr
translation: The month is Makhur-ili, the eponymy is that of the hand of Amur-Assur.

transliteration: 2 me-at ku-ta-ni ša qá-tim i-na A-limki : A-šùr-bé-el-ša-du-e a-na ša ki-ma Ú-ṣú-ur-ša-A-šùr i-da-an-ma TÚG.HI.A : eq-lam a-na šu-mì : Ú-ṣú-ur-ša-A-šùr e-té-qú
translation: Ashur-bel-shadue will give 200 kutānu-textiles of 'hand' quality in the City to the representatives of Usur-sha-Ashur, and the textiles will cross the country in the name of Usur-sha-Ashur.

transliteration: TÚG.HI.A : a-na Kà-ni-iški e-li-ú-ni-ma : ša ki-ma A-šùr-bé-el-ša-du-e 50 ma-na KÙ.B ṭup-pá-am : ša Ú-ṣú-ur-ša-A-šùr a-na 50 ha-am-ša-tim i-lá-pu-tù-ma KÙ.B a-na : na-ru-qí-šu : i-lá-pá-at
translation: When the textiles have come up to Kanesh, the representatives of Ashur-bel-shadue will record a tablet of 50 minas of silver for Usur-sha-Ashur for 50 hamuštum-periods, and he will record the silver into his naruqqum-capital.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u4-me-šu KÙ.B lá ub-lá-ma IGI A-šùr-bé-el-ša-du-e lá iš-ku-un ⅔ GÍN.TA 15 ŠE KÙ.B a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im : ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If within the full term of his days he has not brought the silver and has not placed it before Ashur-bel-shadue, he will add interest at 2/3 shekel 15 grains of silver per 1 mina per month.

transliteration: šu-ma Ú-ṣú-ur-ša-A-šùr iš-tù-mu-ùh-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.B-áp-kà : le-qé na-ru-qá-kà : ù-la1 a-na-ší-i 15 ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am Ú-ṣú-ur-ša-A-šùr a-na A-šùr-bé-el-ša-du-e i-ša-qal
translation: If Usur-sha-Ashur becomes arrogant and says as follows: "Take your silver, I will not carry your naruqqum-capital," Usur-sha-Ashur will pay 15 minas of refined silver to Ashur-bel-shadue.

transliteration: šu-ma A-ta-ta lá iš-ta-/aq-lam A-mur-dUTU-ma i-da-na[m]
translation: If Atata does not pay, Amur-Shamash himself will give it to me.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ni-ší-im Ì-lí-a-lim ù La1-qé-pí-im il5-qé-ú a-na 30 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
translation: From the hamuštum-period of the kārum of Kanesh which Ili-alum and Laqepum took, they shall pay in 30 hamuštum-periods.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na u4-me-šu-nu lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1 1/2 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣú-bu
translation: If they do not pay on their due date, they shall add 1 1/2 shekels per mina per month according to the rule of the kārum.

transliteration: i-qá-qá-ad šál-me-šu-nu ù ke-ni-šu-nu KÙ.B ra-ki-is
translation: The silver is bound to the person of their most solvent and reliable one.

transliteration: 7 ½ ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er : A-šur-né-me-dí DUMU A-šur-na-da A-šur-be-el-ša-du-/e i-šu
translation: Ashur-bel-shadu-e has a claim for 7 1/2 minas of refined silver against Ashur-nemedi, son of Ashur-nada.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-[mu]-uš-tim ša A-šur-ta-[ak-lá-ku] DUMU A-lá-hi-im a-na 6 ha-a[m-ša-tim i-š]a-qal
translation: He will pay in 6 hamuštum-periods, starting from the hamuštum-period of Ashur-taklaku, son of Alahum.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1 ½ [GÍN a-n]a [m]a-na-im i-ITU.KAM : ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-[áb]
translation: If he does not pay, he shall add 1 1/2 shekels of silver per mina per month as interest.

transliteration: 2 GÚ 15 ma-na URUDU SIG5 ½ ma-n[a A]N.NA 1 ½ GÍN KÙ.B i-li-bi4 A-šur-né-me-dí i-šu
translation: Ashur-bel-shadu-e has a claim for 2 talents 15 minas of good copper, 1/2 mina of tin, and 1 1/2 shekels of silver against Ashur-nemedi.

transliteration: 3 ½ ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er Puzur4-Ištar DUM[U] A-bu-ša-lim A-šur-be-el-ša-/du-e i-šu
translation: Ashur-bel-shadu-e has a claim for 3 1/2 minas of refined silver against Puzur-Ishtar, son of Abu-shalim.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-[tim ša E]n-na-nim DUMU Am-ri-a a-na 12 h[a-a]m-ša-tim i-ša-/qal
translation: He will pay in 12 hamuštum-periods, starting from the hamuštum-period of Ennanum, son of Amriya.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na u4-me-šu ma-[al]-ú-tim lá iš-qúl 1 ½ GÍN a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he does not pay at the end of his term, he shall add 1 1/2 shekels per 1 mina as interest.

transliteration: 2 ⅔ ma-na 3 ½ GÍN KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er : En-nam-A-šur DUMU I-dí-Sú-in ú Ar-ší-ah DUMU Na-na-a : A-šur-be-el-ša-du-/e i-šu
translation: Ashur-bel-shadu-e has a claim for 2 2/3 minas and 3 1/2 shekels of refined silver against Ennam-Ashur, son of Iddin-Suen, and Arshi-ah, son of Nanaya.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša Ú-ṣur-ša-Ištar 2 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: From the hamuštum-period of Usur-sha-Ishtar, they shall add 2 shekels per 1 mina per month as interest.

transliteration: 1 ⅓ ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am DAM.GÀR-ru-um a-na A-šur-ma-lik DUMU A-mu-ra a-be-a-lim i-dí-in
translation: The merchant gave 1 1/3 minas and 3 shekels of refined silver to Ashur-malik, son of Amura, for trading.

transliteration: té-er-<<tí>>-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er I-dí-Ištar lá i-li-[kam]
translation: Your report did not come to Idi-Ishtar.

transliteration: a-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na.ki a-ta-ba-al
translation: I will take (it) to Wahshushana.

transliteration: ú-lá i-tù-ar
translation: He will not return.

transliteration: hu-ša-e iš-tí ur-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-um
translation: I will send you the scrap metal with the next messengers.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI ku-nu-ki-a ša šé-ep Ta-ha-ša-li Puzur4-A-šùr DUMU I-šar-ki-id-A-šùr na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Puzur-Ashur, son of Ishar-kid-Ashur, is bringing you 2 minas of gold with my seals, of the caravan of Tahashali.

transliteration: le-ru-ub-ma : ṭup-pè-e : li-ip-té-ú-ma ṭup-pì lá-al-qé
translation: Let me enter, let the tablets be opened, and I will take my tablet.

transliteration: a-na A-šùr-DÙG qí-bi4-ma
translation: Speak to Ashur-tab:

transliteration: um-ma Ta-ha-ša-li
translation: Thus says Tahashali:

transliteration: a-na Kà-ni-iš ta-li-ku
translation: You went to Kanesh.

transliteration: té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma KÙ.B lu-šé-bi4-lam
translation: Let your report come to me and let me send the silver.

transliteration: ša ṭup-pá-am ša A-limki la1 áš-me-ú i-na ṭup-pì-im ta-al-ta-á[p-ta-am]
translation: You wrote in a tablet that I have not heard the tablet of the City.

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma a-dí ma-la1 ù ší-ni-šu ṭup-pá-am ša A-limki ta-áš-me-e
translation: Thus (you said): 'Once or twice you heard the tablet of the City.'

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um Kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-/tí-ma IGI GÍ[R] ša A-šùr ší-[b]u-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: Regarding these matters, the karum of Kanish gave us (the case) and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Ashur.

transliteration: a-ma-kam KÙ.B dí-na-šu-ma KÙ.B ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: Give the silver to him there, and seal the silver and send it to me.

transliteration: Ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ni-ša-al-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na nu-a-im Ha-dí-a-ni iš-qúl
translation: We questioned Ili-ashrani and he said as follows: 'Hadiani paid it to the native.'

transliteration: a-na A-šùr-ma-lik qí-bi4- ma um-ma Puzur4-A-šùr ú A-šùr-lá-ma-sí-ma
translation: To Ashur-malik say: Thus says Puzur-Ashur and Ashur-lamassi:

transliteration: a-ma-lá na-áš-pár-tí-kà : ma-ak-na-kam ša A-bu-ša-lim : nu-ša-áp-tí-ma
translation: In accordance with your message, we had the storehouse of Abu-shalim opened.

transliteration: ta-ma-lá-ki ku-nu-ki-kà : ša ṭup-pè-e ha-ru-mu-tim : ša a-na A-bu-ša-lim : té-zi-bu nu-šé-ṣí-a-ma
translation: We brought out the tablet containers with your seals containing the case-enclosed tablets which you left for Abu-shalim.

transliteration: ta-ma-lá-ki ni-ip-tí-ma : 1 ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im 1 ṭup-pá-am ha-ar-ma-am ša 2 ma-na KÙ.B ša ku-nu-uk Puzur2-A-na DUMU DINGIR-na-da ú 2 ší-ta na-áš-pé-ra-tí-šu nu-šé-li-ma
translation: We opened the containers and we took out one tablet of the karum, one case-enclosed tablet of 2 minas of silver with the seal of Puzur-Ana son of Ilum-nada, and two of his messages.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ṭup-pé-e : GÁNA-lam5 e-ta-qí-im ši-bé-e : ni-iš-ku-ma
translation: Regarding the tablets for crossing the terrain, we established witnesses.

transliteration: me-eh-ri : né-nu : nu-kà-al
translation: We ourselves are holding the copies.

transliteration: a-na-kam A-šur-UTU-ši mu-ut A-šur-DÙG iš-me-ma KÙ.B-áp-kà a-na KÙ-pì-šu iš-ta-kán
translation: Here Ashur-shamshi, the husband of Ashur-tab, heard this and he placed your silver with his silver.

transliteration: KÙ.B lá i-ta-ba-al
translation: He shall not take away the silver.

transliteration: a-wi-lúm pì-šu lá ke-en6
translation: The man's word is not reliable.

transliteration: a-wi-lúm a-na ba-ú-ri-a i-tí-zi-iz
translation: The man stood up to catch me.

transliteration: ù i-na lá i-dim 1 me-at 60 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-ri-a im-tù-qú-ut
translation: And without reason, 160 minas of copper fell upon me as a debt.

transliteration: ù ša ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ú
translation: And we have called for the accounting.

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-we-dí-im e ta-áp-ṭur4
translation: Do not release the man alone there.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-ú-a ù ší-bu-ú-a da-nu
translation: My tablets and my witnesses are strong.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-šu-nu ha-ru-mu
translation: Their tablets are certified.

transliteration: šu-ma a-lá-am i-ma-ha-ar
translation: If he approaches the city.

transliteration: [a-n]a A-šur-DÙG qí-bi4-ma
translation: To Ashur-tab, say:

transliteration: [u]m-ma Lá-ba-na-da-ma
translation: Thus says Labanada:

transliteration: té-er-tí i-a-tum kà-áš-da-ku
translation: I have arrived with my instructions.

transliteration: 1 ṣú-ha-ar-kà ṭur4-da-ma
translation: Send one of your servants.

transliteration: a-na a-li-ki-im ša a-na A-limki i-lu-ku dí-in
translation: Give it to the traveler who is going to the City.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ù ke-ni-šu-/nu ra-ki-is
translation: The silver is bound to the head of their solvent and reliable ones.

transliteration: ma-lá : na-áš-a-[tù]-nu-ni i-na up-qí-im li-wi-a
translation: Whatever you are carrying, let it be wrapped in a container.

transliteration: ù ku-ta-nu! [qá]-áb-li-ú-tum šu-lu-ša i-na up-qí-im li-wi-a
translation: And let the middle-quality kutānu-textiles be wrapped three-by-three in a container.

transliteration: a-na Puzur4-Ištar dí-na-a
translation: Submit the matter to Puzur-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na ṭup-pì-im ša A-limki ù ra-bi4-ṣí-im ša be-lí-a áp-lá-ah-ma a-tù-ra-am
translation: I respected the tablet of the City and the attorney of my lord and I returned.

transliteration: ba-a-am ṭup-pá-am ša A-limki ú be-lí-a IGI kà-ri-im Kà-ni-eš ša-áš-me-e-ma a-ma-lá ra-bi4-iṣ-kà ší-be-e i-na Na-ah-ri-a iš-ku-na-ni le-pu-uš
translation: Come, have the tablet of the City and my lord heard before the colony of Kanesh and let me act according to (the witnesses) your attorney established for me in Nahria.

transliteration: a-ta a-na dí-in kà-ri-im Kà-ni-eš ṣa-he-er GAL gám-ri-im ší-be-e ta-áš-ta-kà-nam
translation: You are continually setting witnesses for the final judgment of the colony of Kanesh, small and great.

transliteration: ù tù-na-ha-ni ú KÙ.B ma-dam tù-ša-ag-me-ri
translation: And you trouble me and you made me spend much silver.

transliteration: 6 ma-na AN.NA ni-is-ha-tim i-na Kà-ni-iš É kà-ri-im il5-qé-ú
translation: They took 6 minas of tin as excise in Kanesh at the colony house.

transliteration: 6 ½ ma-na AN.NA a-na ni-ip-lá-tim a-na Ku-ra a-dí-in
translation: I gave 6 1/2 minas of tin for compensating payments to Kura.

transliteration: a-na A-šur-ma-lik Ú-ṣur-ša-A-šur ú A-šùr-ma-lik qí-bi4-ma um-ma A-šur-be-el-ša-du-e-ma
translation: Speak to Ashur-malik, Usur-sha-Ashur, and Ashur-malik: thus says Ashur-bel-shadue.

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.B i-pì En-na-Sú-in a-na DUMU Ší-ma-lá-i-im a-dí-in
translation: I gave 5 shekels of silver according to Enna-Suen to the son of Shimalaium.

transliteration: DINGIR-ma-lá-ak ù A-šur-ma-lik il5-qé-ú-ma a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im i-dí-nu
translation: Ilum-malak and Ashur-malik took (them) and gave (them) to the merchant.

transliteration: bi-il5-tum : im-ṭí
translation: The load decreased.

transliteration: ša tám-kà-ri-im ik- šu? -da -ni
translation: What belongs to the merchant reached me.

transliteration: a-ha-ma 3 ½ ma-na KÙ.B ša Puzur2-Ištar KÙ.B ú ṣí-ba-sú lá ta-ga-mì-il5
translation: Separately, regarding 3 1/2 minas of silver of Puzur-Ištar, do not be indulgent with the silver and its interest.

transliteration: a-ha-ma 1 ⅔ ma-na 2 GÍN ṭup-pá-am ša ba-áb DINGIR e-zi-ba-kum
translation: Separately, I left you a tablet of 1 2/3 minas 2 shekels of the Gate of God.

transliteration: a-ha-ma 1 ⅓ ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.B ŠÀ.BA ⅓ ma-na 1 ½ GÍN KÙ.B Ša-lim-a-hu-um i-lá-qé
translation: Separately, from 1 1/3 minas 6 shekels of silver, Šalim-ahum will take 1/3 mina 1 1/2 shekels of silver.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú[l 1 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-ITU.KAM] ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-á[b]
translation: If he does not pay, he shall add 1 shekel per mina per month as interest.

transliteration: ⅓ ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.B i-na ša ṭup-pì-šu ša A-šur-ba-áš-tí i-ri-ih
translation: 21 shekels of silver is remaining from his tablet of Ashur-bashti.

transliteration: 40 ma-na KÙ.B i-ṣé-er A-šur-DÙG DUMU Šu-Ištar A-lá-hu-um i-šu
translation: Alāhum has 40 minas of silver against Aššur-ṭāb, son of Šu-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na 3 ša-na-at i-ša-qal
translation: He shall pay within three years.

transliteration: KÙ.B a-ni-am i-ša-qal-ma 11 ma-na KÙ.GI A-lá-hu-um a-na na-ru-qí-šu a-na A-šur-DÙG i-ša-pá-ak
translation: He shall pay this silver and Alāhum shall deposit 11 minas of gold into the capital-fund of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: šu-ma A-lá-hu-um i-ba-lá-kà-at 10 ma-na KÙ.B a-na <<a-na>> A-šur-DÙG i-ša-qal
translation: If Alāhum defaults, he shall pay 10 minas of silver to Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: [šu-m]a A-šur-DÙG [i-b]a-lá-kà-at [x ma-n]a KÙ.B [a-n]a A-lá-hi-im i-ša-qal
translation: If Aššur-ṭāb defaults, he shall pay [x] minas of silver to Alāhum.

transliteration: lu a-hi-um ma-ma-an KÙ.B i-da-š[u]-um na-ru-qú-um a-na É A-lá-hi-im-ma e-ra-áb

translation: Reckoned from the month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Kūbiya, he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

translation: Witnessed by Uzuwa, by Iddin-abum.

translation: 3.5 minas of copper with a value of 4 shekels of silver for small wares.

translation: As for Aššur-imittī, 25 shekels of silver and 1 shekel of gold Atahšu brought him.

transliteration: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šur-SIPA-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē’ī:

translation: 4 talents and 20 minas of tin under seal and 121 textiles, all this I am leading to you.

translation: Thus the colony of Kanesh: say to the payers of the datu-contribution, to our messengers, and to every colony and trading station:

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim(ki) i-li-kam
translation: A letter of the City has arrived.

transliteration: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim(ki) iš-tù u₄-mì-im a-nim ma-ma-an KÙ.AN i-ša-ú-mu-ni i-na né-mè-lim da-šùr ú-lá e-WA iš-ra-tí-šú kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-lá-qé
translation: In the letter of the City (it says): from this day on, whoever buys amūtu-iron, (the City of) Aššur will not share in the profit; the colony of Kanesh will collect the tithe of it.

transliteration: ki-ma ṭup-pì-ni ta-áš-me-a-ni a-ma-kam lu a-na ší-mì-im a-na É.GAL-lim i-dí-in lu té-ra-at É.GAL-lim ú-kà-lim lu na-ší-ma a-dí-ni lá i-dí-in ma-lá KÙ.AN na-áš-ú ni-bi₄-it a-ší-im šu-um-šú ú šu-mì a-bi₄-šú i-na ṭup-pì-im lu-up-ta-nim-ma iš-tí ší-ip-ri-ni šé-bi₄-lá-nim
translation: As soon as you have heard our letter, whoever there has either sold it to a palace, or has offered it to palace officials, or still carries it with him without having yet sold it - for all the amūtu-iron he carries, write the exact amount of every piece, his name and his father's name on a tablet and send it here with our messenger.

transliteration: me-ḫe-er ṭup-pì-ni a-na kà-ar kà-ar-ma ú wa-bar-ra-tim šé-bi₄-lá
translation: Send a copy of this letter of ours to every colony and to all the trading stations.

transliteration: KÙ.AN lu a-na DAM.GÀR-ru-tim i-dí-in šu-mì a-wi-lim lu-up-ta-nim
translation: Even when somebody has sold amūtu-iron via a trading agent, register the name of that man.

transliteration: um-ma en-na-num-ma a-na id-na-a ù a-šur-… qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus Ennānum: say to Idnaya and Aššur-...:

transliteration: a ma-lá áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na tí-ir-tí-a ša x x im … i-ra-dí-ú a-pu-tum i-ḫi-id-ma ki-ma ša qá-qí-dí-kà lu-qú-tí ù e-ma-ri-a a ma-lá a-wi-lu-tí-kà ša-ṣí-ir
translation: In accordance with what I wrote to you, regarding my orders that ... leads - urgent, pay attention and guard my goods and my donkeys like your own life as you are a gentleman.

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-šur-i-mì-tí a-na a-lim(ki) i-li-ku KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na ú 3 ma-na a-na ra-mì-ni-šú na-ší
translation: When Aššur-imittī went to the City, he brought some 2 or 3 minas of silver on his own.

transliteration: ù i-na a-lim(ki) 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at ḫa-al-gi-a-šú a-šur-i-mì-tí il₅-qé
translation: And in the City, Aššur-imittī took 0.5 mina of silver, the working capital of Halgiaššu.

translation: Clear whatever textiles and tin he brings on his own and let it remain with him.

transliteration: ú x x a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-a ša áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni ep-ša
translation: Also, carry out ... in accordance with my instructions that I sent to you.

transliteration: ù ṣí-ba-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí mì-ma lá i-sà-li-ma li-bi₄ lá i-ma-ra-ṣa-kum
translation: Also, with respect to the matters of Aššur-imittī, he must not lie, lest I become angry with you.

transliteration: [...] a-na na-áp-ṭá-ar ku-pá-im i-ša-qú-lu
translation: ... they are to pay at the melting of the snow.

translation: Furthermore, he will send 4.5 shekels of silver from the assets of Wald-Ilim upon his arrival ... my messenger.

transliteration: 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp ú-zu-a i-na li-bi-a ḫi-na-a il₅-qé
translation: Hinnāya took 3.5 minas of Uzua's silver at my expense.

transliteration: IGI a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim DUMU šu-a-nim IGI en-nam-(d)IŠKUR DUMU zi-ra
translation: In the presence of Aššur-bēl-awātim son of Šu-Anum, and of Ennam-Adad son of Zira.

transliteration: um-mì-a-nu-šú a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-ra-ki-sú-ni
translation: His investors had contractually bound me for making purchases.

transliteration: um-ma i-na-a-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ú MAN-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Innaya to Aššur-ṭāb and Puzur-Aššur: Speak!

transliteration: a-na-kam ru-ba-um ù ru-ba-tum a-na ḫa-ra-na-tim ša pá-zu-ur-tim iš-pu-ru-ma
translation: The king and queen here have written to the road-guards concerning smuggling.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma ša i ma-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ù AN.NA na-áš-ú ma ta-ma ra ni ṣa-áb-ta-ma AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A a-tù-nu kà-i-lá-ma ra-ga am i-a-tí ri-id-a-am
translation: They said: "Seize anyone you observe carrying textiles and tin in the land, and then withhold the tin and textiles and lead the criminal to me."

transliteration: ú a-na ša ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim iš-ta-áp-ru
translation: Also, they have written to those of the Narrow Track.

transliteration: a-pu-tum AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A lá tù-pá-za-ra
translation: Urgent: do not smuggle tin and textiles.

transliteration: ú a-na ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim mì-ma lá ta-ša-kà-na
translation: And do not commit anything to the Narrow Track.

transliteration: a-pu-tum a-wa-tum da-na-at
translation: Urgent: the orders are strict.

transliteration: mì-ma e šé-bi₄-lá-ma li-ba-ak-nu e im-ra-aṣ
translation: Do not send anything lest you be sorry.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ší-ta-me-šu-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ šé-bi₄-il₅-šu
translation: Hear the letter repeatedly and send it to Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú a-sà-nim ša É ás-qú-dim ú pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU e-lá-ma ḫa-ra-nam iš-té-ni-iš i-li-ku-nim-ma
translation: The servants of Asanum, who belongs to the house of Asqudum, and Pilah-Ištar, son of Elamma, together went on a journey.

translation: In Hurama they together entered Kubiya's house and the palace levied the import-tax from them together.

translation: Afterwards merchandise was seized and the palace took away Asanum's merchandise.

transliteration: AN.NA ša pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR É ku-bi-a ú-pá-zi-ru-ma i-na É ub-ri iš-lim-ma
translation: The tin that Pilah-Ištar had hidden in Kubiya's house was safe in the guest house.

transliteration: be-lá-num i-li-kam-ma ki-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR im-ṣí-ma AN.NA il₅-qé
translation: Belanum came and he was entitled in the name of Pilah-Ištar to take the tin.

transliteration: ku-bi₄-ma a-na bé-lá-num DUMU šu-a-šur AN.NA ip-qí-id
translation: Kubiya entrusted the tin to Belanum, the son of Šu-Aššur.

transliteration: um-ma bé-lá-num-ma ma-ṣa-ku a
translation: Belanum declared: "I am responsible!"

transliteration: ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma ṣa-ḫe-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: In accordance with the tablet of the City, the plenary Hurama colony gave us (as witnesses).

translation: Witnessed by Aššur-šadu-ili, by Ir'am-Aššur, son of Aššur-malik, and by Abu-šalim, son of Šu-Ištar.

transliteration: [...] … ú-ṣa-áb ITU.KAM qá-ra-a-tim li-mu-um bu-zu-zu
translation: ... he will add. Month Qarra’atum, eponymy Buzuzu.

transliteration: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i da-na-ma qá-tí a-ša-kà-an
translation: He will give 20 minas of silver and I shall lay claim to it.

transliteration: IGI a-šur-GAL IGI a-šur-(d)UTU-ši IGI pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi, by Aššur-šamši, by Pilah-Aššur.

translation: 10 minas of refined silver is owed by our own Puzur-Anna.

transliteration: ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ù kà-sí-a a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim
translation: From the week of Aššur-taklaku and Kasiya the term is for 30 weeks.

translation: If he has not paid, he will add interest at the rate of 0.5 shekel per month per mina.

transliteration: ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um a-mur-a-šur
translation: Month Te'inatum, eponymy Amur-Aššur.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR₄-(d)IM DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR IGI du-um-qá-a DUMU kur-ub-a-a
translation: Witnessed by Puzur-Adad son of Iddin-Ištar, by Dumqaya son of Kurub-aya.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU (d)AB-ba-ni KIŠIB ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
translation: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum, by La-qep son of Enlil-bani, by Silulu son of Uku.

translation: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

translation: And we gave a tablet before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-ša-dí-li-ma a-na ku-li-a ù a-šur-la-ma-sí a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Aššur-šadu-ili to Kuliya and Aššur-lamassi; to Kuliya specifically speak:

transliteration: a-šu-mì a-wa-tim ša É sà-ba-sí-a a-wu-tum ša ma-aḫ-ri-kà lá iz-ku-ú
translation: Concerning the matter of Sabasiya's house, the case that was not settled in your presence.

transliteration: lu-qú-ut-kà ša i-na a-pí-im té-zi-bu-ma lá-ta-ra-ak iṣ-ba-at
translation: Latarak has seized your merchandise that you left behind in Apum.

transliteration: áš-me-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tim ú ší-ip-ra-am al-qé-ma a-na a-pí-im i-li-ik-ma lu-qú-tám ú-ší-ir-ma
translation: I heard it and I obtained a tablet of the elders and a messenger who went to Apum and released the merchandise.

transliteration: a-bi-we-du-um i-ra-dí-a-ku-um
translation: Abi-wedum is now leading that to you.

transliteration: be-et-kà URUDU KÙ.GI ú-ṣú-ra-num ta-da-nam lá i-mu-a um-ma šu-ut-ma ša-qú-ul
translation: As for your house, Usuranum refuses to give either copper or gold, saying: "All has already been paid!"

transliteration: ba-pí-ra-am ša ša-ku-ul-tim ú ku-ku-ba-tim É DAM.GÀR ni-il₅-qé-ma a-na DAM ili₅-ba-ni ni-dí-in
translation: We took beer bread for the banquet and flasks from a merchant's house and gave them to Ili-bani's wife.

transliteration: ki-ma a-wi-lu-tí-kà lu-qú-ut-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Gentleman as you are, convert your merchandise into silver and come here immediately.

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta tí-de₈-e ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša qá-tim a-na ša-ku-ul-tim ...
translation: My brother, realize that every single shekel of silver at hand is for the banquet.

transliteration: a-šur-lá-ma-sí qí-bi₄-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lā-ma li-ba-am dí-nam
translation: Tell Aššur-lamassi: "Send the silver and encourage us!"

transliteration: ší-im SIG₅ a-na a-šur-ṣú-lu-lí dí-in li-bu-šu lá tù-lá-ma-an
translation: Give the yield of the good quality textiles to Aššur-sululi; do not make him angry.

transliteration: ša 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-a-bu-um a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim ḫa-bu-lu
translation: Concerning the fact that Iddin-abum owes 24 minas of silver to Aššur-bēl-awātim:

transliteration: šu-ku-bu-um me-ra-šu É-tí ša ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu ik-nu-uk-ma am-tám ù ÌR-dí ú-šé-ṣí-ma
translation: His son Šu-Kubum has sealed the houses where Šalim-Aššur lives and taken out the maid and the slaves.

translation: But out of the iron that Šalim-Aššur claimed at the City Hall and invested with Iddin-Aššur son of Aššur-malik, and which they brought to Kanesh,

transliteration: qá-tám ša ša-lim-a-šur šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im il₅-qé-ma
translation: Šu-Kubum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim has taken Šalim-Aššur's share to cover Iddin-abum's debt.

transliteration: É-tí am-tám ù ÌR-dí-e a-na ša ki-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ú-wa-šé-er
translation: He will release the houses, the maid and the slaves to Šalim-Aššur's representatives.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
translation: The Kanesh colony has given us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

transliteration: 0.83333 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša sú-ḫu-ur-pì-a-lá a-na sú-e-ta-ta ḫa-bu-lu
translation: 56.5 shekels of silver which Suhurpiyala owes to Suettata,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-al-DU₁₀ iš-qú-ul
translation: Al-ṭāb has paid that silver.

transliteration: a-al-DU₁₀ i-lá-ak-ma né-mu-lu-um i-ta-áb-ší i-né-mì-li-im i-lá-qé
translation: He will make a business trip and if there is profit, he will take it from the profit.

transliteration: šu-ma né-mu-lu-um lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-li-a ù ḫa-ar-ša a-na a-al-DU₁₀ i-ša-qú-lu
translation: If there is no profit Aliya and Harša will pay the silver and the interest on it to Al-ṭāb.

transliteration: IGI ší-il₅-ma-šu IGI šu-pu-nu-ma-an
translation: In the presence of Šilmašu and Šuppunuman.

transliteration: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší Ì-lí-a-lim ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
translation: From Šu-Ištar to Šuma-libši, Ilī-ālum and Amur-Ištar: Speak!

transliteration: a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší ù Ì-lí-a-lim qí-bi-ma
translation: Specifically to Šuma-libši and Ilī-ālum: Speak!

transliteration: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ḫa-bu-lá-tù-nu
translation: You owe 14 shekels of refined silver.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
translation: I hold your certified tablet.

transliteration: u₄-mu-ku-nu ša-na-at e-tí-qú
translation: Your terms are overdue by a year.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-ku-nu ù ke-ni-ku-nu ra-ki-is
translation: The silver loan was with joint liability.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR-áp tám-kà-ri-im
translation: The silver was merchant-silver.

transliteration: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-mur-IŠTAR šu-qú-ul
translation: Pay the silver and its interest there to Amur-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma a-pu-tum i-ḫi-id KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-il₅
translation: To Amur-Ištar: Urgent, pay attention and have the silver and its interest paid.

transliteration: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Ištar-pilah:

transliteration: 3 ma-na AN.NA ḫi-na-a i-na xx ú-kà-al-ma lá i-pá-ṭù-ru-nim
translation: Hinnaya holds 3 minas of tin and one must not open the packet.

transliteration: li-bu-šu lá i-lá-mì-in
translation: Lest he gets angry.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 1.5 ma-na i-ḫi-id-ma šé-bi₄-lam
translation: Take care to send me 1.5 minas of silver.

transliteration: lá ša áš-pu-ra-ku-ni um-ma ḫi-na-a-ma
translation: That I did not write you earlier is because Hinnaya said:

transliteration: té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma ú-šé-ba-la-am
translation: "If a message of yours arrives I will send it to you."

transliteration: áš-pu-ur-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá tù-ḫa-li-iq
translation: I have now written: Do not let the silver get lost.

transliteration: i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
translation: Take care to send me the silver!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN li-li-am
translation: May at least some silver be produced!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR lá KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-sú-in
translation: The silver is not his silver, it is the silver of Iddin-Suen!

transliteration: 2.6666600000000003 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pā-am i-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-ḫi-im ù šu-sú-in en-na-sú-in i-šu
translation: Shalim-ahum and Šu-Suen owe 2 2/3 minas 4 shekels of refined silver to Ennam-Suen.

transliteration: iš-tù SAG ITU.KAM ša ki-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-té ì-lí-dan
translation: From the beginning of month III, eponymy of the successor of Ilī-dān.

transliteration: a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They will pay in a month.

transliteration: šu-ma lá i-šqú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: If they fail to pay they will add 1.5 shekels per mina per month as interest.
