translation: In the presence of Ištar-ilšu, son of Aššur-bāni, and Ada, son of Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: 2 ku-ta-ni ša da-tim a-na e-na-ah-DINGIR a-dí-ma
translation: I gave Enah-ilī 2 kutānus for the fees,

transliteration: a-na qá-tí-šu a-na É kà-ri-im i-dí
translation: and he deposited them on his account in the office of the colony.

transliteration: 1 ku-ta-nam i qá-tim ša a-bi₄-ni a-na qá-tí-šu ú-ṭá-hi
translation: I added 1 kutānum from our father's share to his account.

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur i-ku-nim DUMU e-lá-lí ù am-ur-IŠTAR DUMU …
translation: To Ennam-Aššur, Ikūnum son of Elāli and Amur-Ištar son of ...;

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU i-ku-pì-a
translation: sealed by Aššur-malik son of Ikūn-pīya.

transliteration: a-na šu-a-nim DUMU ha-da-a
translation: To Šu-Anum son of Hadaya;

transliteration: KIŠIB sà-ak-li-a
translation: sealed by Sakliya.

transliteration: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma
translation: To Šalim-Aššur, speak: thus Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a a-dí ší-ni-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-ku-um
translation: I sent you word twice about Ilī-bāni son of Yaya.

transliteration: ki-ma lá-am-ni-iš e-ta-na-pu-šu iš-tù na-ah-ri-a tí-i-ir-tí a-šur-ma-lik DUMU šu-IŠTAR i-li-kam
translation: Since he keeps behaving in an evil manner, a message from Aššur-malik son of Šu-Ištar came from Nahriya.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma 8 TÚG.HI.A ili₅-ba-ni a-ṣé-ri-a im-tù-qú-ut
translation: He said: "Ilī-bāni has attacked me for 8 textiles."

transliteration: TÚG.HI.A a-na ili₅-ba-ni ni-im-nu-ma šu-ut a-na a-šur-ma-lik im-nu-šu-nu
translation: We counted the textiles for Ilī-bāni and he himself counted them for Aššur-malik.

transliteration: 1 e-li-tám a-šur-ma-lik i-na pá-ni wa-ṣa-i-šu e-zi-ma ili₅-ba-ni il₅-qé-ší
translation: Aššur-malik left one top-pack before his departure and Ilī-bāni took it.

transliteration: i-ṣé-er ṣú-ha-ri-im lá i-ma-qú-ut
translation: He shall not attack the servant.

transliteration: a-na a-lim(ki) pá-nu-kà
translation: You are facing toward the City.

transliteration: šu-ma li-ba-kà am-ma-kam lá i-za-ku-ru
translation: If it is your heart's desire, they should not make a declaration there.

transliteration: … li-li-ku-nim
translation: ... they should come.

transliteration: a-na-kam li-iz-ku-ú-ma a-šar i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-kà le-qé
translation: They should clear the matter here and then take your silver wherever it appears.

transliteration: 2 GÚ 56.66666 ma-na AN.NA qá-dum AN.NA qá-tim 15 LÁ 0.25 GÍN.TA
translation: 2 talents 56.6666 minas of tin, including the loose tin, at 14 3/4 shekels per (shekel of silver),

transliteration: 12 ma-na LÁ 0.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu
translation: its price in silver is 11 minas 59.6666 shekels;

transliteration: ší-im TÚG.HI.A ù ANŠE.HI.A 2.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
translation: the price of the textiles and the donkeys is 2.3333 minas of silver.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN x 14.33333 ma-na LÁ 0.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-lá-ma is-ni-iq-ni-a-tí
translation: In all, Elamma weighed out to us 14 minas 19.6666 shekels of silver.

transliteration: e-na-ah-DINGIR be-lá-num ah-ša-lim ù lá-qé-pu-um i mì-ig-ra-tí-šu-nu iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí
translation: Enah-ilī, Bēlānum, Ah-šalim and Lā-qēp seized us by joint agreement.

transliteration: i-na u₄-mì-im ša e-na-ah-DINGIR be-lá-num ù ah-ša-lim KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-be ša ma-za-zi-im ša šu-a-šur qá-sú-nu ma-lá i-ša-qú-lu-ni ù lá-qé-pu-um qá-sú i-ša-qal
translation: On the day when Enah-ilī, Bēlānum and Ah-šalim pay their shares of the silver of Šu-Aššur's pledge, then Lā-qēp must also pay his share.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR₄-a-na
translation: Witnessed by Puzur-Anna,

transliteration: IGI a-lá-hi-im
translation: Witnessed by Ali-ahum.

transliteration: [...] a-na ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki) lu ni-ta-la-ak-ma
translation: ... let us go in accordance with the verdict of the City ...

transliteration: … qí-bi-ma a-hi a-ta
translation: ... say: "My dear brother,"

transliteration: … i-na (d)UTU-ši ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: the very day you hear my letter, set out and come!

transliteration: … lá a-kà-ṣa-ad
translation: I shall not seize.

transliteration: … iš-tí a-ba-ba bu-lá-tí-ni … lá i-mu-a
translation: ... with Ababa, our assets ... he will not agree.

transliteration: … a-na … [...] lá x bi ší … i-a-tí qí-bi-ma ih-da-ma a …
translation: Speak to me, pay attention!

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik ša-lim-a-šur ù ì-lí-a-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Aššur-malik, Šalim-Aššur and Iliya to Šalim-Aššur, speak:

transliteration: la-ma a-šur-ša-du-e i-li-kà-ni la-ma ṭup-pí-kà ub-lá-ni ITU.2.KAM šu-be-lúm i pá-ni a-šur-ša-du-e i-li-kam-ma
translation: Before Aššur-šadu'e arrived, before he brought your letter, Šu-Bēlum arrived two months before Aššur-šadu'e,

transliteration: šu-be-lúm šu-ku-ba-am DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ù a-hi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ma a-na a-lim(ki) ir-de₈-šu-nu-ma
translation: and Šu-Bēlum seized Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim and his brother and conducted them to the City;

transliteration: ù né-nu a-wa-tám nu-ta-er-ma um-ma né-nu-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu ga-am-ra
translation: and then we rebuffed the matter, saying: "Their case is closed."

transliteration: a-na ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) i-tù-a-ar
translation: He is reopening a matter that has been sworn by the City.

transliteration: a-lúm(ki) dí-nam i-dí-in-ma šu-be-lúm ù DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na šu-ku-bi-im ù a-hi-šu la i-tù-ru
translation: The City passed a verdict, stating that Šu-Bēlum and Issu-arik's daughter must not raise claim against Šu-Kūbum and his brother.

transliteration: šu-ku-bu-um a-na kà-ni-iš i-lá-ak-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR ù ku-a-tí a-na šu-be-lim ú-kà-an
translation: Šu-Kūbum must go to Kanesh to make you and Itūr-ilī confirm to Šu-Bēlum

transliteration: ki-ma lu-qú-tám ip-qí-da-ku-nu-tí-ni ša a-na gám-ra-tim a-na ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) i-tù-ra-ku-ni ta-lá-kam-ma a-dí MU.1.ŠÈ a-wa-tám a-na É a-bi-kà ta-da-an
translation: that he entrusted the goods to you; since he has raised claim against you for everything sworn by the City, you must come and open a case for your paternal estate within one year.

transliteration: SAG ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um e-lá-lí DUMU i-ku-nim
translation: Dated the beginning of the month Bēlat-ekallim, the eponymy of Elāli son of Ikūnum.

transliteration: ṭup-pí-kà ší-bi₄-kà da-a-a-ni-kà ga-me-er a-wa-tí-kà ša a-na a-lim(ki) i-la-kà-ni li-li-kam
translation: As to your tablets, your witnesses, and your judges who settled your affair - he who will come to the City should come;

transliteration: ša lá i-la-kà-ni ša-sí-ha
translation: he who will not come you must extradite.

transliteration: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bí-ma
translation: Thus Šu-Ištar, say to Ennam-Suen:

transliteration: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: Why have you written me as follows:

transliteration: 0.5-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR hu-bu-lá-am a-ma-at-kà té-pu-uš
translation: 'Your maid has contracted a debt of 0.5 mina of silver'?

transliteration: a-ṣé-er ra-ga-at-ni ù hu-bu-lá-am a-na na-ša-a té-pá-áš
translation: She is not only wicked, but is also contracting a debt for herself.

transliteration: 10 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-lá-tim uš-té-bi₄-lá-ší-im
translation: I have sent her consignments of silver amounting to 10 minas and 10 shekels!

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-ta ú-la ta-na-ṭá-al
translation: Over there, you are not even looking!

transliteration: a-ma i-a-tí-i ta-ṭá-ba-am
translation: Is it really to me that you are being nice?

transliteration: a-am-tám ha-li-iq
translation: Get rid of the maid!

transliteration: a-na ta-al-ha-tim dí-i-ší
translation: Sell her to a man from Talhat;

transliteration: a-na DUMU a-šùr lá ta-dá-ší
translation: do not sell her to an Assyrian!

transliteration: a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a pá-ni-a a hu-ra-ma tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ma
translation: As to the 0.5 mina of silver that you sent to me in Hurrama,

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-na-nu-um DUMU ku-zi-a na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Ennānum son of Kuziya brings you 0.5 mina of silver under my seal.

transliteration: na-áš-pè-ra-tum ša a-lim(ki) ša a-ṣé-ri-kà ub-lu-ni-ku-ni
translation: Regarding the missives from the City that they brought to you,

transliteration: a-hi a-ta a ba-tí-qí-im pá-ni-im x ub-lu
translation: my dear brother, they brought them to the first express caravan.

transliteration: 23.5 GÚ SÍG.HI.A 66 maš-ku 10 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ú ú-nu-sú-nu 25 TÚG.HI.A mì-ma a-nim i ša-ni-tim šé-pí-šu-nu
translation: 23.5 talents of wool, 66 fleeces, 10 black donkeys and their harness, 25 textiles - all this in their second transport.

transliteration: 10 GÍN AN.NA 2 šé-ni-in ša sí-ni-iš-tim 8 šé-ni ša ṣú-ùh-ri-im 3 ma-ar-šu e-ba-du-ni
translation: 10 shekels of tin, 2 pairs of women's shoes, 8 pairs of children's shoes, 3 ... .

transliteration: du-ug-li mì-ma a-nim a-na qá-tí-šu-nu a-dí-in
translation: Look! I gave all this into their hands.

transliteration: e-zi-ib sà-he-er-tám ša i pá-ni-tim a qá-tí-šu-nu a-dí-nu-ni
translation: Apart from the small items that I had previously given into their hands.

transliteration: 19 GÚ 20 ma-na SÍG.HI.A me-at 2 maš-ku i šé-ep a-šu-ú-ma-an i-li-ik
translation: 19 talents 20 minas of wool and 102 fleeces went in the transport of Ashur-uman.

transliteration: [...] ša-lim-ar-dí ú šu-nu-nu áp-qí-id
translation: ... I entrusted to Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu.

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-i-dí DUMU mu-mu-lá-nim IGI a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU i-ku-nim DUMU sá-ma-a
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-idī son of Mumulānum, (and) witnessed by Aššur-taklāku son of Ikūnum son of Samaya.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim a dur₄-hu-mì-it [...] x x x ša ki-ma i-a-tí ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
translation: All this my representative sent to Durhumit.

transliteration: 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am en-um-a-šùr DUMU sú-in-na-da 5.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am sú-in-na-da me-ra-šu il₅-qé-ú i-na ší-im x x x x x x x x
translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Suen-nādā and Suen-nādā his son have received 13 minas of refined silver and 5.3333 minas of refined silver respectively from the proceeds of the price of ... .

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí IGI iš-me-DINGIR IGI bi-… DUMU ha-na-ni-a IGI DINGIR.SIPA DUMU ša-ak-ṣí-im
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī, witnessed by Išme-ilum, witnessed by Bi... son of Hannāniya, witnessed by Ilī-rē'ī son of Šakṣum.

transliteration: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er x-a-šur DAM.GÀR i-šu
translation: ...-Aššur owes 4 shekels of silver to the creditor.

transliteration: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
translation: Contracted in month XII, he will pay within a month.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 0.33333 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he does not pay, he will add 0.3333 shekel per month as interest.

transliteration: li-mu-um a-šùr-na-da ha-mu-uš-tum ša qá-tè kà-ar-wa-a
translation: Year eponymy of Aššur-nādā, week eponymy of the successor of Karwaya.

transliteration: IGI a-šur-i-d
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-idī.

transliteration: um-ma bu-bu-ra-num-ma a-na a-bi₄-a ù a-šùr-DU₁₀ qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Buburānum to Abiya and Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ qí-bi-ma iš-tù na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur ba-dí-a a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb-ma ù a-ta ta-áš-ta-pu
translation: Specifically to Aššur-ṭāb: Badiya has been staying there since the month Narmak-Aššur, and you have remained silent.

transliteration: šu-ma a-hu-a a-tù-nu iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma pì-iq-da-ni-šu-ma a-na a-lim(ki) li-li-kam-ma da-a-sú a-ša-qal
translation: If you are my brothers, entrust him to the very first caravan and let him come to the City, and I shall pay his road-tax.

transliteration: šu-ma a-lá-kam lá i-mu-a a-pu-tum lá i-ṣa-li-ku-nu kà-sí-a-šu-ma šé-ri-a-ni-šu
translation: If he refuses to come, it is urgent that he does not cheat you; bind him and bring him to me.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-a ša a-hu-zu-ma tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni
translation: Regarding the 0.5 mina of silver that I acquired and you sent to me in advance.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-na-num DUMU ku-zi-a ub-lá-ku-um
translation: Ennānum son of Kuziya brought to you 0.5 mina of silver under my seal.

transliteration: a-hi a-ta na-áš-pè-ra-tim ša a-lim(ki) ša en-na-num ub-lá-ku-ni i-hi-id-ma
translation: My brother, pay attention to the reports from the City that Ennānum brought to you.

transliteration: a ba-tí-qí-im pá-ni-im-ma dí-in-ma lu-ub-lu
translation: And give (them) to the very first messenger so that they may bring (them).

transliteration: iš-tí wa-ṣí-im pá-ni-im-ma lu-ṣí-am
translation: He should depart with the first travellers to leave.

transliteration: um-ma a-šur-ša-du-e a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Aššur-šadū'ē, Amur-šarrassa, and Šalim-wardum to Ali-ahum.

transliteration: 31 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-kà ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ub-lá-am
translation: Šalim-wardum brought 31 minas of tin under your seal.

transliteration: a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà AN.NA a-na a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim ni-dí-ma a-na li-bi ma-tim ú-šé-ri-bu-ma 6.5 GÍN.TA a-na an-ni-ki-kà ub-lu-ni-kum
translation: In accordance with your instructions we gave the tin to Amur-šarrassa and Šalim-wardum and they led it into the heartland, and they brought you (silver) at 6.5 shekels per (shekel) for your tin.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 3.5 GÍN ša-du-a-tám ni-dí
translation: Thereof we deposited 3.5 shekels as transport tariff.

transliteration: 4.66666 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ša-lim-wa-ar-dim na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Šalim-wardum is bringing you 4.6666 minas and 2.5 shekels of silver under our seals.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu ni-dí-in
translation: We gave 1 shekel of silver for his disposal.

transliteration: a-na šu-mì šu-(d)EN.LÍL ša ni-iš-pu-ra-ku-ni 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-(d)EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
translation: With respect to Šu-Enlil about whom we wrote to you, Šu-Enlil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur promised 3 minas of silver to us.

transliteration: iš-tù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim i-li-kà-ni šu-(d)EN.LÍL lá-šu
translation: After Šalim-wardum arrived, Šu-Enlil was gone.

transliteration: a šu-mì-šu ša-lim-wa-ar-dim 10 u₄-me ú 20 u₄-me nu-sá-as-ḫîr-šu
translation: Because of him we made Šalim-wardum wait 10 or 20 days.

transliteration: i-na a-lá-ak šu-(d)EN.LÍL tí-ir-tám za-ku-tám ni-ša-pá-ra-kum
translation: When Šu-Enlil arrives we shall send a final report to you.

transliteration: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-sá-num-ma
translation: To Kuliya, thus says Asānum.

transliteration: a-šu-mì a-ší-im sà-ah-ra-a-ku
translation: I am delayed because of the iron.

transliteration: a-ši-a-im i-ma-gu₅-ru a-da-šu-ma a-ta-be-a-am-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: When they agree on the iron I will sell it, get ready and leave for you.

transliteration: a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà ša a-šu-mì kà-lá-pí-im i-li-kà-ni ší-bé-e a-dí-ni lá ah-ri-im
translation: As for your letter which arrived here concerning the axe, I have not yet recorded the witnesses.

transliteration: i ší-be-a a-zu kà-ṣa-ar PUZUR₄-a-mur
translation: Among my witnesses is Azu, the transporter of Puzur-Aššur.

transliteration: be-lí a-ta a-na a-na PUZUR₄-a-mur pu-nu-ma a-zu-ú li-ìṭ-ru-dam
translation: Please, my lord, approach Puzur-Aššur and let him send Azu to me.

transliteration: iš-tí tap-pá-i-šu ší-bu-tám li-dí-nam
translation: So that he can testify for me together with his colleagues.

transliteration: i-na lá i-da-i-a a-mì-ša-am i-tal-kam
translation: Without my knowledge he has left for there.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na e-lá-lí a-lá-ak
translation: He said: 'I am going to Elalī.'

transliteration: a-na en-um-a-šur ù SIG₅-pí-a-šur a-na SIG₅-pí-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur and Damiq-pī-Aššur; specifically to Damiq-pī-Aššur, from Šāt-Anna.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-na-kum
translation: I gave you 10 shekels of refined silver for purchases.

transliteration: 3 ša-lá-ší-šu qá-dum ša ha-ra-an a-lim(ki) ha-ra-nam ú-qá
translation: Three times I waited for the caravan together with those on the road to the City.

transliteration: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu a-na en-um-a-šur šu-qál
translation: Pay the silver or the goods bought with it there to Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: 2 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni
translation: Concerning the 2 minas 12.5 shekels of silver that I gave you.

transliteration: a-hi a-ta be-lí a-ta ší-ma-am e-pu-uš-ma iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma šé-bi-lam
translation: My dear brother, my dear lord, carry out the purchase yourself and send it with the very first transport.

transliteration: x lá ša ku-lu ša aq-bi₄-a-ku-ni lu TÚG-ba-tí lu AN.NA ša-dí-šu-ma šé-bi₄-lam
translation: ... as for everything I told you, sell either the textiles or the tin and send (the silver) to me.

transliteration: a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
translation: To Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-na-a-na
translation: Sealed by Anna-anna.

transliteration: KIŠIB lu-zi-na KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀
translation: Seal of Luzina, seal of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: ša hu-bu-ul a-šur-ba-ni DUMU sú-ku-ku
translation: Of the debt of Aššur-bāni, son of Sukkuku.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-tí-šu i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay 0.66666 mina of silver at the agreed time.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ìš-qú-ul 1 ma-na-um 0.33333 ma-na i-lá-ak-šu-um
translation: If he does not pay, 0.33333 mina per mina will accrue for him.

transliteration: a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR hi-na-a i-šé-e-šu
translation: Hinnāya will sue him for 1 mina of silver.

transliteration: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ip-hu-ru-um
translation: Month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy of Iphurum.

transliteration: a-na LUGAL-sú-en₆ qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-GAL-ma
translation: To Šar-Suen speak: thus says Aššur-rabi.

translation: Let them remain there with Anna-anna.

translation: Ennam-Aššur... Thereof 26 shekels of silver ... sick-copper Rabi-Aššur.

translation: Memoranda concerning customers.

translation: To Dan-Aššur and Ušmaya from Puzur-Aššur:

translation: As you brought tin to Akiya, I have brought it here before Akiya, and there is 2 minas too little of the tin.

transliteration: li-tí-ik-tám ku-nu-ki ša a-ki-a DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings it to you sealed by Akiya for testing.

transliteration: a-ma-kam iš-tí áb-nim ša tù-ša-qí-lá-ni ma-aḫ-ṣa-ma šu-ma ba-tí-iq i-li i-ṣé-ri-šu id-a
translation: Check it there with the weight-stone that you weigh with and if there is too little, add bags on top of it.

transliteration: a-ba-ma 2 ma-na ni-ga-li na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Further, he brings you 2 minas of sickles.

transliteration: 8 ma-na x x ga a li-il₅-qé
translation: Let him take 8 minas...

transliteration: 20 ma-na a-tù-nu le-qé-a-ma a-na na-áb-ri-tí e-ma-ri-a dí-na
translation: You yourselves should take 20 minas and give it for the paddock of my donkeys.

translation: I promised to give 0.3333 mina of silver as a working capital to Akiya.

transliteration: a-na-kam l
translation: I do not have it here.

transliteration: iš-tù a-lim(ki) KÙ.BABBAR-pì ú-ta-ra-am
translation: I shall return my silver from the City.

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 15 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-ki-a
translation: 5 shekels of silver is owed by Akiya.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-ma ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pu-šu lu-up-ta
translation: Give him the silver and write his tablet for 0.3333 mina of silver.

transliteration: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 4 shekels of silver.

transliteration: i-nu-mì tí-ri-ku-nu-ni dí-na-ší-im
translation: When she asks you for it, give it to her.

transliteration: a ma-lá áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅-tim DIRI a-na ša-lim-be-lí dí-na
translation: In accordance with what I wrote you, give good, extra-fine textiles to Šalim-bēli.

transliteration: um-ma e-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šur-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ ú a-šur-SIG₅ x qí-bi₄-ma
translation: From Enna-Suen to Aššur-muttabbil and Aššur-damiq:

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na (d)UTU-ši na-áš-pé-er-tí ta-ša-me-a-ni a-na a-šur-SIG₅ qí-bi₄-ma
translation: My brothers, on the day you hear my missive, speak to Aššur-damiq:

transliteration: a-na ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ša a-ta ta-ni-iš-ú 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú 5 GÍN KÙ.KI a-na en-na-nim ú e-ni-ša-ru-um ku-nu-ki-a a-dí-in-ma a-na ṣé-ri-ku-nu na-ší
translation: In addition to the silver that you yourself are bringing, I have given 1.5 minas of silver and 5 shekels of gold to Ennānum and Eniš-Aššur, and they are bringing it to you under my seals.

transliteration: ú a-na-ku a-we-el gi₅-mì-lim
translation: And I am a man of favor.

transliteration: a-pu-tum i-ḫi-id-ma ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-a
translation: Please, pay attention and buy merchandise that makes me profit.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ru-a lá i-sà-ḫu-ur ṭur-da-ni-šu-nu
translation: My employees must not delay - send them to me!

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šur-(d)UTU-ši DUMU šu-IŠTAR KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU ku-sú-sà-ri-im
translation: Seal of Aššur-šamšī, son of Šu-Ištar, seal of Aššur-lamassī, seal of Dān-Aššur, son of Kususārum.

transliteration: x ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-lá-ma-sí la-ma-sà-tum tí-šu
translation: [x] mina of refined silver Aššur-lamassī owes to Lamassutum.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR ù ì-lí-ìš-ta-kál a-na 4 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
translation: From the week of Kurub-Ištar and Iliš-tikal he will pay in 4 months.

translation: Abuwa brings that to you.

transliteration: i-na u₄-mì-im ša e-ra-ba-ni a-na a-lim(ki) ṭù-ru-sú
translation: The very same day he arrives you must send him to the City.

transliteration: ṭup-pì lu-ša-ak-ší-id
translation: He shall conduct the case concerning my tablet.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu lá ta-be-i-il₅ dí-šu-um
translation: Do not deny him 10 shekels of silver for his expenses - give it to him.

transliteration: 15 ma-na URUDU a-na ší-bi₄ šé-ru-bi₄-im ù a-na ba-áb DINGIR šé-ru-dim áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid 15 minas of copper to have the witnesses brought here and led to the Gate of the God.

transliteration: 3 ma-na URUDU da-a-sú ša a-bu-a ša iš-tù kà-ni-ìš a-dí wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na áš-qú-ul
translation: 3 minas of copper, the fee for Abuwa for the stretch from Kanesh to Wahšušana, I paid.

transliteration: 2.5 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 2.5 minas of copper for his expenses.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 20.5 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-kà áš-qú-ul
translation: In all I have paid 20.5 minas of copper for him.

transliteration: 2.5 ma-na URUDU i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a iš-tí a-ša-at da-na-a
translation: 2.5 minas of copper is owed by Dannaya's wife in Wašhaniya.

transliteration: x x x ki a-ḫi a-ta
translation: My dear brother...

translation: ...the tin I left for you...

transliteration: x x x x x GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áp-ra-tim
translation: ...x shekels of silver, the sureties...

translation: To the merchant say, thus Adaya and Aššur-ṭāb:

translation: Adaya brought 4 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

transliteration: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ku-nu-ki-kà a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lam
translation: Aššur-ṭāb brought 5 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà
translation: Total: 9 minas of your silver.

translation: Thereof Aššur-ṭāb is bringing you 1 talent 54 minas of sealed tin.

translation: At the rate of 14.1666 to 1, its value in silver was 8 minas.

transliteration: 1 ANŠE ù ú-nu-sú 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
translation: 1 donkey and its harness cost 0.33333 mina of silver.

transliteration: … 4.5 GÍN wa-ṣí-tum
translation: ... 4.5 shekels for export tax.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-ṣú-bi a-šùr-DU₁₀ il₅-qé
translation: Aššur-ṭāb received additions of 2 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 4.5 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA qá-tim 14.16666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI 19 GÍN
translation: 4.5 minas 2 shekels of hand-tin at the rate of 14.1666 to 1, its price in silver was 19 shekels.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà gám-ra-kum
translation: Your silver has been spent for you.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šùr-e-mu-qí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
translation: Seal of Aššur-emūqī, seal of Ennam-Aššur, seal of Iddin-abum.

translation: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum [...]

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na a-lá-ak šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay refined silver before the arrival of Šu-Illil.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he has not paid, he will pay interest at the rate of 1.5 shekels per mina per month.

transliteration: ša a-šùr-ma-lik [...]
translation: Concerning Aššur-malik [...]

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-šùr-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Šalim-Ištar: to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur, specifically to Ennam-Aššur say:

translation: Dādaya and Ladiya brought 20 minas of silver under your seal.

translation: Ikūn-pīya son of Šu-Anum has received 8 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of the wool of Ušinalam.

translation: Witnessed by Iddin-Kūbum, by Uzub-iškum his brother, and by Enna-Suen.

translation: To Adida and Ali-ahum say, thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: 6 na-ru-qá-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-a i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im e-zi-ib
translation: I left 6 sacks with textiles under my seal in the store-room.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 12 TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅ 8 TÚG.ḪI.A tár-dí-ú-tim 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša uš-ma-a
translation: Among those were 12 good quality textiles, 8 second quality textiles, and 4 textiles belonging to Ušmaya.

transliteration: ṣú-ba-tí-a a-šar ša-ṣú-ru šu-uk-na
translation: Place my textiles where they will be under guard.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tim 21 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí
translation: I left with you 0.33333 mina 1 shekel of silver, the price of a textile, and 21 minas 10 shekels of silver.

transliteration: URUDU-ri-i a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma
translation: Sell my copper for silver.

transliteration: ú KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ku-un-kà-ma li-ib-ší
translation: And then seal the proceeds in silver from my textiles and let it remain.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫu-ša-ḫi-ku-nu lá tù-ma-na li-ib-ší
translation: Do not consider the silver for your own needs; let it remain intact.

transliteration: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ṣú-ba-tí-a a-na i-ṭá-at-lim i-ta-dí-na
translation: My dear brothers, as to the silver for my textiles, they should be sold for cash on delivery.

transliteration: ba-áb-tám lá a-ra-ší
translation: I shall not have any outstanding claims.

transliteration: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-be-lí DUMU ba-šu ḫa-bu-lu-ni-im i-na ba-ni-x-im
translation: Šalim-bēlī son of Bašu owes me 14 shekels of silver in ... .

transliteration: a-na šál-ma-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma (d)IM.GAL-ma
translation: To Šalim-Aššur say, thus says Adad-rabi:

transliteration: ṭup-pá-kà a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR a-šur-ma-lik šál-ma-a-šur iš-me-ú-ma
translation: Here, Šu-Ištar, Aššur-malik, and Šalim-Aššur heard your letter.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma a-wa-tum a-ni-tum a ma-lá ša ṭup-pì-šu ša i-iš-pu-ra-ni ke-na
translation: They said: "This matter is correct as he wrote in the letter he sent."

transliteration: i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni é-ta-ú
translation: Issu-arik spoke in our presence.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-IŠTAR a-wa-sú li-il₅-qé-ma a-na KÁ-áb DINGIR nu-NU-ri-id-ma ṭup-pá-am lu ni-dí-na-kum
translation: They said: "Let Šu-Ištar have his case," so we led him to the Gate of the God and gave you a tablet.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ša DUMU i-ba-a ú a-na ší-bi₄-kà kà-ra-am lá ša-a-lam a-ṣé-er ru-ba-im né-ru-ma
translation: Concerning the matter of Ibaya's son, and so as not to question the colony about your witnesses, we went to the prince.

transliteration: um-ma ru-ba-ú-um-ma be-el a-wa-tim li-li-kam-ma lá ta-ma-ḫa-ra
translation: The prince said: "Let the litigant come and do not confront the assembly."

transliteration: i-nu-mì DUMU i-ba-a i-lá-kà-ma a-lam i-ma-ḫu-ru-ni i-nu-mì-šu u₄-me er-ša
translation: When Ibaya's son arrives and they confront the City, at that time request terms.

transliteration: a-na ší-bi₄-ku-nu ta-e-ra-ma kà-ra-am lá ša-a-lam a-na a-lim(ki) ta-e-ra-ma
translation: Rebuff the matter with respect to your witnesses and turn back to the City so as not to ask questions of the colony.

transliteration: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-wi-lu-um be-el na-ru-qí-im ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am a-na ší-bi₄-šu kà-ra-am i-ša-al
translation: Then say: "The man will extradite the owner of the joint-stock capital; he will question the colony about his witnesses."

transliteration: i-nu-mì-šu a-lu-um i-da-na-ku-nu-tí
translation: Then the City will grant you the right to a case.

transliteration: me-at 56 TÚG 12 ma-na 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
translation: 156 textiles cost 12 minas 18 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 6 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me 0.83333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
translation: 6 black donkeys cost 55 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 30.33333 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 2.3
translation: 30.33333 minas of expense tin cost 2.3333 minas of silver.

transliteration: [...] KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
translation: ... Sealed by Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum.

transliteration: a-wa-tù-šu-nu ša šál-ma-a-šùr šu-bé-lam ki-ma DAM i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im
translation: Their case concerning Šalim-Aššur: Šu-Bēlum for the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik, and the daughter of Iddin-abum.

transliteration: ra-bi-ṣum ù šu-be-lúm KI ša-lim-a-šur ni-iš a-lim it-mu-ú-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu gám-ra
translation: The attorney and Šu-Bēlum swore an oath on the City with Šalim-Aššur and their case was concluded.

transliteration: a-na lu-qú-tim AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ša É a-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim i-pí-iq-du ša ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki)
translation: For the goods, the tin and textiles that have been entrusted in the house of Aššur-bēl-awātim in accordance with the verdict of the City.

transliteration: šu-ku-bu-um ù a-ḫu-šu i-lu-ku-nim-ma … x ša-lim-a-šùr a-na lu-qú-tim AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ša-lim-a-šùr ú-kà-nu-ni
translation: Šu-Kūbum and his brother will come and confirm the goods, the tin and textiles for Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku ra-bi-ṣú-um a-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim
translation: Aššur-taklāku was the attorney for these goods.

transliteration: šu-bé-lúm a-ša-at i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im a-na ša-lim-a-šùr šu-ku-bi-im ù a-ḫi-šu ú-lá i-tù-ru
translation: Šu-Bēlum, the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik, and the daughter of Iddin-abum must not raise claims against Šalim-Aššur, Šu-Kūbum, or his brother.

transliteration: šu-ma i-tù-ru šu-be-lúm ù ra-bi-ṣum ú-bu-bu-šu-nu
translation: If they do raise claims, Šu-Bēlum and the attorney will clear them.

translation: Say to Asqudum and Abila, thus says Iddin-Suen:

translation: To Aššur-massu’ī, Šu-Kūbum and Aluwa; specifically to Aššur-massu’ī from Ennam-Aššur:

translation: In addition to the 5 shekels of silver from Aššur-ṭāb plus the price of my textile that she put on, announce to Aluwa with Šu-Kūbum as witness how much you will add to the 5 shekels for the price of my textile, and give it, so it may come with Hudubēlī.

transliteration: ra-qá-tám SIG₅ iš-tí a-lu-wa šé-bi-lam
translation: Send me a fine thin textile with Aluwa.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma li-bi₄-ki lá i-lá-mì

translation: From Ennam-Aššur to Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: šu-ma ILLAT-at-kà i-sà-ri-dam ù a-ta qá-dí-ma ILLAT-tí-kà sí-ir-dam-ma lu-qú-tám ša DAM.GÀR ša ta-ra-dí-ú TÚG.HI.A SIG₅-tim bi-ir-ma i-na ma-a-ma ú-lá i-na ú-na-ap-sé e-zi-ib-ma ší-tí TÚG.HI.A ma-ṭí-ú-tim lu i-na ša DAM.GÀR i-ba-ší-ú lu ša bé-ú-lá-tí-kà ù-lu i-na ša bé-ú-lá-at ṣú-ha-re-e i-ba-ší-ú qá-dí-ma tap-pá-e-kà a-na É.GAL-lim le-ru-bu-nim
translation: If your caravan is being packed, then you too should pack together with your caravan, and choose textiles of good quality from the goods of the merchant that you are leading, and leave them in Mamma or in Unapse, and the rest of the less good textiles - both from what remains of the merchant's and from your own working capital and from the working capital of the servants - should enter the palace together with your partners.

transliteration: a-ni na-ab-ri-tum i-na ur-šu i-ṣa-ba-at-ku-nu
translation: Now, winter has caught you in Uršu.

transliteration: i-na na-áp-ṭí-ir ku-nu-tí ù a-na-ku ú-lá ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-a a-ṭa-ra-dam-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR a-ma-lik
translation: When you are released (from the cold), then I shall send either myself or someone I can rely on, and I shall take a decision about the merchant's goods.

transliteration: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma tì-ir-tí DAM.GÀR hi-mì-tum i-li-kam
translation: Why did you write, saying: "A heated letter from the merchant came."

transliteration: a-na-ku sà-ah-ra-ku-ma a-na lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR mì-li-ik-ša ma-lá-kam lá a-al-té-e
translation: I have personally been delayed and been unable to take any decision about the merchant's goods.

transliteration: ba-a-nim i-a-tí ta-ša-pá-ra-am
translation: Come on, it is to me you write!

transliteration: a-pu-t
translation: Urgent...

transliteration: en-um-a-šùr ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ù a-lá-ha-am e-pu-ul um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im-ma
translation: Ennam-Aššur answered the attorney and Ali-ahum, and Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum:

transliteration: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lá ni-ip-ta-ar
translation: We are the children of a dead man (inheritors); we have not divided (the estate).

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-bu-ni i-na a-lim(ki) lu-qú-tám ip-qí-da-ku-ni-ma x a-na ṣé-er ša-zu-za-tí-šu i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU a-šur-GAL i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a e-na-ah-DINGIR DUMU šu-a-šur i-a-tí ù ku-a-tí qá-dí-šu-nu-ma ù né-nu ša-zu-úz-tum ša šál-ma-a-šur a-bi-ni
translation: When our father in the City entrusted merchandise to you and (sent it) to his representatives - Iddin-abum son of Aššur-rabi, Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, Ennānum son of Amriya, Enah-ilī son of Šu-Aššur, myself and you together with them - we were the representation of Šalim-Aššur, our father.

transliteration: ù a-lá-an lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim ša šé-pì-kà mì-ma lu-qú-tám šál-ma-a-šùr ú-lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam
translation: Apart from this merchandise transported by you, Šalim-Aššur did not send any other merchandise.

transliteration: ma-lá lu-qú-tum a-ni-tám x ša a-ta tù-šé-li-a-ni-ma lu-qú-tum ší-it i-na É-šu-nu iz-ku-a-ni
translation: As much as these goods which you brought up and these goods were cleared in their house,

transliteration: li-bi ša-zu-úz-tí a-bi-ni ù li-bi-ni i-de₈
translation: the agents of our father and we know.

transliteration: ù me-he-er-ni a-na a-lim(ki) a-na ṣé-er a-bi-ni iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša lu-qú-tám tù-šé-li-a-ni i-li-ik-šu-ma i-na a-lim(ki) i-ba-ší
translation: Also our answer went to the City, to our father, the very day you brought the goods up here, and it is in the City.

transliteration: i-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim qá-tí ša-zu-za-at a-bi-ni i-ta-dí-nu ni-a-tí-ma
translation: A claim to these goods has been made against us by our father's agents.

transliteration: ma-lá lu-qú-tám i-a-tí i-šu-ru-ni-ni a-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-er-ma KÙ.BABBAR ší-im
translation: As for the goods they took care of for me, I converted them to silver, and the silver, the price...

transliteration: a-na šu-(d)DUMU.ZI e-lá-a a-dí-da lá-ma-sí ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
translation: To Šu-Tammuzī, Elaya, Adida, Lamassī and Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr ù a-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: thus Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

transliteration: i-na dur₄-hu-mì-it 40 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am bu-lá-tí ša a-bu-ni e-zi-bu um-me-a-nu ša a-bi₄-ni i-ṣa-áb-tù ù sí-ki-ni ú-kà-lu
translation: In Durhumit our father's investors have seized 40 talents of washed copper, assets that our father left; they also detain us.

transliteration: um-ma né-nu-ma a-lá-an URUDU a-nim mì-ma bu-lá-tí ša-ni-a-am a-bu-ni ú-lá e-zi-ib
translation: We said: "Apart from this copper our father left no other assets."

transliteration: URUDU a-na KÙ.BABBAR li-tù-ur-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim(ki) li-li-ik-ma lu-qú-tum iš-tù a-lim(ki) li-ba-al-ki-tám-ma KÙ.BABBAR x x šu-ta-be-a x x
translation: Have the copper converted to silver and let the silver go to the City, and then let goods be transported from the City so you may be paid in full in silver.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er 40 GÚ URUDU bu-lá-tí ša a-bi₄-ni ú-kà-lu-ni um-ma šu-nu-ma ù NA₄.ZA.GÌN ik-ri-bu ša a-bi₄-ku-nu … lu ni-sú-uh
translation: Not only do they hold the 40 talents of copper, our father's assets, but they say: "Let us also take away the lapis lazuli, your father's votive offering."

transliteration: a-ba-ú-ni be-lu-ni a-tù-nu a-we-lu NA₄.ZA.GÌN ik-ri-bi₄ ša a-bi₄-ni a-na e-ṭá-ri-ni i-za-zu
translation: Our dear fathers and lords, the men are ready to remove the lapis lazuli, our father's votive offering from us.

transliteration: ih-da-ma a-lam mu-ùh-ra-ma ma-lá ik-ri-bu ša a-šùr lá i-ha-li-qú-ni ep-ša-ma
translation: Take care to confront the City and act so that the votive offerings for Aššur are not lost;

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) le-qé-a-ma ki-ma NA₄.ZA.GÌN a-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ru-ma a-dí … ik-ri-bu … uš-té-ru-bu
translation: get a tablet from the City stating that the lapis lazuli must be converted to silver and until the votive offerings are brought in.

transliteration: ù ra-bi-ṣa-am ah-za-nim-ma KI a-
translation: Also, hire an attorney and...

transliteration: 25 TÚG i-ku-num DUMU DINGIR.ILLAT
translation: 25 textiles: Ikūnum son of Ilī-ellat;

transliteration: 23 TÚG i-sú-rik₁₃
translation: 23 textiles: Issu-arik;

transliteration: 20 TÚG bu-ut-qum
translation: 20 textiles: Butqum;

transliteration: 17 TÚG šu-la-ba-an DUMU a-mur-DINGIR
translation: 17 textiles: Šu-Laban son of Amur-ilī;

transliteration: 7 TÚG a-nu-um-ì-lí
translation: 7 textiles: Anum-ilī;

transliteration: 8 TÚG a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU pá-na-kà
translation: 8 textiles: Aššur-malik son of Panaka;

transliteration: 20 TÚG e-la-ma DUMU i-ku-nim
translation: 20 textiles: Elamma son of Ikūnum -

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 1 me-at 20 TÚG ILLAT-at i-ku-nim DUMU DINGIR.ILLAT
translation: in all 120 textiles in the caravan of Ikūnum son of Ilī-ellat.

translation: After the caravan of Puzur-ilī (has come) they will receive them.

translation: From Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur:

translation: 50 textiles, 25 minas of tin, 0.33333 mina 0.66666 shekel of silver, 2 black donkeys - all this you sent.

translation: 25 textiles were sold at 12 minas each,

translation: 55 minas was the price of your donkeys,

translation: 31 minas the price of the silver in Dan-Aššur's possession -

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN URUDU-i-kà 20 GÚ 24.66666 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um
translation: the total of your copper: 20 talents 24.66666 minas of washed copper.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 6 GÚ šu-nu-nu i pá-ni-tim ub-lá-kum
translation: Thereof Šu-Nūnu earlier brought you 6 talents;

transliteration: 8 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša-lim-wa-ardí ù šu-nu-nu ku-nu-ki-ni na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu bring you 8 talents of washed copper under our seals.

transliteration: 18 ma-na SIG₅ ša-du-a-at URUDU-i-kà ù ANŠE.HI-kà ni-iš-qúl
translation: 18 minas good copper we paid as the transport tariff on your copper and your donkeys;

transliteration: 2.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi₄ URUDU-i-kà ni-dí
translation: 2.5 minas of good copper we deposited out of your copper

transliteration: a-na ta-ší-a-at URUDU ša áb-ša-lim ù dan-a-šùr a-na áb-ša-lim ni-dí-in
translation: and gave to Ab-šalim for the carriage of Ab-šalim's and Dan-Aššur's copper.

transliteration: gám-ra-am ù ú-ku-ul-tám mì-ma ú-lá ni-dí-šu-nu-tí
translation: We did not give them anything for expenses and food.

transliteration: URUDU-a-kà x
translation: Your copper ...

transliteration: 6.5 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.GI pá-ša-lúm SIG₅ 10 GÍN.TA a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na šé-ep-IŠTAR ù lu-lu a-ḫa-ma
translation: 6.5 shekels 22.5 grains of pašallu-gold at the rate 1:10 in silver to Šēp-Ištar and Lullu, and further,

transliteration: 4 ANŠE ṣa-la-me ù ú-nu-sú-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
translation: 4 black donkeys and their harness I gave to them.

transliteration: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im IGI dan-a-šùr DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr
translation: Witnessed by Enna-Suen son of Idi-abum, witnessed by Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

transliteration: 5 na-ru-qá-tim a-ḫa-ma a-dí-šu-nu-tí
translation: 5 sacks, separately, I gave to them.

transliteration: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: na-áš-pár-tám ša a-šur-ma-lik gu₅-ba-áb-tám ša ma-ḫu-ra-at É ku-ra ša-áš-me-ma
translation: Make the priestess who lives opposite Kura's house hear the missive from Aššur-malik;

transliteration: ta-as-kà-ri-nam lu ta-dí-na-ší-ma
translation: also, do give her the boxwood log;

transliteration: a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám a-dí-na-ku-ni uq-ru-a-tim e-pu-uš-ma
translation: since I gave you a memorandum, make the jewelry

transliteration: na-áš-pár-tum ša a-we-lim lu ša É ub-ri-ni i-li-kam a-ma-kam ša-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
translation: and ask there whether the missive from the man or from our guest-house has come, and send it to me.

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta a tí-ir-tí-a i-ḫi-id
translation: My dear brother, pay heed to my message.

transliteration: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma
translation: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: šu-ma a-ni-ša-am ḫa-ra-kà al-kam-ma lu ni-iz-ku
translation: If your journey takes you here, then come and let us clear accounts.

transliteration: šu-ma sà-aḫ-ra-tí tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
translation: If you are delayed, then send word.

transliteration: a-mì-ša-am ḫa-ra-ni
translation: My journey will take me there.

transliteration: 1 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA šu-ku-bu-um iḫ-bu-lam
translation: For 1 mina 2 shekels of tin Šu-Kūbum became indebted to me.

transliteration: ta-aḫ-sí-is-tum a-ni-tum ar-ki-at
translation: This memo is a later one.

transliteration: x dan-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-ma-ḫi-im
translation: ... Dan-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum ...

transliteration: ANŠE ša ba-ri-ni ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
translation: Šalim-Aššur has taken a donkey owned by us both;

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i ra-mì-ni-šu x x x x-na 0.83333 … i-na x ku-ta-ni ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim ir-dí-a-ni
translation: he has 0.3333 mina of silver of his own funds. ... Of the textiles that Šu-Ištar son of Dadānum conducted here,

transliteration: 6 ku-ta-ni ki-ma šu a-tí pu-šu-ki-in i-dí-nam
translation: Pūšu-kēn has given me 6 textiles on his own.

transliteration: a-du-da ú šu-IŠTAR ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
translation: Aduda and Šu-Ištar sent them.

transliteration: a-na ir-ma-a-šur ù (d)UTU-ba-ni a-na ir-ma-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ir'am-Aššur and Šamaš-bāni, and in particular to Ir'am-Aššur, say as follows, thus Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 3 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i pá-ni-tim iš-tù ḫa-tim iš-tí šu-sú-en₆ ú-šé-bi-lá-ku-ma
translation: Previously I sent you 2 minas 57 shekels of silver from hattum with Šu-Suen

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-bi šu-ut i-lá-ak-ma iš-tù a-lim(ki) AN.NA 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-lá-ma li-ba-am i-da-nam
translation: and I thought: 'He is my father, he will go and send me from the City at least 10 minas of tin and thereby encourage me.

transliteration: ù KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a a-na ša ṭup-pì-a ú-šé-ba-al
translation: And when some silver becomes available for me I will then be able to send silver to my creditor on the basis of my tablet'.

transliteration: a-ta um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-at-kà ta-aḫ-ša-aḫ-ma a-na ša ṭup-pì-kà a-tí-dí-ší-im
translation: But you said: 'Your sister needed the silver, so I gave it to her on the basis of your tablet'.

transliteration: ur-ki-tim i ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-kà um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN i-šu qá-tí-kà dí-na-ma
translation: Later, when you were about to set out on a journey, you said: 'Give me every single shekel of silver you have available

transliteration: AN.NA 10 ma-na lá-áš-a-ma lu-šé-bi₄-lá-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR li-li-a-ku-ma li-ba-am ri-ší um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: then I will buy for you and send you tin, 10 minas, so that you can obtain silver and gather courage!'

transliteration: ù a-na TÚG.HI-tí-a a-na-aḫ-ma a-šar ša-la-ḫi-im šu-lu-ùḫ-šu-nu TÚG.HI-tù lá i-ḫa-li-qú
translation: You also said: 'You must also exert yourself for my textiles and salvage them as well as you can. The textiles must not get lost!'

transliteration: i-nu-mì ta-tal-ku lá tí-dí-e ki-ma ḫa-ra-na-tum ù É.GAL-lu da-nu-ni
translation: When you left, did you not know that the roads and the palaces were causing difficulties?

transliteration: a-dí TÚG.HI.A áš-lu-ḫu ITU.7.KAM i-na li-bi ma-tim as-ḫu-ur
translation: Until I had salvaged the textiles I stayed seven months in the interior.

transliteration: 3 TÚG.HI.A a gám-ri-im ša ḫa-ra-nim i-gi₅-im-ru-ma TÚG.
translation: Three textiles were spent for the expenses of the trip, but I managed to ship the textiles...

transliteration: a-na a-l-hi-im q-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum from Amur-Ištar:

transliteration: a-dí ḫu-ma ša áš-pu-ra-ku-ni u₄-mu-a ITU.1.KAM a-na a-wa-tim ta-da-nim a-ḫu-ru-ú
translation: Concerning huma about whom I wrote to you, my terms for starting a legal case have one month to run,

transliteration: ú me-éḫ-ra-am ša ší-bi-a ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-am
translation: but you keep sending me a copy of my witnessed tablet.

translation: Your message should - on the very day you hear my missive - your message should come.

translation: Azu must not be delayed a single day! - your message should come!

translation: If it is a matter of engaging in a legal case, I shall do it!

transliteration: šu-ma É-tám kà-ba-sà-am lá-ak-bu-us
translation: If it is a matter of remitting the house, I shall do it!

transliteration: a-wa-tim a-ni-na i-de₈ a-ma-kam a-ni-na ša-i-il₅
translation: Annina knows the matter. Ask Annina there!

translation: 4 talents 30 minas of black copper is deposited in the house of Aššuruš-tikal son of hinnaya.

translation: Send me word about the orders that he holds.

translation: Elamma and Galdaya settled accounts

translation: with the result that after both travel expenses and his food allowance have been deducted,

translation: Elamma has a claim of 1 mina of refined silver on Galdaya.

translation: From the week of Amriya and Ikūnum he will add 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

translation: Month VII, year-eponymy of Abiya, son of Šu-Dagan.

translation: We made them swear an oath by the City for these words.

translation: Witnessed by Šalim-Adad, witnessed by La-qēpum, witnessed by Amur-Šamaš, witnessed by Eze.

translation: Separately, there still exists a valid record of his working capital.

translation: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

translation: Travellers reached us at Buhitar(?) and I questioned them concerning the son of Sadaya.

translation: ... the City ... they went to the City and ... they will bind ... for 6 months ... Šalim-Aššur ... they came ... Sadaya ...

translation: Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb have paid 56 minas of silver from Aššur-idī's silver to Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: um-ma la-qé-ep ù en-nam-a-šùr-ma ke-na i-na ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU šu-lá-áb-ra-at KÙ.BABBAR ni-il₅-qé
translation: Lā-qēp and Ennam-Aššur answered: "Yes, we took the silver in the week of Puzur-Ištar son of Šu-Ilabrat.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR eq-lam a-šu-mì en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL e-tí-iq
translation: The silver goes overland (to Assur) in the name of Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil,

transliteration: ù a-na bi-it-qá-tim en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-za-az
translation: and Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil answers for (possible) shortfalls."

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr-ma DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li ša i-tur₄-DINGIR ú kà-ku-a ma-nu-um i-da-nam
translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil said: "And the tablet concerning the debt to Itūr-ilī and Kakkuwa, who will give me that?"

transliteration: um-ma la-qé-ep-ma a-na-ku a-da-na-kum
translation: Lā-qēp answered: "I shall personally give it to you."

transliteration: um-ma la-qé-ep-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-a-tí
translation: Lā-qēp (further) said to Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil: "You have been paid the silver.

transliteration: 2 ṭup-pé-e ḫa-ar-me-en ša ḫu-bu-lim a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-ḫi-a tù-kà-al
translation: You have in your possession 2 certified tablets concerning the debt of my brother Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: lu ku-a-um lu ša DUMU kà-ri-a ma-nu-um lu i-da-nam
translation: Yours as well as that of Karriya's son, who will give that to me?"

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL a-na-ku a-da-na-kum
translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil answered: "I shall personally give it to you."

transliteration: IGI a-la-bi-im DUMU sú-li-a IGI ki-li-a DUMU en-na-nim
translation: Witnessed by Ali-abum son of Suliya, by Kiliya son of Ennānum.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-d
translation: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: KIŠIB … KIŠIB … a-na …
translation: Seal of ... seal of ... to ...

transliteration: ù ša-li-ma a-ša-at ir-ma-a-šur
translation: and Shalima, wife of Irma-Ashur.

transliteration: um-ma a-kà-dí-a-ma a-na a-šur-ma-lik qí-bí₄-ma
translation: From Akkadiya to Aššur-malik:

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-ša-tám ta-ḫu-zu
translation: Why have you taken a wife in marriage?

transliteration: a-na-ku a-na-kam a-bu-ša al-le
translation: As for me, should I handle(?) her father here?

transliteration: a-bu-ša ú-ba-ša-am
translation: Her father shames me;

transliteration: a-šé-pé-šu mu-qú-ut
translation: fall at his feet

transliteration: ú kà-bi-sú
translation: and honour him.

transliteration: ra-qá-tám dí-šum
translation: Give him a thin textile.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN ḫu-sà-ri-im ù 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša šu-be-lim ù a-lu-a ub-lu-ni-ku-ni
translation: 0.5 mina 3 shekels of lapis lazuli plus 4 textiles that Šu-Bēlum and Aluwa brought to you,

transliteration: me-eḫ-ra-tim KÙ.BABBAR i-na ra-mì-ni-kà dí-in-ma
translation: give the corresponding amount in silver yourself,

transliteration: iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-a ku-nu-ki-kà šé-bi-lam
translation: and send it with my servants under your seal.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ru-a ú-ma-kāl lá i-bí₄-tù
translation: My servants must not delay a single day,

transliteration: ṭur₄-da-šunu
translation: send them.

transliteration: a-dí URUDU ša ma-zi ša i-na É kà-ri-im aṣ-bu-tù-ma
translation: Concerning the copper ... that I seized in the office of the colony

transliteration: a-na a-lu-lá-a ù pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ú-ša-zi-zu
translation: and let stand for Alulaya and Pilah-Ištar -

transliteration: šu-ma URUDU i-na É kà-ri-im i-zu-zu
translation: if the copper stands in the office of the colony,

transliteration: ma-lá qá-sú ku-zi-zi-a i-kà-šu-du
translation: then let Kuziziya receive the copper in the office of the colony as much as he can acquire,

transliteration: URUDU i-na É kà-ri-im li-im-ḫur-ma
translation: let him receive the copper in the office of the colony,

transliteration: URUDU-li-ik-nu-uk
translation: let him seal the copper

transliteration: ú iš-té-en i ba-ri-ku-nu li-ib-ší
translation: and then let it remain with one of you.

transliteration: tí-ir-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam-ma
translation: Let your report come to me

transliteration: za-ku-sà lá-áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí
translation: and I shall send you the final report.

transliteration: um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bí₄-ma
translation: From Pilah-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: a-na 6.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na DAM.GÀR ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni a-na-kam-ma tù-na-ḫi-da-ni
translation: Here you instructed me about the 6.83333 minas of silver that I owe to the merchant,

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ma-qú-tá-ku-ni a-na ša-nim lá tù-pá-na
translation: and you said: "Whatever silver falls to you, do not set that aside to any other person;

transliteration: a-na a-lu-lā-a ki-ma DAM.GÀR šu-qú-ul
translation: pay it to Alulaya on behalf of the merchant."

transliteration: 15 u₄-me lá i-li-ik KÙ.BABBAR im-qú-ta-ma
translation: Before 15 days had gone by silver fell into my hands,

transliteration: a-lu-lá-a a-na-kam lá-šu-ma
translation: but Alulaya was not here,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim i ku-nu-ki-šu i-ba-ší
translation: so the silver remains to this day under his seal.

transliteration: a-dí ší-ni-šu ú 3 šál-ší-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-kum
translation: 2 or 3 times I have sent word to you,

transliteration: ú i pí-a tí-ra-tim áš-ta-pá-ra-kum
translation: and I have sent you oral messages,

transliteration: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí-kà-ma li-bí₄-ší
translation: and you answered: "Let the silver remain in your possession."

transliteration: li-ba-kà lu i-de₈ ki-ma iš-tù 4 ITU.KAM KÙ.BABBAR a šu-mì-kà kà-ṣú-du
translation: You certainly know that the silver has been held up for 4 months in your name.

transliteration: u₄-ra-ni a-ta-lá-ak
translation: Tomorrow I shall leave.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a ša ki-ma i-a-tí e-zi-ib
translation: I have left the silver with my representative."

transliteration: a-na a-šùr-ma-lik ší-ša-ra IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù a-šùr-dan qí-bí-ma
translation: To Aššur-malik, Šišara, Ištar-lamassī and Aššur-dan

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
translation: from Šalim-Aššur:

transliteration: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a ... na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: ... brings you 10 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, under my seal.

transliteration: x ... ṭup-pá-am x x x ... ú-lá né-pá-áš tí ... x x x x x x ...
translation: ... a tablet ...

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 0.5 ma-na ... x-3 na-ru-uq ŠE-am-... ú GIG
translation: further, I personally gave him 0.5 mina ..., x+3 sacks of barley and wheat,

transliteration: 1 SÌLA Ì.GIŠ sà-ar-dam i ra-mì-ni-a a-dí-šu-um
translation: and 1 litre of olive oil.

transliteration: um-ma a-tí-na-ma ḫa-ra-ni x ...
translation: You (fem. pl.) said: ... a journey ..."

transliteration: a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ú-ṭá-tám ša-ma-ni-ma
translation: Buy grain for this silver

transliteration: a-na É e-ri-šu-... lá e-ra-ba-am
translation: but it must not enter the house of Erišum(?).

transliteration: ... ù i-na a-lá-ki-a ... ú-ṭá-tat-ki-na lu-ta-e-ra-ki-na-tí
translation: Also, when I come I shall return your grain to you (fem. pl.).

transliteration: tí-ir-ta-ku-nu da-mì-iq-tám i-na pá-ni-a li-li-kam-ma
translation: Send me a positive message ahead of my departure

transliteration: li-ba-am di-na-nim
translation: and cheer me up! "

transliteration: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bí-ma um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur from Amur-Ištar:

transliteration: a-na-kam ... a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar a-li-kum kà-lá
translation: Here (...) the traveling party has been stopped on the way to Šalatuwar.

transliteration: i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na wa-áš-ba-ku
translation: I am staying in Wahšušana.

transliteration: a-dí a-wa-tum ša ša-lá-tù-wa-ar i-za-ku-a-ni
translation: Until the matter of Šalatuwar has been cleared up,

transliteration: wa-ša-na-lam a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar wa-ṣí
translation: Wašanalam has left for Šalatuwar.

transliteration: tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a-šar ma-lá-ki-im mì-il₅-kà-ni
translation: Send me word and decide what there is to decide for me.

transliteration: šu-ma a-wa-tum i-za-ku-wa a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà e-ra-áb
translation: If the matter is cleared up, I shall enter in accordance with your instructions.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 15 ma-na 10 GÍN lu ša AN.NA ú ṣú-ba-tí-kà ku-nu-ki-ni ṣí-li-a na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Total of your silver: 15 minas 10 shekels, Șilliya brings you under our seal - both that from the tin and that from your textiles.

transliteration: i-na ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu ša e-lá-ma um-ma pí-lá-ah-a-šùr-ma a-na e-lá-ma-ma
translation: When Elamma was about to set out on a journey Pilah-Aššur said to Elamma:

transliteration: lá-qé-ep DUMU i-li-a ku-nu-im AN.NA a-na 70 ha-am-ša-tim ú-kà-lam
translation: "Lā-qēp, the son of Iliya, who belongs to you(r firm), offers me tin with a credit term of 70 weeks."

transliteration: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma i-a-am AN.NA-ki le-qé-ma gi₅-im-lá-ni a-na 20 ha-am-ša-tim 8 GÍN.TA lá ta-ba-ta-qám
translation: Elamma answered: "Take my own tin and do me a favor by giving me (for it) not less than 8 shekels per (shekel of silver) in 20 weeks."

transliteration: um-ma pí-lá-ah-a-šur-ma 8 GÍN.TA AN.NA a-lá-qé-ma a-ta-BA mì-nam ta-da-nam
translation: Pilah-Aššur said: "I will take the tin at the rate of 8 shekels, but you, what will you give me?"

transliteration: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ú a-na-ku iš-tù a-lim(ki) i-na tù-a-ri-a 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-da-na-kum
translation: Elamma answered: "And I, when I return from the City I will give you 15 minas of silver."

transliteration: a-na a-lim(ki) tù-šé-ba-al ší-a-ma-tim i-ša-ú-mu-ni-kum ta-be-el-šu
translation: "You will send it to the City and one will make (with it) purchases for you, it will be at your disposal."

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dín
translation: Before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

transliteration: i-na ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu ša e-lá-ma um-ma pí-lá-ah-a-šùr-ma 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú a-dí-na-kum
translation: When Elamma was about to set out on a journey Pilah-Aššur said: "I gave you 15 minas of refined silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid for."

transliteration: a-na a-lim(ki) i-na e-ra-bi-kà-ma 1 GÚ AN.NA ša-ma-am ú a ší-tí KÙ-pì-a TÚG.HI.A ša-ma-am iš-tí ANŠE-ri-kà pá-ni-im šé-bi₄-lam
translation: "When you enter the City you must buy for me 1 talent of tin and for the rest of my silver buy textiles for me, send them to me with your next donkey transport."

transliteration: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: Elamma answered: "I will send them to you".

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-nu-nu DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR KIŠIB zi-ki-ki DUMU a-šur-SIPA KIŠIB a-bu-ša-lim DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
translation: Seal of Šu-Nūnu son of Amur-Ištar, seal of Zikiki son of Aššur-rē'ī, seal of Abu-šalim son of Puzur-Ištar.

transliteration: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-bu-ša-lim i-ri-šum i-šu
translation: Abu-šalim owes 6 shekels of refined silver to Irišum.

transliteration: a-na bu-qú-nim i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay at the shearing.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 0.16666 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he has not paid, he will add 1/6 shekel per month.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šur-e-mu-qí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šùr DUMU me-na-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
translation: Seal of Aššur-emūqī, seal of Ennam-Aššur s. of Menaya, seal of Iddin-abum.

transliteration: ša hu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi₄-im 13.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um
translation: Concerning Iddin-abum's debt of 13.3333 minas of refined silver.

transliteration: u₄-mu-šu ma-al-ú
translation: His term has expired.

transliteration: ša a-mur-IŠTAR
translation: Concerning Amur-Ištar.

transliteration: um-ma a-dí-da-ma ú a-lá-hu-um-ma a-na lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma
translation: From Adida and Ali-ahum to Lamassī:

transliteration: mì-šu ša iš-tù ša-na-at ú ší-ta ša-na-at ni-iš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni-ma ú tí-ir-tám ša É a-bi-ni kà-ša-dam ú-lá ta-le-e-a-ni
translation: Why is it that although we have been writing for both one and two years, yet you are not able to reach a solution to the affair of our father's house?

transliteration: ú šu-ma ša-zu-za-tum ša i-na ša-ha-tí-ki i-za-zu-nu ú a-na té-er-tí-ni ú-lá i-na-hi-du ša-ni-ú-tum ša ki-ma šu-nu-tí ú-lá i-ba-ší-ú
translation: And if the agents who support you pay no attention to our messages, are there no others instead of them?

transliteration: iš-tù 3 ša-na-tim en-um-a-šùr lu me-et
translation: It is in fact 3 years since Ennam-Aššur died.

transliteration: a-na-kam i-tur₄-DINGIR i-na ba-áb kà-ri-im ki-ma né-ši-im pá-ri-ik-ma ú-lá ni-le-e-ma ší-bi
translation: Here Itūr-ilī blocks the gate of the colony like a lion and we are incapable of setting witnesses.

transliteration: a-na i-sú-ri-ik qí-bi-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šùr-ma
translation: To Issu-arik from Šalim-Aššur:

transliteration: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú i-na li-bi lu-qú-tí-kà ša šé-ep pu-šu-ki-in ili₅-ba-ni ub-lá-kum
translation: Ilī-bāni brought you 15 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, from your goods transported by Pūšu-kēn.

transliteration: AN.NA-kà ša i-ri-šum ú a-bu-ša-lim ir-de₈-ú-ni-ni e-ri-qá-tum … a-na ma-lá … tí-ir-tí-kà a-na bu-ur-uš-ha-dim ú-šé-ru-bu-ma
translation: Your tin that Irišum and Abu-šalim conducted here, ... wagons in accordance with your orders they will bring it into Burušhaddum.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-ul-tí en-nam-a-šùr … x x x x x lim … ṣú-ha-ar-tim me-er-a-at-kà KI ma-áš-kà-tí-a ú-šé-ra-a-ku-um ú lu-qú-at-kà ú-za-kà-a
translation: And 10 shekels of silver, the consignment of Ennam-Aššur ... of the girl, your daughter, I shall have conducted to you together with my deposits and then I shall clear your goods.

transliteration: um-ma ma-ma-hi-ir-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: From Man-mahir to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: AN.NA ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ni a-lu-lá-a ú a-mur-IŠTAR 15.5 ma-na AN.NA x-am-ku-nim
translation: As to the tin you sent me, Alulaya and Amur-Ištar ... 15.5 minas of tin.

transliteration: ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà 2 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a šé-ep-IŠTAR ú šé-lu-um-ar-dí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: The proceeds of your tin, 2 minas 12.5 shekels of silver, Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī are bringing that to you under my seal.

transliteration: ú a-ni a-lá-hum iš-pu-ra-am um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: Also, now Ali-ahum wrote to me, saying:

transliteration: šu-ma i-na ša a-bi₄ i-dí-na-ku-ni mì-ma i li-bi₄-kà i-ší-a-at a-na a-hi-a lá tù-ša-ar
translation: "If any of what my father gave to you remains in your possession, do not release it to my brother."

transliteration: šu-ma tù-ta-šé-er a-na-ku ú a-ha-tí a-na a-wa-tim ni-šé-e-kà
translation: "If you release it, then I and my sister will sue you in the matter."

transliteration: ú ša ki-ma šu-wa-tí ší-bi₄ i-iš-ku-nu-nim
translation: Also, his representatives have set witnesses against me.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-hi-im ú a-ni-na qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum and Annina from Aššur-malik:

transliteration: 8.66666 ma-na KÙ ku-nu-ki-a ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr DUMU a-ta-ta na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Atata brings you 8.6666 minas of silver under my seal.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-dí a-lá-kà-ni a-šar a-lá-hi-im li-ib-ší
translation: The silver should remain with Ali-ahum until I arrive.

transliteration: [...] x x bi-ri i ar-za-lam qá-áb-li-tám ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣú-ba-tám ša ki-ma x i-na hu-lu-ni … a-na pá-ni-šu-nu lu-ub-lu-nim
translation: ... an arzālu, a qablītu worth 1 mina of silver, a textile ... they should bring to them.

transliteration: ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu ša a-šur-na-da a-šur-na-da DUMU ah-ša-lim ú a-bi₄-ì-lí ni-kà-sí i-sí-ú-ma
translation: When Aššur-nādā was about to leave on a journey Aššur-nādā, son of Ah-šalim, and Abī-ilī settled accounts as follows:

transliteration: iš-tù a-lim(ki) i-na e-lá-i-šu 15 ma-na AN.NA a-šur-na-da a-na a-bi₄-ì-lí i-da-an-ma 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá i-ba-ta-aq-šum
translation: When he comes up from the City Aššur-nādā will give 15 minas of tin to Abī-ilī, who will pay him not less than 2 minas of silver.

transliteration: ra xx i-na li-bi₄ a-bi₄-ì-lí a-šur-na-da ú-lā i-šu-ú
translation: Abī-ilī does not owe anything to Aššur-nādā.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-ah-šu-ša-na i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur tup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tí-a a-dín
translation: For these words the Wahšušana colony gave us and before Aššur's dagger I gave the tablet with my testimony.

transliteration: sí-li-IŠTAR tap-pá-i
translation: Șilli-Ištar was my fellow witness.

transliteration: ra-bi-ባa-um ša E šal-ma-a-šr a-ba-ba iባ-ba-at-ni-a-ti-ma a-na en-um-a-šr  a-la-ሧi-im -ቡa-ሧi-ni-a-ti-ma
translation: The attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ababa, seized us and made us approach Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum.

transliteration: i-na ቡup-pi-im ša a-lim(ki) mi-ma šal-ma-a-šr e-zi-bu -pa-ሧa-ar-ma a-na a-lim(ki) -ba-al
translation: According to the tablet of the City, I shall collect all that Šalim-Aššur left behind and bring it to the City.

transliteration: lu ba-ab-tam a-bu-ku-nu e-zi-ib lu mi-ma e-zi-bu ba-a-nim k`-li-ma-ni-ma
translation: Come, show me either the outstanding claims your father left or anything he left behind.

transliteration: i-ša-ሧa-ti-ku-nu la-zi-iz-ma lu-še-ru-ku-nu-ti-ma  a-na a-lim(ki) lu ni-lik
