transliteration: 4 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí (d)IM-ba-ni ir-dí-a-ni
translation: 4 talents of sealed tin of Aššur-imittī, Adad-bāni brought to me.

transliteration: nu-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma 4 GÚ 6 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA ni-is-ni-iq
translation: We checked it and we checked 4 talents 6 minas 5 shekels of tin.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.83333 ma-na ni-is-Ḧba-at AN.NA-ki-šu a-na É kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
translation: From it, we gave 5/6 mina as the import-tax of his tin to the office of the colony.

transliteration: IGI en-na-a-šùr DUMU a-ni-nim
translation: Witnessed by Enna-Aššur son of Anninum.

transliteration: IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU ú-zu-a
translation: Witnessed by Ennum-Aššur son of Uzua.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA AN.NA 2 GÚ 2 0.5 ma-na ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
translation: From that tin, Šalim-Aššur took 2 talents 2.5 minas.

transliteration: 41 ma-na 11.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma šu-a-tí ú ku-nu-ki-a 3 né-pí-šu a-Ḧba-ma
translation: 41 minas 11.5 shekels of refined silver, sealed by his representatives and by me - in 3 packages; further.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-sú mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-nu-nu ù ì-lí-áš-ra-ni áp-qí-id-ma a-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-lim(ki) ub-lu
translation: 0.6666 mina 1 shekel of silver, its transport tariff - all this I entrusted to Šu-Nūnu and Ilī-ašrannī, and they brought it to Šalim-Aššur in the City.

transliteration: a-Ḧba-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
translation: Furthermore, I gave them 5 shekels of silver for their food.

transliteration: IGI a-Ḧbu-wa-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR IGI ba-zi-a DUMU DINGIR-ku-ru-ub IGI a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU qàr-da-a
translation: Witnessed by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar, by Baziya son of Ilī-kurub, by Aššur-taklāku son of Qardaya.

transliteration: a-Ḧba-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a be-a-li-im a-na šu-nu-nu
translation: Furthermore, I gave 10 shekels of silver as a working-capital to Šu-Nūnu.

transliteration: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ma-aḦá-ri-šu-nu-ma a-dí-in
translation: And 7 shekels of silver to Ilī-ašrannī witnessed by the same men.

transliteration: KIŠIB sú-en-na-da DUMU e-nam-a-šùr
translation: Seal of Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
translation: The Kanesh colony gave me for these proceedings and I gave my testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šur-i-dí ù i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-na-da tap-pá-ú-a
translation: Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī and Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-nādā were my (absent) partners.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí DAM ku-ni-li a-na lá-ma-sà-tim DAM e-lá-ma té-zi-ib
translation: 37 shekels of silver and 2 1/4 shekels of gold Ištar-lamassī, wife of Kū-ilum, left to Lamassutum, wife of Elamma.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ú KÙ.KI a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-šùr-dan ú šu-mì-a-bi₄-a DUMU a-mu-a lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma x ú en-nam-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma i ša-Ḧba-at um-mì-šu i-zi-iz-ma ip-qí-du
translation: That silver and gold Lamassutum, wife of Elamma, attended by Elamma's son Ennam-Aššur, entrusted to Ennam-Aššur, son of Aššur-dān, and Šumi-abiya, son of Amua.

transliteration: IGI PÚZUR-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a IGI a-mur-DINGIR DUMU šu-ku-bi-im IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí DUMU bu-zu-zu IGI PÚZUR.IŠTAR DUMU šu-ku-bi-im
translation: In the presence of Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikū-pīya, of Amur-ilī, son of Šu-Kūbum, of Maṣi-ilī, son of Buzuzu, of Puzur-Ištar, son of Šu-Kūbum.

transliteration: a-na en-na-nim DUMU a-bi₄-a ú a-lá-Ḧba-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šùr
translation: To Ennānum son of Abiya and Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur
translation: Seal of Puzur-Aššur.

transliteration: 13.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-šu
translation: Iddin-abum owes 13.3333 minas of refined silver to Amur-Ištar.

transliteration: IGI a-šur-e-mu-qí IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-na-a
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-emūqi, by Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya.

transliteration: 25 áb-na-tum iš-tí e-na-aḦba-DINGIR
translation: 25 stones owed by Enah-ilī.

transliteration: 40 áb-na-tum iš-tí ku-ša-ra-a
translation: 40 stones owed by Kušaraya.

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-lá-Ḧba-um-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur from Ali-ahum.

transliteration: a-Ḧba-i a-ta a-ma-kam iš-tù a-wa-tù-um i-ba-tù-qú-ni tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà le-pu-uš
translation: My dear brother, send me word there after the matter has been dropped, then I shall act in accordance with your instructions.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er ANŠE a-ni-ú-tim 3 ANŠE ù ṣú-Ḧba-ri šé-ri-a
translation: Dispatch 3 donkeys and servants in addition to these donkeys.

transliteration: a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà le-pu-uš
translation: I shall act in accordance with your instructions.

transliteration: a-al-DU₁₀ a-na a-mur-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-mur-a-šur-ma
translation: Āl-ṭāb seized us against Amur-Aššur and Āl-ṭāb said to Amur-Aššur:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ù šu-IŠTAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am lá qá-bi-a-tù-nu
translation: "Have you and Šu-Ištar not promised to pay each half of the silver?

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma ke-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am qá-bi-a-ni-ma
translation: Amur-Aššur answered: "True, we have promised to pay each half of the silver

transliteration: ù i-né-ma-li ša-li-iš-tám ša-tim áš-du-na-da i-zu-a-az
translation: and also that he would receive as a share one third of the profit

transliteration: ù a-na i-bi-sà-e ša-li-iš-tám i-za-az
translation: and that he also would be responsible for one third of the losses".

transliteration: IGI a-ta-tí-a IGI a-ḥu-wa-qar IGI a-šur-(d)UTU
translation: In the presence of Atatiya, of Ahu-waqar, of Aššur-šamšī.

transliteration: a-šu-mì sú-bi-ri-im ša ip-ṭí-re
translation: Concerning the Subaraean, of the ransom.

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bu-ša-lim DUMU PÚZUR.IŠTAR
translation: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver, the working capital of Abu-šalim, son of Puzur-Ištar;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša ku-nu-uk PÚZUR-a-šur a-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá i-tù-ar
translation: a tablet with Puzur-Aššur's seal, he will not come back on 10 shekels of silver;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bi-a-a DUMU ú-zu-a
translation: a tablet about 0.3333 mina of silver, the working capital of Abiaya, son of Uzua;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša DINGIR-ma-lik DUMU a-de₈-lá-at
translation: a tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ilī-mālik, son of Adad-ellat;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na-sú-in DUMU za-ar-ni-qí-im ša be-ú-lá-tí-šu
translation: a tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Zarniqum, of his working capital;

transliteration: ù Ṭup-pu-um ša 13.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša e-nam-sú-in DUMU a-lá-bi-im
translation: and a tablet of 13.1666 shekel of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Ali-abum;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-qí-pí-im DUMU a-gu₅-a
translation: a tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Laqēpum, son of Agua;

transliteration: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-lá-ḥi-im ù DUMU ku-zi-zi-a
translation: a letter of Ali-ahum and the son of Kuziziya;

transliteration: Ṭup-pu-um ša 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-ma-a
translation: a tablet of 0.5 mina of silver of Šumaya.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 Ṭup-pu-ú i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-im ša i-ša-sú-ú ta-ba-ku-tum
translation: In all 9 tablets in a tablet box, to be read and thrown away.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḥi-im ù i-ku-pí-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma um-ma za-li-dí-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur from Zalidi:

transliteration: 0.83333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ù 0.5 ma-na a-ḥa-ma a-mu-ra-am a-na šu-a-šùr DUMU i-dí-a-šùr ḥa-bu-lá-ku
translation: I owe 53 shekels of refined silver plus a further 0.5 mina of checked silver to Šu-Aššur son of Iddin-Aššur.

transliteration: Ṭup-pá-am ša 4 x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR xx-ma a-na a-bi₄-ni ḥa-bu-lu a-na ša-pár-tim ú-kà-al
translation: The tablet concerning 4 minas of silver which the agent owes to our father, he holds as security.

transliteration: be-lí a-ta KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šùr šu-qú-ul-ma Ṭup-pì šé-ṣí-ma iš-tí-kà li-ib-ší-ú
translation: My dear lord, pay the silver to Šu-Aššur, get out my tablet and let it be with you.

transliteration: ù té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá-at-bi₄-a-ma lá-tal-kam
translation: Also, send me word so I can set out and leave.

transliteration: ù a-dí Ṭup-pì-im ša (d)UTU-ba-ni a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu ni-gi₅-ri-ma
translation: Also, with respect to Šamaš-bāni's tablet we sued both once and twice,

transliteration: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí Ṭup-pá-am ta-da-nam lá i-mu-ú
translation: but your representatives refuse to give the tablet.

transliteration: té-er-ta-kà a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma
translation: Send word to your representatives.

transliteration: 1 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḥa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
translation: 1 mina 14 shekels of silver, the excise on it extra, the transport fee for it paid;

transliteration: a-ḥa-ma 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḥa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bu ku-nu-ki ša DAM.GÀR
translation: separately 0.5 mina of silver, the excise on it extra, the transport fee for it paid, temple funds, under the seals of the agent,

transliteration: en-um-a-šur a-na ir-ma-a-šur ip-qí-id-ma a-na a-lim(ki) a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-bi-il₅
translation: Ennam-Aššur entrusted to Ir'am-Aššur and he brought it to the City for making purchases.

transliteration: IGI a-zu-ta-a DUMU e-me-me IGI ì-dí-ba-ni DUMU ir-ma-a-šur
translation: In the presence of Azutāya, son of Ememê, of Idi-bāni, son of Ir'am-Aššur.

transliteration: 3 na-áš-pè-ra-tum ša ku-nu-uk sà-ak-li-a x x a x x x UD i-na a-lim IGI ma-x-im IGI-x x-na ṭá-á-btim ša-ak-na
translation: 3 missives sealed by Sakliya placed in the City with Ma... and others as witnesses.

transliteration: i-na x x x za ḥa-x x bi … x ba-li x x x 0.16666 GÍN 1 x x x-ki a-ni áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid 10 shekels of silver in the presence of witnesses.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša um-ma-ša a-na me-er-i-tí-ša i ba-áb-tim té-zi-bu a-na ḥu-bu-ul a-na a-ḥe-ša a-tù-nu ta-lá-qé-a
translation: The silver that her mother left to her daughter as part of the outstanding claims, do you want to take it for the debt, for her brothers?

transliteration: ni-zi-iz-ma i-na a-wa-tim ni-bu-šu-nu-ma iš-tù gám-ru-um
translation: We took action and rebutted them by our argumentation.

transliteration: ù ša a-na bi-ki-tim ša um-mì-ki ù a-ḥi-ki iṣ-ḥe-ru ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI
translation: After the expenses made for the bewailing of your mother and your brothers had been deducted, the rest of the silver was 37 shekels of silver and 2 1/4 shekels of gold,

transliteration: ku-nu-ki ša en-um-a-šùr ù šu-mì-a-bi-a a-na en-um-DINGIR DUMU ḥa-da-a i-na pu-ùḥ-ri-ni ni-ip-qí-id-ma na-áš-a-ki-im
translation: under the seals of Ennam-Aššur and Šumi-abiya we together entrusted to Ennam-ilī, the son of Hadāya, and he is on his way to you with it.

transliteration: i-na ŠÀ.BA KÙ.BABBAR ri-ik-sí-im 2.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ì-lí-a ni-is-ḥa-tum ša a-šùr na-ad-a
translation: In the packet of silver 2 1/4 shekels of silver of Iliya, excise for Aššur, have been put.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí a-na É li-mì-im dí-ni
translation: Give that silver to the office of the limmum.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-um É e-lá-ma ib-ší
translation: This silver was in Elamma's house.

transliteration: 2 ṣí-il₅-a-nu ša ṭup-pé-e ku-nu-ku ša a-ḥe-ki ù um-mì-ki i-ba-ší-ú
translation: There are still two containers with tablets sealed by your brothers and mother.

transliteration: pá-al-ḥa-ni-ma pá-ṭá-ra-am ú-lá ni-mu-wa
translation: We did not dare to open them because we were afraid.

transliteration: lá ta-áš-ta-na-me-i ki-ma um-mì-ki iš-tù 10 ša-na-tim nu-a-um aḥ-zu-ma i-na É nu-a-im wa-áš-ba-at-ni
translation: Have you not heard that the Anatolian is since ten years married to your mother and that she lived in the house of the Anatolian?

transliteration: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ma-dí-im mì-ma lá ta-da-gi₅-li
translation: Do by no means expect much silver,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-mì-um ù KI-kam um-mì-ki
translation: there is only the afore-mentioned silver and the seal of your mother.

transliteration: iš-tù ḥa-mu-uš-tim ša a-lá-ḥi-im ù bu-sí-a i-ša na-ra-am-ZU ù i-ku-nim KÙ.BABBAR ni-iš-qúl
translation: Reckoned from the week eponymy of Ali-ahum and Buṣiya we paid the silver during that of Naram-Suen and Ikūnum.

transliteration: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-na ṣé-er ú-na-bi₄ ù a-ší-a-at lu-zi i-šu
translation: Unabi and Ašiat owe 15 minas of washed copper, weighed with our stones, to Luzi.

transliteration: iš-tù ḥa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mu-ru-um-ba-ni ú a-šur-na-da a-na 4 ḥa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
translation: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: If they have not paid in time, they must add interest according to the rule of the colony.

transliteration: i-na pu-ru-uš-ḥa-dim URUDU-am i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They must pay the copper in Purušhaddum.

transliteration: ITU.KAM ḥu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bu-um
translation: Month Hubur, eponymy Iddin-abum.

transliteration: IGI i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR
translation: Witnessed by Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḥi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum from Zukuwa:

transliteration: lá-ma a-li-kà-ni AN.NA-kà ta-dí-in
translation: Before I came your tin was sold.

transliteration: šu-qú-ul-tí AN.NA-ki-kà 1 GÚ 30 ma-na 0.5 ma-na mu-ṭá-e i-šku-nu
translation: The weight of your tin was 1 talent 30 minas; 0.5 mina they established as losses.

transliteration: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí áš-a-al-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma ke-e AN.NA ta-dí-na-šu
translation: I questioned your representatives, saying: "How did you sell the tin?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma 8 LÁ 22.5 ŠE GÍN.TA ta-dí-in
translation: They answered: "It was sold at the rate 8 minus 22.5 grains."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ṣa-ba-at-ma 11.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN ší-tí an-ni-ki-kà
translation: Seize the silver, 11 1/3 minas 2 shekels was the rest for your tin.

transliteration: lá-ma a-li-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-áš-qú-ul
translation: Before I arrived you had not been paid the silver;

transliteration: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša a-li-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-ki-ni i-ba-ší
translation: the day I arrived I had the silver paid and the silver is under our seals.

transliteration: ki-ma i-na a-li-ki DUMU um-me-a-nim ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na na-áš-ú lá-šu-ma a ší-a-tí KÙ.BABBAR ni-ik-lá
translation: Since there is no affiliated trader among the travellers who can be responsible for some 10 minas of silver, for that reason we held the silver back.

transliteration: li-ba-kà mì-ma lá tù-la-ma-an
translation: Do not get angry.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR na-dí
translation: The silver is ready.

transliteration: a-dí 5 u₄-me-e šu-ḥu-bur wa-ṣa-a-am qá-bi
translation: Within 5 days Šu-Hubur has promised to leave.

transliteration: iš-tí šu-ḥu-bur KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà nu-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: We shall send you your silver with Šu-Hubur.

transliteration: i-na ša ṭup-pí-šu ḥa-ar-mì-im šu-ku-tám 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-ma
translation: I made Šukkutum pay 4 minas of silver from what was in his certified tablet.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà x lu ší-im AN.NA xxxxx we-du-um xxxxx ša šu-ki-tim iš-té-ni-iš 15 ma-na 11 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu
translation: Total of your silver, from the proceeds of the tin and from Šukkutum, in all Šu-Hubur will bring you 15 minas 11 shekels under our seals.

transliteration: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na a-li-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus the Kanesh colony, say to the travelers:

transliteration: a-na-kam sú-en₆-SIG₅ im-ḥu-ur-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: Here Suen-damiq has appealed to us and he said:

transliteration: li-ip-ta-num DUMU qar-da-a ú-ta-ra-am a-na ta-ú-ri-šu ma-aṣ-a-ku
translation: "I want Liptānum, son of Qardaya, to be brought back; I take responsibility for bringing him back".

transliteration: DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr ší-pár-ni
translation: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur is our messenger.

transliteration: iš-tí DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr li-tù-ra-am
translation: He must come back with Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur.

transliteration: a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq-šu
translation: You must be his executive force.

transliteration: a-na ì-lí-e-mu-qí šu-ta-mu-zi a-bi₄-a-a e-lá-a ù lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma um-ma a-dí-da ù a-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: To Ilī-emūqī, Šu-Tammuzi, Abiya, Elaya and Lamassī from Adida and Ali-ahum:

transliteration: iš-tù ša-lim-a-šur me-tù-ú DAM.GÀR-ru-ú ša a-bi₄-ni ša a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ša ha-bu-lu-ni i-a-tí ù en-um-a-šur lá-am-ni-iš e-pu-šu-ni-a-tí-ma sí-ku-ni ù ba-a-ba-tù-ni ṣa-bu-ta-ma a-tù-nu ta-áš-me-a-ma a-na a-lim(ki) ta-lí-kà-ma a-lu-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma um-ma
translation: After Šalim-Aššur died, our father's customers to whom he owed silver there treated me and Ennam-Aššur badly, we were detained and our outstanding claims blocked, and you heard about it and went to the City assembly, and the City gave a verdict as follows:

transliteration: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-a-šur i-na eq-lim ha-bu-ul i-na tup-pì-šu ù ší-bi₄-šu i-ku-an-ma i-na sá-bi-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu i-lá-qé

translation: from the capital of your father Enah-ilī, also for the silver under your seal, we have ... and we have booked 1.5 mina of silver.

translation: As to the three slaves that you gave to Šalim-bēlī, of them one slave has been taken as security because of the man of Katila.

translation: They bring you 16 minas of tin.

translation: From Man-mahir to Ali-ahum: Inform me

translation: 5 minas ... of silver, its transport tariff paid,

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
translation: if he does not pay he will add in accordance with the regulation of the colony an interest of 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

transliteration: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU i-dí-(d)IM KIŠIB a-mur-a-šur DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim KIŠIB en-um-a-šur ŠEŠ-šu KIŠIB i-ku-pì-a-šur DUMU ḫi-na-a
translation: Seal of Puzur-Anna, son of Iddin-Adad, seal of Āmur-Aššur, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, seal of Ennam-Aššur, his brother, seal of Ikūn-pī-Aššur, son of Hinnāya.

transliteration: 5 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am i-ṣé-er a-mur-a-šur DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ù en-um-a-šur a-ḫi-šu li-ip-it-IŠTAR i-šu
translation: 5 talents of refined copper Āmur-Aššur, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, and Ennam-Aššur, his brother, owe to Lipit-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na MU.5.ŠÈ i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They will pay in 5 years;

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: when they do not pay they will add 1.5 mina per (talent) per month as interest.

transliteration: i-ku-pì-a-šur DUMU ḫi-na-a qá-ta-tum
translation: Ikūn-pī-Aššur, son of Hinnāya, is guarantor.

transliteration: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
translation: Month VII, eponymy year of Buzutaya.

transliteration: šalim-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: Šalim-Aššur seized us and said:

transliteration: a-na šu-bé-lim ù en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÚ ù 2 GÚ a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu i-na na-ru-qí-a ú-ša-qí-il₅
translation: To Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen: "I have paid some 1 or 2 talents of silver for your father's debt out of my joint-stock capital.

transliteration: ba-a-nim ṭup-pé-e ša ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu am-ra-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí šu-uq-lá-nim
translation: Come on, look at the tablets concerning your father's debt and pay me my silver."

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu ú ma-aḫ-ru-ú ša a-bi-ni i-na ku-nu-uk šu-(d)EN.LÍL a-mur-IŠTAR ù šu-a-nim kà-an-ku-ma i-na a-lim(ki) i-ba-ší-ú
translation: They said: "Our father's tablets and copies were sealed with the seals of Šu-Illil, Amur-Ištar and Šu-Anum, and they are in the City.

transliteration: šu-ma-ba i li-bi a-bi-ni ta-áb-tù-ra-am šál-ma-am i-na a-lim(ki) la-qá-am la ta-mu-a
translation: If indeed you can establish anything as owed by our father, will you refuse to take the full amount in the City?"

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim KÙ.BABBAR ša GÁN-lim a-na-ku pá-ḫu-ra-am qá-bi-a-ku
translation: Šalim-Aššur answered Šu-Bēlum: "I have personally promised to collect the silver that is abroad.

transliteration: mì-šum iš-tí DUMU da-da KÙ.BABBAR i ḫa-ḫi-im tal-qé
translation: Why have you taken silver from Dada's son in hahhum?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na al-qé
translation: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I took it."

transliteration: ù en-na-sú-in iš-a-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-šú-ú i tí-me-el-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
translation: So he asked Enna-Suen, saying: "Why have you taken silver in Timel-kiya?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma al-qé a-da-gal-šu lá i-ba-ší
translation: He answered: "I shall look whether I took any, but there is nothing."

transliteration: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-li-im IGI šu-ku-bi-im IGI a-šùr-i-mì-t
translation: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lalum, by Šu-Kūbum, by Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: a-na na-áb-sú-in en-um-a-šur ZU-re-i ú a-šur-iš-tí-kál qí-bi₄-ma um-ma iš-ma-a-šur-ma
translation: Say to Nab-Suen, Ennam-Aššur, Suen-rē'ī, and Aššur-ištikal, thus Išme-Aššur:

transliteration: áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí um-ma a-na-ku-ma DAM ḫa-lá-bi₄-im me-at
translation: I wrote you as follows: 'The wife of hali-abum is dead.

transliteration: mì-ma té-zi-bu pá-ḫi-ra-ma a-na ḫu-ur-ší-im iš-té-en šé-ri-ba-ma ki-ma i-a-tí ku-un-kà
translation: Collect everything she left behind and bring it into one single storeroom and seal it in my name'.

transliteration: áš-ta-na-me-ma ma-ma-na am-tám a-na a-ḫa-zi-im i-za-az
translation: I hear by rumor that somebody intends to marry the maid.

transliteration: ša-i-lá-ma lu DUMU a-šur lu nu-a-um ší-be-e šu-uk-na-šú-um
translation: Make inquiries and whether it is an Assyrian or an Anatolian, set witnesses against him.

transliteration: lá e-ḫa-sí mì-ma té-zi-bu lu ba-áb-tám ṣa-bi₄-sí
translation: He shall not marry her! Seize everything she left behind, also outstanding claims.

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-iḫ-da x a-wi-lum KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ta-ba-al
translation: Please, my brothers, take care, (for) the man may take along a lot of silver.

transliteration: bu-lá-tí-a šar-ší-a-ni
translation: Make me obtain my assets!"

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur KIŠIB MAN-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
translation: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur; seal of Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan.

transliteration: i-na-sú-in dan-a-šur e-pu-ul
translation: Enna-Suen answered Dan-Aššur.

transliteration: um-ma i-na-sú-in a-na dan-a-šur-ma me-er me-tim a-na-ku
translation: Enna-Suen said to Dan-Aššur: I am an heir.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am tù-kà-li-mì-ma i-na ṭup-pì-im ša 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-kà-li-mì-ni šu-mì a-bi₄-kà PÚZUR-a-šur ú-lá ú-du
translation: You have shown me a tablet and in the tablet concerning 12 minas of silver that you have shown me the name of your father Puzur-Aššur was not indicated,

transliteration: ú šu-mì ma-ma-na ú-lá ú-du-ú … lá tù-ba-a-ra-ni
translation: nor was anybody's name indicated. You do not provide proof for me.

transliteration: lu a-ni-a-ma me-er-e me-tim a-na-ku a-ḫe-e ma-du-tim i-šu-ú
translation: May it be like this: I am the heir. I have many brothers.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am lu ni-il₅-qé-ma šu-ma a-bu-kà PÚZUR-a-šur i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-bi₄-a i-šu-ú
translation: Let us take the tablet and if your father Puzur-Aššur had any claim on my father Iddin-abum,

transliteration: a-ṣé-er ku-nu-uk a-bi-a ù a-na-ku lá+lá-… qá-dí a-ḫe-a-ma a-na-ku-ma a-za-za-ku-um
translation: then on top of my father's seal I too shall ... I shall personally stand up for you together with my brothers.

transliteration: ší-bi₄-kà lá-aṣ-ba-at-ma
translation: I shall seize your witnesses."

transliteration: a-na a-šur-ni-im-ri ù a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur KIŠIB šu-zu-zu DUMU a-šur-SIPA
translation: To Aššur-nimrī and Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur; Seal of Šu-Zuzu son of Aššur-rē'ī.

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ma-lá-ba en-na-sú-in i-šu
translation: 15 shekels of refined silver Malaba owes to Ennam-Suen.

transliteration: iš-tù ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um šu-da-a DUMU en-na-nim a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša
translation: From month VI, eponymy of Šudaya, son of Ennānum he will pay within 3 weeks.

transliteration: šu-ma DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-na ma-lá-ba i-tù-ru en-na-sú-in ú-ba-áb-šu
translation: If the sons of Aššur-ṭāb raise a claim against Malaba Ennam-Suen will clear him.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šùr IGI a-šùr-du-gu₅-ul
translation: Before Puzur-Aššur, before Aššur-dugul.

transliteration: a-na ì-lí-e-mu-qí šu-ta-mu-zi a-bi-a-a e-lá-a ù lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma um-ma a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
translation: To Ilī-emūqī, Šu-Tammuzi, Abiya, Elaya and Lamassī from Adida and Ali-ahum:

transliteration: 3.33333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-lí-a a-dí-im
translation: Šalim-Aššur invested 3.3333 minas of gold in Aššur-ištikal son of Sukkalliya.

transliteration: ša-lim-a-šur i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šù um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na šu-ta-mu-zi a-dí-da ù e-lá-a-ma a-ḫu-a-tù-nu
translation: When Šalim-Aššur was about to leave he said to Šu-Tammuzi, Adida and Elaya: My dear brothers,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na li-mì-im a-mur-a-šur ḫa-bu-lá-ku
translation: I owe silver to the eponym Amur-Aššur.

transliteration: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-šur-iš-tí-kál en-na-nim ù ḫa-na-a qá-tí li-mì-im a-mur-a-šur ù qá-at-ku-nu šu-uk-na
translation: Lay claim on behalf of the eponym Amur-Aššur and of yourselves to the tablet concerning Aššur-ištikal, Ennānum and Hannaya;

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù né-ma-al-šù li-iš-qú-lu-ma li-ma-am a-mur-a-šur ṭá-i-ba-a
translation: they should pay the silver and the accrued profit and then satisfy the eponym Amur-Aššur.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a li-zi-iz
translation: The rest of the silver should stand available for my customers."

transliteration: a-na-kam a-šur-iš-tí-kál ú ì-lí-e-mu-qí ni-ṣa-na-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma 3.33333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šur x x x x x
translation: We keep seizing Aššur-ištikal and Ilī-emūqī here, saying: "Šalim-Aššur has invested 3.33333 minas of gold ..."

transliteration: a-na šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a a-šùr-ma-sú-wi ù en-um-a-šùr a-na a-šur-ma-sú-wi qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
translation: To Šu-Tammuzi, Elaya, Aššur-massuʾī and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Aššur-massuʾī from Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: a-na-kam a-dí 5-ší-šu ù iš-ri-šu ta-áp-nu-a-ma um-ma a-ta-ma a-ḫi a-ta i-na qá-tim e-ri-tim lá wa-áš-ba-ku-ma lá a-ḫa-li-iq
translation: Here you confronted me five or ten times, and you said: My dear brother, let me not stay with empty hands and perish!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú e-li-iš dí-na-ma e-en₆ a-šur ù e-en₆ a-ḫa-tí-a kà-li-mì-ma ú a-dí ba-al-ṭá-ku-ni ú-lá a-ma-ší-kà
translation: Give me at least 2 minas of silver, preferably more, show me Aššur's eye and the eye of my sister, then as long as I live I shall never forget you."

transliteration: ke-na a-wa-tum ša IGI a-šur ù i-li a-ba-e-ni ta-ta-ma-a-ni-ni
translation: Yes, these were the words you swore to me before Aššur and our fathers' god.

transliteration: i-na ku-ur-ṣí-im áp-ṭù-ur-ma ú i-a-tí iš-tí ṣa-bi-im 5 ú e-li-iš tù-uš-ta-ar-ší-a-ni-ma
translation: I released you from your bonds, but then it was me you made to suffer with 5 men or more,

transliteration: a-ma um-me-a-ni a-bi-a sí-ki ú-kà-lu-ú a-na É-bé-tí-kà ú-lá ú-ta-ší-ru-ni
translation: and now, my father's investors detain me! They have not granted me access to your house.

transliteration: ša a-dí bé-tí-kà KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-na-ku-ni-ma e-ni-kà áp-té-ú a-ta té-ta-áp-ša-ni-ni
translation: While I gave you silver for your house and opened your eyes, you have done this to me!

transliteration: DINGIR-lúm lu i-de₈ ša i-na ú-ṭí-i-tim e-ṭí-ru-kà-ni a-ta gi-mì-li tù-ta-er
translation: May the god know that I saved you from darkness and you repaid me thus!

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im tí-il₅-tí-tí-iš ù me-er-i-tí-ša a ší-tí ta-dí-na-kum
translation: Moreover, my wife gave you 1 mina of silver as the price of Tiltitiš and her daughter, but you refused to let Tiltitiš be installed in my house.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a ba-zi-a
translation: 2 minas of silver for Baziya;

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša dan-a-šur
translation: 1 mina of silver with the interest on it of Dān-Aššur;

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR É kà-ri-im
translation: 1 mina of silver of the colonial office;

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR wa-wa-li a-šur-i-mì-tí
translation: 0.5 mina of silver Wawali (and) Aššur-imittī -

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 2.5 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ir-ma-a-šur i-lá-qé
translation: Of this Ir'am-Aššur will take 2 minas 30.5 shekels of silver.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim a-na ir-ma-a-šur e-zi-ib
translation: All this I left to Ir'am-Aššur,

transliteration: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim IGI sà-ba-sí-a
translation: in the presence of Šu-Ištar, son of Dadānum, and of Sabasiya.

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur and Al-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu té-er-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí
translation: Once or twice I have sent word to you.

transliteration: i-na ṣú-ba-tí ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-hu-tum i-ba-ší-ú
translation: Among the textiles belonging to the merchant there are some old textiles.

transliteration: i-hi-id-ma x-x mì-li-ik ṣú-ba-tim mì-il₅-kà
translation: Pay attention and take a decision concerning the textiles.

transliteration: 1 TÚG SIG₅ a-lu-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Aluwa is bringing you 1 fine textile.

transliteration: a-ma-kam iš-tí ší-im AN.NA-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ma gi-im-lá-ni
translation: There you should send me silver together with the proceeds from my tin, thus doing me a favour.

transliteration: a-na 17 ku-ta-ni ša i-na ba-at-na ha-al-qú-ni 1.3333300000000001 ma-na.TA AN.NA ILLAT-tum ú-ma-li-ni-a-tí
translation: For the 17 textiles that were lost in Batna, the caravan paid us a compensation of 1.3333 mina of tin per person.

transliteration: ša la-qá-im ku-ra il₅-ta-qé
translation: Kura has successively obtained what he was entitled to.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-tí-šu ku-ra i-na a-lim(ki) il₅-qé
translation: Kura has received 0.3333 mina of silver, his working capital, in the City.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-šu a-šur-ma-lik ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
translation: And 0.5 mina of silver Aššur-mālik sent to him en route.

transliteration: i-na lu-qú-tim ša šé-ep kur-ub-IŠTAR 2 GÚ AN.NA ú li-wi-sú 15 ku-ta-ni 2 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-me kur-ub-IŠTAR ip-qí-dam
translation: Of the merchandise shipped under Kurub-Ištar's responsibility, Kurub-Ištar entrusted to me 2 talents of tin with its wrapping, 15 textiles, and 2 black donkeys.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 1 šu-uq-lam ip-ṭur₄-ma 11 ma-na AN.NA il₅-té-qé
translation: Of this load he has broken the seals of one packet and has taken 11 minas of tin.

transliteration: lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šùr a-dí-in
translation: I gave (it) to Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur.

transliteration: a-ša-me-ma ma-áš-kà-tù-šu ú-šé-bi-lam
translation: I hear that he sent his deposit.

transliteration: a-ma-kam DUMU PUZUR₄-ša-du-e ša-lá-ma lu KÙ.BABBAR ša-al-ṭam lu ší-im pí-ri-kà-ni ú-šé-bi-lam
translation: Ask the son of Puzur-šadu’e there whether he sent ready cash or the proceeds from the pirikannu-textiles.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni i ku-nu-ki-šu-ma i qá-tí am-tí-a li-ib-ší
translation: What silver he sent should remain in the hands of my maid under his own seal.

transliteration: a-ma-kam GÉME ú e-wa-ri-mu-ša na-hi-da-ma ba-áb-tí lu-pá-hi-ru-ma
translation: instruct the maid and Ewarimuša there to collect my outstanding claims.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá tù-šé-ṣa-a-ni-ni i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu a-dí a-lá-kà-ni i be-tí-a li-ib-ší
translation: And the silver you produce should remain in my house under your seals until I arrive.

transliteration: ú ṣú-ha-ri-a na-hi-da-ma ú-ṭá-tám ú e-ṣí lu-pá-hi-ru-nim
translation: Also, instruct my servants to gather grain and firewood.

transliteration: ú-ṭá-tám lu ŠE-am lu GIG ša ú-šé-ru-bu-ni-ni-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR am-tum lu ta-ta-dí-in-ma
translation: The maid should sell for silver the grain, whether barley or wheat, that they bring in.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR É-tí-ša li-ib-ší a-dí a-lá-kà-ni
translation: The silver should remain in her house until I come.

transliteration: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí …
translation: 12 shekels of silver is owed by PN.

transliteration: 6 e-ri-qá-tum iš-tí a-ší-ú-ma-an
translation: 6 wagons are owed by Aši-uman.

transliteration: a-hu-a a-tù-nu ba-áb-tí za-ki-a
translation: My dear brothers, clear my outstanding claims.

transliteration: 14 … ma-na x 8.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA TÚG.HI.A ù ANŠE.HI.A
translation: 14 minas [x] + 8.6666 shekels of silver is the price of tin, textiles and donkeys.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na bé-a-lim a-na šu-nu-nu
translation: 10 shekels of refined silver for working capital for Šu-Nūnu;

transliteration: 1 GÍN a-na ni-qí-šu
translation: 1 shekel for his sacrifice;

transliteration: 7 GÍN a-na i-lá-áš-ra-ni ÌR-ni
translation: 7 shekels for Ilī-ašrannī our slave(?);

transliteration: 2 GÍN a ni-qí-šu a-na šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim
translation: 2 shekels for his sacrifice to Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum;

transliteration: 1.5 GÍN a-na ili₅-ba-ni
translation: 1.5 shekel for Ilī-bāni;

transliteration: 1.5 GÍN a-na a-šur-la-ma-sí DUMU ša-ba-ha-nim
translation: 1.5 shekel for Aššur-lamassī son of Šabahānum;

transliteration: 1 GÍN a-na a-ra-ší-ha-tal
translation: 1 shekel for Arašihatal;

transliteration: 1 GÍN a-na a-bu-ša-lim
translation: 1 shekel for Abu-šalim;

transliteration: x i-x … [...] x x x x x x a x x na x x x ri-im x x-a-na x x x ki-a x x ni a-na tí-da … a-ha-ma
translation: ... for Tida ... further:

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-šur-DU₁₀ i-na-na e-hu-zu
translation: when Aššur-ṭāb married Inanna,

transliteration: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na am-tí-šu
translation: 1.5 shekel of silver for his maid;

transliteration: 1 GÍN a-na ša lá-qé-pí-im
translation: 1 shekel for the maid of Lā-qēpum;

transliteration: 3 GÍN i-nu-mì DUMU e-lá-ma e-hu-zu a ma-ha-tí-ni a-dí-in
translation: 3 shekels when the son of Elamma married, I gave to our aunt.

transliteration: a-na MAR.TU-ba-ni en-na-nim ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ku-ku-wa-ma
translation: To Amurrum-bāni, Ennānum and Ennam-Aššur from Kukuwa:

transliteration: a-na-kam ha-ra-ni a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: Here I would set out on a journey and come,

transliteration: i-dí-IŠTAR ù (d)IM-ṣú-lu-li im-ṣí-ú-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam-ma iští KÙ.BABBAR a-nim lu ší-pí-ir-šu
translation: Send me silver and let him be the messenger coming with that silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR e-lá tù-šé-bi-lam-ma li-ba-kà ú li-bi-i e im-ra-aṣ
translation: Do not fail to send silver lest both you and I will regret it!

transliteration: ḫa-nu-ba a-na-kam ú-ta-za-am um-ma šu-ut-ma a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tám ša ku-li-a a-ša-me-ú a-ma-kam a-ma-tim lá ú-šar
translation: Here Hanuba keeps complaining, saying: 'Until I hear from Kuliya I will not release the slave-girls over there.'

transliteration: um-ma a-ḫu-qar ú a-šùr-iš-tí-kál-ma
translation: thus Ahu-waqar and Aššuriš-tikal:

transliteration: a-na-kam šu-be-lúm ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
translation: Here we seized Šu-Bēlum and

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am me-eḫ-ra-am ša lá-qé-ep nu-ša-áš-me-šu-ma um-ma né-nu-ma ší-bu-ta-kà dí-in
translation: we made him listen to the copy of Lā-qēp's tablet and we said to him: 'Give your testimony!'

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma ištù pá-na-ma a-na pí-lá-aḫ-a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-di-in
translation: He answered: 'Some time ago I already gave my testimony to Pilah-Aššur.'

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim(ki) ša-ak-šu-dam lá qá-bi
translation: no promise has been made to deliver the silver to the City.

transliteration: né-ru-ub-ma me-eḫ-re ša ba-áb DINGIR ša ší-bu-tí-šu ša a-na pì-lá-aḫ-a-šùr i-dí-nu ni-iš-me
translation: We entered and listened to the text of the copies of his testimony drawn up in the gate of the god, that he had given to Pilah-Aššur.

transliteration: lá-qí-ip tap-pá-i a-ma me-eḫ-ri ší-me a-ma-kam ma-lá-kà
translation: Lā-qēp was my companion. Here is my copy, listen to it; it is up to you there.

transliteration: a-na-kam ib-ni-lí DUMU a-šùr-(d)UTU-ši wa-ar-kà-sú nu-ša-il₅-ma
translation: Here we questioned Ibni-ilī, son of Aššur-šamšī, about his record and

transliteration: ú e-ba-ru-uš-šu ku-ni-lúm ú i-dí-IŠTAR nu-ša-il₅-ma
translation: we also questioned his friends, Kūn-ilum and Iddin-Ištar, and

transliteration: eṭ-lu-um ke-en₆ ú wa-ar-kà-tám i-šu
translation: the result was: The man is reliable and has a good record.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ar-tám ta-da-nam lá ta-da-nam té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
translation: Let your instruction come to me whether the girl must be given or not.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-nu-mì ma-nu-ba-al-ma-a-šur a-ša-sú e-hu-zu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 2 shekels of silver when Mannum-balum-Aššur married his wife.

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR li-tí SIG₅ i-ṣé-er wa-al-hi-iš-na pé-ru-wa ù tù-wa-tù-ú-i a-ší-tí-šu lá-ma-sà-tum tí-šu
translation: 15 shekels of refined silver Walhišna, Peruwa and Tuwatuwi, his wife, owe to Lamassutum.

transliteration: ištù ha-mu-uš-tim ša i-na-a a-na ša pá-ar-kà i-ša-qú-lu
translation: Reckoned from the week of Innāya, they will pay not later than the festival of Parka.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: If they do not pay they will add interest at a rate of 1.5 shekels.

transliteration: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí
translation: Month XII, eponymy of Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ra-ki-is
translation: They are jointly liable for the silver.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na u₄-me-šu-nu lá iš-ta-aq-lu tù-wa-tù-wi ú-šé-ṣa
translation: Should they not pay when their term is due, then I will take away Tuwatuwi.

transliteration: x IGI ša-ar-ni-ga-a-šu IGI e-na-a-šur
translation: In the presence of Šarnigāšu, and of Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-mur-a-šur i-dí-a-bu-um i-šu
translation: Half a mina of refined silver Amur-Aššur owes to Iddin-abum.

transliteration: 1 GU₄.HI.A ša-lá-nam ša ma-ra-e-em i-da-an
translation: One ox for fattening he will deliver.

transliteration: IGI ku-sí-lá-nim IGI a-šur-lá-ma-sí
translation: Before Kusilānum, before Aššur-lamassī.

transliteration: 2 maš-ki ša-pá-tim ṣa-ru-pu-tim ha-bu-ul
translation: He also owes two colored woolen fleeces.

transliteration: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
translation: To my representatives, from Puzur-Aššur:

transliteration: a ma-lá tí-ir-tim ša zu-ku-a a-hi-iṭ-ma ištù 3 ITU.KAM ší-mì ga-me-er
translation: In accordance with the message from Zukua I have checked and my purchases were concluded 3 months ago.

transliteration: URUDU lá-mu-num 20 GÚ i-ba-ší-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma 10 GÍN-šu lá-ak-bu-ús-ma ha-ra-ni lá-ta-lá-ak
translation: About 20 talents of poor copper are here, so I said: 'Let me remit 10 shekels on it and then leave on a journey.'

transliteration: URUDU lá-ma-dam ú-kà-in
translation: I confirmed being aware of the copper.

transliteration: a-na 30 ma-na URUDU TA ú-kà-in
translation: I confirmed for 30 minas of copper each.

transliteration: a-na 1 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU a-na ar-nim kà-ru-um i-dí-ni
translation: The colony imposed a penalty on me of 1 talent 30 minas of copper.

transliteration: i-šé-pá-tí-šu-nu mì-ta-qú-tim ù ip-ra-am a-qá-qá-dí-a ší-ta-pu-ki-im 45 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé-ú-ma ša pì-lá-tim e-pu-uš-ma i ša-am-ší x ša tup-pu-um lá-pu-ta-ku-ni ha-ra-ni a-ta-lá-ak
translation: By constantly falling at their feet and constantly pouring dust on my head they have taken 45 minas of good copper on my account and I have made ... and on the very day the letter is written I shall leave on a journey.

transliteration: ki-ma ú-ku-ul-tí e-ma-ri da-na-at-ni ù we-da-ku-ni-ma ma-ma-an iští-a lá-šu-ú e-ma-ri a ší-mì-im … a-tí-dí-in … ma-lá … áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma 13 ma-na AN.NA ša a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU na-ra-am-ZU a-dí-nu ša-áš-qí-il₅
translation: Since fodder for the donkeys is hard to acquire and I am alone with no one staying with me, I have offered the donkeys for sale ... I wrote you, saying: 'Have the 13 minas of tin that I gave to Ennam-Aššur son of Narām-Sîn paid.'

transliteration: um-ma a-lu-lá-a ú a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: From Alulaya and Amur-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: na-áš-pé-er-tám ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-a-tí
translation: You have sent us a missive.

transliteration: ki-ma a-we-lu ma-du-tum lá-pu-tù-ni na-áš-pè-er-tám lá nu-ša-áš-me-ma ni-ip-nu-šu-ma um-ma né-nu-ma i li-bi-kà-ma x ra ší um i-ba-ší ú na-áš-pé-er-tí-kà a-ṣé-er a-we-lim li-li-ik
translation: Since many men were noted down, we have not let anyone hear the missive, but we confronted him and said: '... is in your possession and let your missive go to the man.'

transliteration: na-áš-pè-er-tám x x x lá i-mu-a
translation: He refused to ... the missive.

transliteration: um-ma né-nu-ma na-áš-pé-er-tám x li-tám IGI be x x a-mur ma lá i-li-bi₄-x i-ba ma kà i x na-áš-pé-er-tí-ni za-ku-tum a-ṣé-er en-um-a-šur li-li-ik
translation: We then said: 'The missive ... witnessed by ... our final clear missive shall go to Ennam-Aššur.'

transliteration: 16.83333 ma-na NA₄.ZA.GÌN 20 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am 30 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-nam mì-ma a-nim IGI a-lu-lá-a ú ar-ší-ah ú-kà-in
translation: 16.83333 minas of lapis lazuli, 20 talents 50 minas of washed copper and 30 talents of bad copper - all this he confirmed with Alulaya and Aršiah as witnesses.

transliteration: a-dí a-ni-tim a-mur-IŠTAR KÙ.BABBAR-ma ri-iš tí-ir-tí-ku-nu ú-kà-al
translation: Concerning this Amur-Ištar keeps the silver in accordance with your instructions.

transliteration: um-ma né-nu-ma ma-ma-an i-na um-me-a-ni-ku-nu lu tí x tám
translation: We said: 'Who among your investors ...?'

transliteration: i-na ša-am-ší ša tup-pì-ni ta-ša-me-ú qá-qá-dí-kà ki-a-ma x x a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: The very day you hear our letter ... your head in this way and come.

transliteration: i-x-x lá ša ša-lá-at tup-x x x-ma en-um-a-šur li-li-kam-ma iští a x a ú a lá ša ša ki ú 2.5 ma-na.TA x x-šu-ni ki-am x
translation: Ennam-Aššur should come and with ... and ... at 2.5 minas each ...

transliteration: a-na šu-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ba ma-ta-ga-x ú (d)UTU-ba-ni-ma
translation: Say to Šu-Ištar, thus Zuba, Mataga..., and Šamaš-bāni:

transliteration: a-šu-mì ša-áp-tim ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni eṭ-lu-tum i-ma-qú-tù-ni-ma ša-áp-tám išté-ni-iš₆ ni-dá-an-ma KÙ.BABBAR ni-zu-wa-azₓ
translation: As for the wool about which you wrote, when the men arrive here we will sell all the wool together and we will divide the silver.

transliteration: KI i-x x x a-na pu-šu-ki-in nu-šé-ba-lam
translation: And with ... we will send it to Pūšu-kēn.

transliteration: a šu-mì É-be-et DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša sà-im qá-áb-a-tí-ni a-na-kam iští ir-ma-a-šur a-ta-am-ga-ar
translation: As for calling at a merchant's house for a loan, as you have promised, I have here now come to an agreement with Ir'am-Aššur.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma té-er-tù-šu a-ṣé-er i-ku-pì-a-šur ú i-a-tí li-li-kam-ma la-dí-na-ku-um
translation: He said: 'Let his instruction come to Ikūn-pī-Aššur and to me, then I will give it to you'.

transliteration: xx x ki-ma ak-lá-ku-kà-ni xxxx gi₅-im-lá-ni
translation: Since I held you back ... do me a favor.

transliteration: … xxxx ša ma-ma-a x da-mì iq-tám a-na x ša-áp-tám xxx a-na ší-tí xxx šé-bi₄-lam
translation: The [wool?] of Mamma ... the wool ... for the rest ... send to me.

transliteration: a-na 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pí-im ì-dí-ba-ni ì-li-a-lúm ú mì-šu-ra-bi ú-kà-nam
translation: For 8 minas of refined silver Idi-bāni shall confirm for me Ilī-ālum and Mīšur-rabi's liability.

transliteration: a-na-ku ú ì-dí-ba-ni mì-ìš-lá x ú tup-pu-šu ha-ar-ma-am i-da-namₓ ša KÙ.BABBAR 8 ma-na ha-bu-lu
translation: I and Idi-bāni are each entitled to half the amount; moreover, he shall give me a valid record of his stating that he owes 8 minas of silver.

transliteration: šu-ma lá uk-ta-i-na-šu-nu ú tup-pu-šu ha-ar-ma-am lá i-ta-ad-nam a-na mu-nu-a-tí-a a-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ì-dí-ba-ni PUZUR₄-a-šur i-šé-e
translation: Should he fail to confirm them and also to give me his valid record, Idi-bāni shall sue Puzur-Aššur for my computed share, for 4 minas of silver.

transliteration: IGI su-(d)EN.LÍL IGI šu-ki-tim IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI šu-be-lúm
translation: In the presence of Šu-Enlil, of Šukkutum, of Amur-Ištar, and of Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: 2 ma-na 16.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi e-na-a-šur DUMU a-mu-ra a-šur-ni-šu DUMU ì-lí-ILLAT-tí i-šu
translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Amuraya owes 2 minas 16.1666 shekels of refined silver to Aššur-nīšu son of Ilī-ellitī.

transliteration: IGI ku-li-a DUMU a-la-bi-im IGI ur-ad-a-šur DUMU DIRI-im IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU sá-ma
translation: Witnessed by Kuliya son of Ali-abum, by Urad-Aššur son of Watrum, by Aššur-malik son of Samaya.

transliteration: um-ma … a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: From ... to Ali-ahum:

transliteration: a-pu-tum i-na u₄-mì-im ša tup-pí ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Urgent, the very day you hear my letter set out and come!

transliteration: um-me-a-nu a-bi-kà iští-in ú ší-na … a-wa-tim a-hu-kà … uštaršiū
translation: One or two of your father's investors have embroiled your brother in a lawsuit.

transliteration: tup-pa-am ša a-ma-kam a-na i-li-a ta-di-na-ni-ma ú … um-me-a-ni e-pu-lu-ni x-kà-a URUDU šu-a-tí x x x x kà-a ma-la x x x i-na li-bi-šu i-ší-tù
translation: The tablet that you gave me there to Iliya, and then the investors answered (about) that copper ... as much as remains owed by him.

transliteration: lu a-na ší-im URUDU SIG₅ ú e-ma-ri ša a-na ša-lá-tù-ar tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma qá-sú iš-ku-nu a-na mì-ma a-nim ší-bi šu-ku-šu-ma
translation: Whether for the price of the good copper or the donkeys that you sent me in Šalatuwar and to which he laid claim, set witnesses for all this against him.

transliteration: ma-lá URUDU SIG₅ i É-tí-šu i-ba-ší-ú a-ha-ma i-na URUDU SIG₅ ša qá-sú iš-ku-nu a-na ni-bi-it URUDU SIG₅ IGI ší-bi ta-ah-sí-is-tám i-dí-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Set down a memo before witnesses concerning the specification on copper of good quality - about how much good copper is in his house as well as the good copper to which he laid claim, and set out and come.

transliteration: ú a-na-kam iští um-me-a-ni lu-za-ki-ku-nu
translation: Then I shall clear you here with the investors.

transliteration: i-na … lá tù-uš-té-ṣa-a … um-me-a-nu … lá ú-ša … pu-… lá … x x … a-tal-kam
translation: Do not quarrel; the investors ... set out and come.

transliteration: šu-pu-na-ah-šu ṣú-ḣa-ru-um ša a-we-el-tim i-li-kam-ma
translation: Šuppun-ahšu, the lady's servant, came.

transliteration: šu-mì a-we-el-tim 2 ma-na KÙ a-na GAL sí-mì-il₅-tim áš-qúl
translation: In the name of the lady I paid 2 minas of silver to the Chief of the Staircase.

transliteration: en-nam-a-šùr a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Ennam-Aššur seized us against Aššur-ṭāb,

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr-ma a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma
translation: and Ennam-Aššur said to Aššur-ṭāb:

transliteration: a-na a-i-tim ta-ša-a-lá-ni ù sí-ki tù-kà-al
translation: "For what do you question me and detain me?

transliteration: lu a-bi ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um
translation: If either my father owes you anything,

transliteration: lu a-na-ku ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um
translation: or if I owe you anything,

transliteration: lu ṭup-pí ḫa-ar-ma-am tù-kà-al
translation: or if you have in your possession a tablet certified by me,

transliteration: ší-bi-kà ri-id-a-ma IGI a-ni-ú-tí-ma lu-ša-bi-kà
translation: then bring forth your witnesses and let me satisfy you with these men as witnesses!"

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma
translation: Aššur-ṭāb answered:

transliteration: 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-tí
translation: "You owe me 1 talent of silver.

transliteration: ma-aṣ-a-ku ú-kà-al-kà
translation: I take responsibility for holding you."

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
translation: Ennam-Aššur said:

transliteration: ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
translation: "Do keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king -

transliteration: ki-ma ša lá ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-ni-ma sí-ki ú-kà-lu
translation: that he detains me although I do not owe him anything!"

transliteration: IGI a-šur-e-nam DUMU lá-qé-pí-im
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-ennam son of Lā-qēp,

transliteration: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU e-ta-a
translation: by Ša-Ištar son of Aššur-immittī, (grand)son of Etaya.

transliteration: 2 TÚG ša DAM.MÍ kur-ub-IŠTAR a-na a-šur-ma-lik a-dí-in
translation: I gave 2 textiles of the wife of Kurub-Ištar to Aššur-malik.

transliteration: a-ḫu-a-tù-nu ú-ṭù-tám lu tù-pá-qí-dá
translation: Please, my brothers, you must provide her with barley.

transliteration: nu-dí-ma a-lá-nu-ma lá tù-pá-ra-dá-šu
translation: Do not frighten her from there!

transliteration: ṣú-ba-sà-a ù ší-it-ar-ša-a eṭ-ra-šu
translation: Deprive her of her garment and her head-dress.

transliteration: a-na DUMU a-šùr ù a-na DUMU kà-né-eš lá ta-dá-na-šu
translation: You must not sell her to an Assyrian or to a citizen of Kanesh.

transliteration: a-na ta-al-ḫa-tim dí-na-šu
translation: Sell her to a man from Talhat!

transliteration: ú a-ša-ar ta-dá-na-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma
translation: And where you sell her you must say:

transliteration: a-na ma-at kà-né-eš a-wi-il₅-tám lá tù-ta-ra-nim
translation: 'Do not bring the woman back to the land of Kanesh!'

transliteration: 15.33333 GÍN 15 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er kà-ar-ší-ni a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
translation: Karšini owes 15.3333 shekels 15 grains of silver to Ali-ahum.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im ITU.KAM be-el-té-kál-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí
translation: Reckoned from the week of the kaššum-official, month Bēlat-ekallim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī,

transliteration: x a-na e-tí-šu i-ša-qal
translation: he will pay at the earliest convenience.

transliteration: x IGI wa-al-dí-lim IGI i-na-ar
translation: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

transliteration: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er kà-ar-ší-ni ù a-li-li x IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí tí-šu
translation: Karšini and Alili owe 6 shekels of silver to Ištar-lamassī.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí ITU.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-té a-šur-i-mì-tí
translation: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-imittī, month Ša-sarrātim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī,

transliteration: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-sú ù 20 ak-li a-na ša-na-at ú-bu-lu-nim
translation: they will bring 3 shekels of silver, its interest, plus 20 loaves of bread within one year.

transliteration: IGI wa-al-dí-lim IGI i-na-ar
translation: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

transliteration: [...] … mu-ut a-bi-a en-na-a-šur …
translation: ... the death of my father has Ennam-Aššur ...

transliteration: … ša-zu-úz-tí a-ba-e-ší-na ú-lá …
translation: ... the representatives of their fathers did not ...

transliteration: 1 xx id-du-ni šu ma li-ba-am a-na a-we-li i-dí-nu-ni
translation: ... that they did encourage the men.

transliteration: a-tù-nu ú-lá mu-ut a-bi₄-a ú-lá šu-lu-um-ku-nu ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ma li-ba-am ta-dí-na-nim
translation: As for you, you did not write either about my father's death or send me your greetings to encourage me.

transliteration: a-na-ku a-na-kam iš-tí DAM.GÀR …
translation: While I here with the merchant ...

transliteration: [...] … ma-lá ku-nu-tí …-a-am i-šu
translation: ... as much as for you ... he has ...

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù a-lim(ki) i-na e-lá-i-šu a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù a-lá-ḫi-im SIG₅-pì-i-a-šùr DUMU IR-ad-ì-lí-šu i-ša-qal
translation: Damiq-pī-Aššur son of Warad-ilīšu will pay 1 mina of silver to Ištar-lamassī and Ali-ahum when he comes up from the City.

transliteration: IGI a-dí-da IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI be-lúm-ba-ni
translation: Witnessed by Adida, by Aššur-bāni, by Bēlum-bāni.

transliteration: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam-Aššur:

translation: I myself will pay 4 shekels of silver.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-pu-ul-šum
translation: Of this amount you paid him 28 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ i-tu-me-li-a a-dí-šum
translation: 2 shekels of silver I gave him in Tumeliya.

transliteration: 1.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-kúl-tí ANŠE ù da-a-sú ša a-dí wa-ah-šu-ša-na
translation: 1.6666 shekel of silver fodder for the donkey and road-tax for it until Wahšušana.

transliteration: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša 30 TÚG.HI.A iš-tù ú-lá-ma a-dí bu-ru-uš-ha-tim ù É wa-áb-ri
translation: 3 shekels of silver for 30 textiles from Ulama until Burušhattum and for the cost of the inn.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ha-bi-a ù a-ší-tí-šu a-lā-hu-um i-šu
translation: Habiya and his wife owe 0.3333 mina 1.5 shekel of silver to Ali-ahum.

transliteration: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ù kur-ub-IŠTAR-ma a-na da-da ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, say to Dada and Ēnah-ilī:

transliteration: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša aḫ-ša-lim a-na a-bi-ku-nu ub-lá-ni šu-ma 15 GÍN.TA i-ba-ší AN.NA ša-ma-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: The 30 minas of silver that Ah-šalim brought to your father, if there is tin available at a rate of 15 shekels (to 1), then buy it and send it to me.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na 15 GÍN.TA ba-tí-iq mì-iš-lam AN.NA mì-iš-lam TÚG.ḪI.A ša-ma-ma i pá-ni-im-ma áb-kà-nim
translation: If the rate is less than 15 shekels (to 1) then buy for one half of it tin and for the other half textiles and ship them to me with the first opportunity.

transliteration: a-ni-ša-am a-ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-dam
translation: It should reach me here before the suspension of traffic.

transliteration: i-nu-mì AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ta-kà-na-kà i pá-ni šu-uq-lá-tim ù sí-ke TÚG.ḪI.A ša DAM.GÀR lá-pí-ta-nim
translation: When you seal the tin and the textiles write on the packets (with tin) and on the hem of the textiles: "Belonging to the merchant".

transliteration: i ki-dim a-wa-at-ku-nu lá i-ša-me
translation: No word of you should be heard outside!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša e-la-ma
translation: The silver belongs to Elamma.

transliteration: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 8.33333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tù ni-mar-ZU ba zi ú ni i li-bi₄ en-nam-a-šur DUMU (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni
translation: 12 shekels of silver plus 8.3333 minas of good copper I deposited with Ennam-Aššur son of Amurrum-bāni after Nimar-Sīn.

transliteration: a-dí šu-ma a-a-e-ma pu-uz-ra-am i-ṣa-ba-at 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ba-lu-um dí-nim ù ṣa-al-tim i-ša-qá-lam
translation: Until, if he takes refuge anywhere, he shall pay 1 mina of silver without lawsuit or litigation.

transliteration: IGI a-zu-a IGI ra-áb-a-šur DUMU a-šur-i-mí-tí
translation: Witnessed by Azua, witnessed by Rab-Aššur son of Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur from Amur-Aššur:

transliteration: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni tap-pá-i KÙ.BABBAR uš-ta-pár-ki
translation: Concerning your silver that you wrote me about, my partner has allowed the silver to stop.

transliteration: a-dí ITU.1.KAM iš-tí-in x x x x-ni šu x x x-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: Within a single month ... I shall leave.

transliteration: ú u₄-mu-a 2 ITU.KAM a-ḫu-ru
translation: Also, my term still runs for 2 months.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ki-iš-da-tí-a a-na i-dí-a-šùr DUMU dan-a-šùr i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
translation: I myself paid 0.6666 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver, my earnings, to Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur.

transliteration: lu a-na ri-ig-ma-tim i-dí-a-šur ir-dí-ni-a-tí-ni lu a-na ṭup-pí ša ší-bi₄ i bá-áb DINGIR-lim ú-ga-ri-mu-ni 1 GÚ 40 ma-na ag-mu-ur-ma mì-iš-li-šu ṣí-li-a i-dín-nam
translation: I personally spent 1 talent 40 minas (of copper) both when Iddin-Aššur led us to the court case and when they produced the tablet with witnesses in the gate of the God, and Ṣilliya gave me half of that.

transliteration: x 0.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ mu-ṣí-šu ú pu-ru-sà-e ša ra-bi₄-ṣí-im i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
translation: I personally paid x 0.5 minas of good copper, the exit-tax and the decision of the attorney.

transliteration: ú-ku-ul-tí MAŠKIM a-na-ku-ma ú-ša-qí-il₅
translation: I too paid for the food of the attorney.

transliteration: ṣí-li-a mì-ma a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu ú-lá i-dín
translation: Ṣilliya did not give anything for his food.

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-na-ku ù a-ba-ba a-ṣé-er ì-lí-dan e-tí-qú-ni i-na ḫa-ra-nim lu a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim ni-is-ḫu-ru-ma a-wa-sú ni-ib-tù-qú-ni
translation: When I and Ababa travelled to Ilī-dan we were delayed on the journey until this very day, and we dropped his case;

transliteration: ú iš-tù ku-bu-ur-na-at a-dí dur₄-ḫu-mì-it ni-tù-ru-ni 0.5 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ga-me-er
translation: then we returned from Kuburnat to Durhumit - 0.5 mina 4 shekels of silver was the expense.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim a-dí a-wa-tim ša É a-bi-ni kà-šá-dim ú-ga-me-er
translation: All this I have paid in order to conclude the matter of our father's house.

transliteration: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É a-bi-a gám-ri a-lá-qé
translation: I shall take my expenses from the silver of my father's house.

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma sà-ba-sí-a ù tám-kà-ru-um-ma a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: From Šalim-Aššur, Sabasiya and the merchant to Pilah-Ištar and Zikiki:

transliteration: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša tám-kà-ri-im
translation: 30 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, belonging to a merchant;

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bu ša a-šur ša tám-kà-ri-ma ku-nu-ki-šu a-na ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR zi-ki-ki na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: further, 10 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, votive offerings for Aššur, also belonging to a merchant and sealed by him, Zikiki is bringing to you destined for Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: To Zikiki:

transliteration: a-ni-am a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR pì-qí-id-ma iš-tí a-wi-tí-šu e-ta-wu ú a-ta i-na re-ší-šu i-zi-iz-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lu ṭá-ba-tí
translation: Entrust this to Pilah-Ištar and join it to his consignment and then you personally may serve him and be positive over every shekel of silver.

transliteration: a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
translation: To Pilah-Ištar:

transliteration: a-ḫu-ni a-ta li-bi₄ zi-ki-ki lá tù-lá-ma-an
translation: Our dear brother, do not make Zikiki angry.

transliteration: ṭup-pè-en₆ ší-na ša a-ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR lá-pu-tù ša šé-ep zi-ki-ki iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR-ni x x-ba-šu-ni iš-tí pá-né-e-ma šé-bi₄-lá-ni-šu-nu
translation: There are two tablets that were written to Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar and that have been transported by Zikiki - send them together with our silver ... as soon as possible.

transliteration: i-na ṭup-pè-en₆ a-me-e-en₆ qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um wa-du
translation: Laying claim was indicated on those two tablets.

transliteration: tí-ir-tí a-lim(ki) da-nu-tù-um i-li-kam
translation: A strongly worded message from the City arrived.

transliteration: qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um lá-šu
translation: There is no way to lay claim.

transliteration: we-da-ku
translation: I am alone.

transliteration: ṭup-p
translation: Send those two tablets.

transliteration: a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ša šál-ma-a-šur a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur, seized us against Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative,

transliteration: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im 22 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i-na li-bi₄-ku-nu
translation: and the attorney Ababa said to Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative: '22 talents of good copper are in your possession.'

transliteration: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu ke-na i-na li-bi₄-ni
translation: Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative, answered: 'Yes, it is in our possession.'

transliteration: i-na kà-ni-iš a-na-ku ù a-ḫi-i ni-za-ku-ma a-li URUDU i-na li-bi₄-ni i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ni-ta-dí-a-ku-um
translation: In Kanesh I and my brother will make a settlement and wherever copper is shown as being owed by us, we shall deposit it for you.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
translation: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-ki-tim IGI en-nu-um-sú-in
translation: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šukkutum, by Ennam-Suen.

transliteration: um-ma i-dí-a-šur-ma a-na ḫa-nu-nu x a-lá-ḫi-im ù e-na-na-tim qí-bi-ma
translation: From Iddin-Aššur to hanunu, Ali-ahum and Ennanātum:

transliteration: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im ma-ḫi-ir a-lim(ki) en-um-(d)IM a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ḫa-bu-ul
translation: Ennam-Adad owes worth 2 minas of refined silver at the market price in the City to a merchant.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am a-na-ku ú-kà-al
translation: I personally have his certified tablet.

transliteration: i-nu-mì DAM.GÀR-ru-um ṭup-pu-šu xxxx 15 GÍN.TA xxx na a-lim(ki) xxxx um … [...] xxx KÙ.BABBAR … xxx az … ṣí-ib-tim li-iṣ-ḫi-ir
translation: When the merchant ... his tablet ... 15 shekels ... the City ... let him deduct ... of the interest.

transliteration: ṣí-ib-tám lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
translation: Make him no favours on the interest.

transliteration: ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma iš-tù a-li-ki-im pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
translation: Make him pay and send it with the very first transport.

transliteration: iḫ-da-ma ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: Take care to have him pay.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu ša li-mì ša 30 ma-na iš-tí e-na-na-tim i-ba-ší
translation: The tablet concerning his debt to the eponyms, concerning 30 minas, is in Ennanātum's possession.

transliteration: … a li-bi₄ ṭup-pè-a šu-uk-na-ma ù tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
translation: Place it among my tablets and then send me word.

transliteration: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma dan-a-šur a-lá-ḫu-um ù šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Man-mahir, Dan-Aššur, Ali-ahum and Šu-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-ma-kam a-šar lá a-bi-im ù um-mì-im na-lá-tí-ni-ma ù mu-ur-ṣa-am a-na mu-ur-ṣí-im tù-ra-du-ú
translation: Why are you lying around there where there is no father and no mother, making the disease worse?

transliteration: ki-ma a-na-kam a-na É DINGIR tù-ru-du-ma iš-tí DINGIR e-na-na-tim té-ta-ri-šu ù IGI i-li-kà tù-ta-na-nu-nu ù a-ḫu-um ù eb-ru-um li-ba-am i-da-na-ku-nu
translation: Instead of going down to the temple here, asking mercy from the god, praying constantly to your god so that brother and friend could give you encouragement,

transliteration: a-ta a-ma-kam ki-ma a-we-lim ra-qí-im ša-na-at ta-ta-šá-áb ša tí-ir-tám ù ḫu-šá-ḫa-am lá tí-šu-ú
translation: you have sat there for a year as an empty man, without purpose or wishes.

transliteration: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu ša ki-ma i-na pá-ni-tim té-ta-ta-ri-ša-ni a-na a-ḫi-kà ú-kà-lu-ma
translation: Your father's investors here offer those things to your brother which you earlier constantly asked me for,

transliteration: ù ki-ma a-ḫu-kà we-dí-ni-ma ù a šu-mì-kà ma-ga-ra-am ú-lá i-mu-a
translation: but, in fact, since your brother is alone he is of course unwilling to agree on your behalf.

transliteration: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-ni ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Urgent, set out and come here the very day you hear our letter!

transliteration: ù a-ḫi-ú-tum i-ta-bu-lu-kà
translation: Also, strangers may carry you away all the time.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lu a-na ANŠE.ḪI.A lu a-na ḫi-šá-nim gu₅-mu-ur-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Agree to some 10 shekels of silver either for donkeys or for a pole and set out and come.

transliteration: a-na-kam É a-bi-ku-nu za-ki-a
translation: Clear up the affairs of your father's house here.

transliteration: ma-ma-an ša-li-um i-na ṣé-ri-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
translation: No evildoer should harm you.

transliteration: ú-um-šu-ma be-el a-wa-tí-ku-nu i-na a-wa-tí i-ra-de₈-ú-k
translation: Until now your accusers have been pestering you with lawsuits.

transliteration: um-ma ì-lí-dan-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: From Ilī-dan to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta … ta-li-kam-ma … tù-ša-… ma-lá … x i … [...] x x dí iš …
translation: My dear brother and lord, ... you came ...

transliteration: li-mu-tù … a-dí-i ṭup-pu lá i-mu-tù-ú
translation: Let the tablets be invalid; as long as the tablets have not been invalidated at all.

transliteration: gi₅-mì-li-kà-a lá a-ga-mì-il₅-kà-a
translation: I shall by no means show you any favours.

transliteration: ù KÙ.BABBAR maš-qá-al-ta-kà mì-ma ú-la a-ša-qá-la-kum
translation: And I shall not make any payments in silver to you.

transliteration: a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-té-zi-iz
translation: ... he carried out his wishes.

transliteration: wa-ar-ki-tám kà-ru-um SIG₅-pí-a-šur a-na ší-ip-ru-tim iš-pu-ur-ma e-ri-iš-tí kà-ri-im ú-ta-er-ma e-ri-iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR im-ḫu-ur
translation: Later the colony dispatched Damiq-pī-Aššur as envoy and he rejected the wishes of the colony and accepted Itūr-ilī's wishes;

transliteration: ù ṭup-pá-am ša i-tur₄-DINGIR a-na ta-am-ni-a-i-im ú-šé-bi₄-lu SIG₅-pí-a-šur ší-ip-ru-um ša kà-ri-im iš-ta-sí-ma
translation: also, the letter that Itūr-Ilī sent to the king of Tawniya, Damiq-pī-Aššur, as the envoy of the colony, read it aloud,

transliteration: a-ḫu be-lu a-tù-nu a-tù-nu a-ma-kam ší-ta-lá-ma ki-ma a-lúm(ki) ù É a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-lu ep-šá-a
translation: so, dear brothers and lords, take counsel there and act because the City and my father's house have been turned into debtors.

transliteration: ma-ṣa-ku
translation: I take responsibility.

transliteration: a-wi-lam₅ ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am
translation: I shall have the man extradited.

transliteration: ki-ma da-me-e ša a-ḫi-a lá ik-šu-du ù iš-tù MU.2.ŠÈ KÙ.BABBAR-áp É a-bi₄-a ú-ṣa-li-mu-ú ù a-ḫi a-šu-mì a-mu-tí-šu sú-ri-e dí-ku-ma
translation: Since he did not acquire my brother's blood-money, and since he bothered me with the silver of my father's house for two years and my brother surely was killed because of his iron,

transliteration: a-ma-kam i ša-ḫa-at a-ḫa-tí-a ù me-er-a-at a-ḫi-a i-zi-za-ma a-lam₅(ki) mu-ùḫ-ra-ma ra-bi-ṣa-am da-na-am aḫ-za-nim
translation: (therefore) assist my sister and my brother's daughter there, appeal to the City assembly and acquire a capable attorney.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi ḫa-bu-a-lá ù ta-ri-ku-da
translation: 1.5 mina of silver is owed by habuala and Tarikuda.

transliteration: 15 na-ru-uq ar-šá-tum 2 UDU ṣú-pu-ú a-ḫa-ma
translation: 15 sacks of wheat and 2 shorn sheep separately.

transliteration: 3 ku-ta-ni SIG₅ il₅-qé-ú-ma a-na sí-kà-tim a-ṣé-er be-li-šu-nu ú-šé-bi₄-lu
translation: They took 3 fine kutānu-textiles and sent them to their masters for the sikkātum-festival.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu-nu
translation: 1.5 mina of silver is their price.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR al-qé-e a-ḫa-ma
translation: From this I have received 0.5 mina of silver separately.

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 5 na-ru-uq ŠE-um i li-bi₄ ta-ri-ku-da
translation: 15 shekels of silver and 5 sacks of barley are owed by Tarikuda.

transliteration: 2 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni a-na 0.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na pá-ni-tim IGI ki-zi ù ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà a-dí-na-kum
translation: I previously gave you 2 kutānu-textiles for 0.3333 mina 2 shekels of silver with Kizi and your servant as witnesses.

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 1 (TÚG)ku-ta-nam ša da x IGI ku-da-tim ù šu-a-šùr a-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-na-kum
translation: Separately I gave you 1 kutānum-textile ... with Kudatum and Šu-Aššur as witnesses for 10 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-ṣa-ri-a i li-bi-kà i-ri-ḫa-am
translation: 2 shekels of silver out of 17 shekels of silver belonging to my packer remained as a debt of yours.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim iš-tí a-da-da
translation: All this is with Adada.

transliteration: ú šu-ut 5 UDU.ḪI.A 1.66666 GÍN.TA i-dí-nam
translation: And he gave me those 5 sheep at 1.66666 shekels each.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU mì-šar-GAL
translation: Seal of Amur-Ištar son of Mīšar-rabi.

transliteration: KIŠIB la-qé-ep DUMU kà-a-tim
translation: Seal of Lā-qēp son of Kayātum.

transliteration: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃
translation: Seal of Iddin-abum son of Issu-arik.

transliteration: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im
translation: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mur-IŠTAR a-na 23 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
translation: Reckoned from the week of Amur-Ištar he must pay within 23 weeks.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu la iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he has not paid within his stipulated term he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

transliteration: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
translation: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum and Inah-ilī from Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 4 GÚ AN.NA ú … ša a-bi-ni a-ma-kam … e-zi-bu-ma a-x … a-na ḫa-na-a a-… ta-dí-na-ni-ma iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-nu-tí
translation: 4 talents of tin and ... belonging to our father they left there and ... to hanaya ... you gave to me and ... I shall send it to you from Purušhaddum.

transliteration: a-na-kam i-nu-mì e-ri-qá-tim a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim iš-tí dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur a-bu-ku
