transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu 1.66666 ma-na 6.66666 GÍN
translation: Their value in silver was 1.66666 mina 6.66666 shekels.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 5 GÍN KÙ e-ri-ib-tum ša AN.NA i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ il₅-qé
translation: Thereof Puzur-Abeh has taken 5 shekels of silver, entrance tax for the tin, in Wahšušana;

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na am-tim ni-iš-qú-ul
translation: we paid 0.5 mina 4.5 shekels of silver to the maid.

transliteration: ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ir-dí-a-kum
translation: Ilī-ašrannī led it to you.

transliteration: 4 ma-na a qá-tí-šu ni-dín
translation: We gave 4 minas for his expenses.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ḫa-nu na-áš-a-kum
translation: hanu brings you the rest of your silver, 1 mina 6 shekels of silver under our seals.

transliteration: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì a-dí-da áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid 6 shekels of silver in the name of Adida.

transliteration: x GÍN ṭá-áb-tí áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid x shekels for my salt-fee.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
translation: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, son of Aššur-dan.

transliteration: šál-ma-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-hi-ú-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma mì-šu-um ší-im TÚG-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
translation: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar, and Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar: "Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?"

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ lá-mu-nam aṣ-ba-at
translation: Amur-Ištar answered: "Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper."

transliteration: ba-lu-um hi-na-a ú ší-bé aṣ-ba-at
translation: I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma ha-bu-ra-ta-i-am tal-qé
translation: Šalim-Aššur said: "Did you take copper from Haburat?"

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ša i qá-tim x-ta-šu-šu al-qé
translation: Amur-Ištar answered: "I took what I could grab."

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-aṣ-ba-at
translation: Amur Ištar continued: "But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?"

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur mì-ma lá aṣ-ba-at-ma
translation: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I have seized nothing."

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a ṣú-ha-ri-a a za-al-pá áš-ta-pár
translation: Amur-Ištar said: "I have sent my servant to Zalpa."

transliteration: ṣú-ha-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wu
translation: When my servant comes I shall discuss further.

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
translation: Amur-Ištar continued: "It is I who am suing you, not you who are suing me."

transliteration: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI pu-šu-ki-in
translation: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Pūšu-kēn.

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU a-šùr-i-dí KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-i-dí sū-in-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
translation: Sealed by Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī, by Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-idī; Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur was our partner.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

transliteration: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
translation: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: 1 TÚG KI ša-ha-ma
translation: 1 textile owed by Šahama.

transliteration: 1 TÚG KI sú-is-ha-ra šu wa-áb-ri-ni
translation: 1 textile owed by Su-Ishara, our guest.

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
translation: Before Aššur-bāni.

transliteration: a-na ku-zi-zi-a IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí na-áb-sú-in a-na-na a-mur-IŠTAR ša-lim-ar-dí ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
translation: To Kuziziya, Ištar-lamassī, Nāb-Suen, Anna-anna, Amur-Ištar, Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya from Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša ku-ku-wa ù ku-nu-ki-a ù 7 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim i-a-um ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of silver sealed by Kukuwa and by me plus 7 black donkeys with their harness - all this belonging to me, Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ku-ku-wa a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU MAN.IŠTAR ha-bu-lu-ni-ma 20 GÚ SÍG.HI.A a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ú-kà-lu-ni a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
translation: In addition to this silver that Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you, for the 3 minas silver and its interest that Kukuwa owes to Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar, and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security - say to my representatives:

transliteration: a-ma-kam ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a i-ha-šu-hu-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu i-na ša ba-áb-tí-a ta-am-hu-ra-ni lu KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ṣé-er a-na-na ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni a-na ṣí-ib-tim KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im dí-na-šu-nu-tí-ma
translation: Whatever silver Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya ask for there, lend them silver against interest according to the rate of the colony - from what silver you have received from my outstanding claims, or silver I sent to Anna-anna under my seal.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a me-er-i-ša ša qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu lu-up-ta-ma a-na am-tí-a ṭup-pá-am dí-na-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni
translation: Then write a tablet for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, her son, with joint liability, and give the tablet to my maid so it may remain in her possession until I come.

transliteration: a-na ṣé-er a-šùr-UTU i-na ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu né-ru-ub-ma um-ma en-na-sú-in a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma
translation: We entered with Aššur-šamšī when he was about to go on a journey and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī:

transliteration: a-pu-na lá-ma kà-sà-am ni-iš-tí-ú a-wa-tí-im lá-ta-wu-kum li-ba-tim lá ta-ma-lá
translation: Please, before we drink from the cup I want to declare something to you, do not get angry!

transliteration: i-nu-mì i-na wa-áš-ha-ni-a ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ni 2-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ha-ti tù-šé-bi-lá-kà
translation: When they detained me in Wašhaniya did my sister send you to me with 2 minas of silver?

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU ke-na tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma ú-lá a-dí-na-kum
translation: Aššur-šamšī answered: "Sure, she sent me, but I did not give it to you."

transliteration: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma u₄-ma-am a-ha-tí ta-tù-ra-am
translation: Ennam-Suen then said: "Today my sister has come back here."

transliteration: um-ma ší-it-ma ta-al-tám-nam KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí ša iš-tù 8 ša-na-tim šé-ṣí-ma dí-nam
translation: And she said: 'You have done me wrong! Produce the silver and its interest due since eight years and give it to me!'

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma e-ni-ma-ma a-na šé-ep a-šur-i-mì-tí am-qú-ut
translation: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I threw myself down at the feet of Aššur-imittī."

transliteration: a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-ma KÙ.GI 15 GÍN ù 1 ma-na sà-am-tum ma-lá ta-le-a-ni É.GAL-lam ṭá-i-ba
translation: Saying: 'Please, my brothers, here are gold, 15 shekels, and 1 mina of carnelian, appease the palace as well as you can'.

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma a-na en-na-sú-in-ma šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-dí-im i-tù-ar al-kam-ma ší-bé-kà la-aṣ-ba-at-ma ma-lá e-pá-ší-im ep-ša-ni
translation: Aššur-šamšī also said to Ennam-Suen: "If the silver due has increased much then come here, let me seize your witnesses and do with me what you think best!"

transliteration: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma É.GAL-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ṣé-ri-a i-šu
translation: Ennam-Suen answered Aššur-šamšī as follows: "The palace has a substantial silver claim on me."

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šùr-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù sà-hi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-kà na-ki-ru-um ub-lam
translation: They brought me 29 shekels of silver and small goods under seal.

transliteration: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na ú e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
translation: Annima and Eništārum brought you 10 minas of silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na ni-ip-lá-tí-a áš-ta-qal
translation: The silver you sent me I have paid to cover my balance payments.

transliteration: u₄-mu-ú er-ša-sú-ma ILLAT kà-al-a-at
translation: The weather is bad and the caravan has been stopped.

transliteration: a-hu-a a-tù-nu i-na lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-hu-tù-um i-ba-ší-ú
translation: My dear brothers, among the goods of the merchant there are some old textiles.

transliteration: ih-da-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-im mì-il₅-kà
translation: Take care and decide about the goods.

transliteration: a-hu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA x šé-bi-lá-ni-ma
translation: My dear brothers, send me silver, the proceeds from the tin.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì x i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
translation: And deposit my silver to my debit.

transliteration: a-dí tí-ir-ta-ak-nu i-lá-kà-ni ri-iš lu-qú-tim ú-kà-al
translation: I hold on to the goods until your orders arrive.

transliteration: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-mālik:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni ù ṭup-pè-kà a-na ma-lá té-er-tí-kà a-na a-lim(ki) uš-té-bi₄-il₅
translation: The silver you sent me and your tablets I have now sent to the City following your instruction.

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša É kà-ri-im ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im tù-šé-bi₄-lu KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-li-im a-dí-in
translation: As for the silver of the colonial office that you sent for Lā-qēpum, I gave that silver to Lalum.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ù 5 TÚG ša a-di-ú-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp lá-qé-pí-im-ma i-ší-qí-il₅
translation: In addition to that silver and the 5 textiles that I deposited, silver has been paid from Lā-qēpum's silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-kà a-na lá-qé-pí-im li-li-ik-ma i-na ga-ma-ar KÙ.BABBAR šu-um-kà i-na É kà-ri-im lu ni-il₅-pu-ut
translation: Let your silver go to Lā-qēpum and then, when the silver is spent we will register it in your name in the colonial office.

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša a-mur-IŠTAR ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im ù ku-a-tí ha-bu-lu té-er-tí lá-qé-pí-im a-ṣé-er lá-li-im ù ku-a-tí i-li-kam-ma
translation: As for the silver of Amur-Ištar, which he owes to Lā-qēpum and to you, there came a message of Lā-qēpum, addressed to Lalum and you.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma u₄-me ṣa-áb-ta-ma ma-lá e-tí-qú-ni 1 GÍN.TA a ma-na-im ší-sí-a-ma
translation: In which he said: "Seize (him for) the days he is overdue and claim (an interest of) 1 shekel per mina."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: And make him pay the silver and the interest on it.

transliteration: a-wa-tám a-šu-mì ni-a-tí mì-li-ik
translation: You must decide on behalf of us.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà mì-li-ik TÚG.HI.A ma-lá be-lúm-ba-ni e-zi-ba-ku-ni
translation: Sell all the textiles that Bēlum-bāni left behind for you.

transliteration: ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur i-na ni-a-ú-tim-ma ma-na-im URUDU x-x-us-ma dí-in
translation: At any price, sell for copper by our own 1-mina-weight.

transliteration: lá i-na-dí-ú KÙ.BABBAR
translation: The silver must not be stocked.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-a ha-ru-mu-tum me-eh-ru-a ú ta-ah-sí-sà-tum
translation: My certified tablets, my copies and memoranda.

transliteration: ir-ma-a-šur a-na DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-a-lim lá-qé-pí-im DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ù i-šu-hi-im DUMU šu-lí ša ki-ma šu-lí iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Ir'am-Aššur seized us against Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, son of Ilī-ālum, La-qēpum, son of Puzur-Anna, and Išuhum, son of Šuli, representing Šuli.

transliteration: um-ma ir-ma-a-šur-ma 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-lí DUMU bu-zu-ta-a ša en-na-sú-in DUMU ì-lí-a a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-dí-na-ni-ma qá-tí ú-kà-i-lu-ma
translation: And Ir'am-Aššur said: "2.5 minas of silver belonging to Šuli, son of Buzutaya, which Ennam-Suen, son of Iliya, gave me for making purchases and which I kept in my possession."

transliteration: a-wa-tí-a ah-ša-lim DUMU bu-zu-ta-a bé-lá-num DUMU šu-a-šur ù a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU a-lá-hi-im ig-mu-ru-ni
translation: And for which Ah-šalim, son of Buzutāya, Bēlānum, son of Šu-Aššur, and Aššur-taklāku, son of Ali-ahum settled my case.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí ki-ma šu-lí ša-bu-a-tí šu-lí DUMU bu-zu-ta-a lá i-tù-ra-am
translation: With that silver you have been satisfied as representative of Šuli; Šuli, son of Buzutāya, shall not raise a claim for it against me.

transliteration: um-ma DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur-ma lá-qé-ep DUMU PÚZUR-a-na ù i-šu-hu-um DUMU šu-lí a-na ir-ma-a-šur-ma
translation: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, La-qēp, son of Puzur-Anna, and Išuhum, son of Šuli, answered I'ram-Aššur:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-lí ša a-wa-at-kà gám-ra-a-ni šu-lí ša-bu-a-ni
translation: With the silver of Šuli, whose affair with you has been settled, we have satisfied Šuli.

transliteration: a-na ša ṭup-pí-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šé-e-kà
translation: On the basis of what your record states the merchant will sue you for the silver.

transliteration: i-na ha-muš-tim ša a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a ITU.KAM tí-i-na-tim li-mu-um ma-ṣí-ì-lí
translation: During the week of Aššuriš-tikal, son of Sukkalliya, month of Tinatim, of the eponymy of Maṣi-ilī.

transliteration: IGI ku-da-dim DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ IGI DINGIR-na-da DUMU a-šur-na-da
translation: In the presence of Kudādum, son of Aššur-ṭāb, of Ilī-nādā, son of Aššur-nādā.

transliteration: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šùr na-áb-sú-in a-na-na ù da-ra-áš qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
translation: To Mannum-kī-Aššur, Nab-Suen, Anna-anna and Daraš from Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-a 2 ší-ta a-ma-tim ú 2 ší-na ṣú-hu-ur-ší-na
translation: As to the 1 mina of refined silver under my seal, 30 minas of good copper under my seal, 2 slave-girls plus their 2 children.

transliteration: i-na mì-ma a-nim a-na hu-bu-li-im ša da-ra-áš qá-tí a-lu-lá-a ša-ak-na-at
translation: Alulaya has laid claim to all this for Daraš' debt.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù URUDU ku-nu-ki-a ša-ta-na na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Šāt-Anna brings you the silver and copper under my seal.

transliteration: a-ma-tim ú ṣú-hu-ur-ší-na a-na É-bé-tí-a da-ra-áš lu-šé-ri-ib-ma
translation: Let Daraš bring the slave-girls and their children into my house.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ma-nu-ki-a-šur li-ib-ší-ma
translation: And let the silver remain with Mannum-kī-Aššur.

transliteration: a-ma-tim ba-tí-iq ú-tù-ur dí-na-ma
translation: Sell the slave-girls at the best available price.

transliteration: 1 ma-na-am ša-ni-am KÙ.BABBAR da-ra-áš li-iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí-ma
translation: And let Daraš pay to you another mina of silver.

transliteration: ù KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a ma-nu-ki-a-šur i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mu-ri-im lu-kà-in-ma
translation: And then Mannum-kī-Aššur must confirm the silver under my seal among the checked silver.

transliteration: iš-té-ni-iš ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-šu ša kà-ni-iš a-tù-nu ù da-ra-áš ší-ta-a-ma-ma
translation: For in all 2 minas of silver you and Daraš must make a purchase in Kanesh that will benefit him.

transliteration: pí-ri-kà-nu a-šar ma-nu-ki-a-šur-ma le-ru-bu
translation: And the pirikannu-textiles should enter Mannum-kī-Aššur's house.

transliteration: ú KÙ.BABBAR áš-ra-kam-ma ša-áš-qí-lá
translation: Then, have the silver paid in the same place.

transliteration: a-dí pí-ri-kà-nu-um lá e-ru-ba-ni KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a-na da-ra-áš lá tù-ša-ra
translation: As long as the pirikannu-textiles have not entered, do not release a single shekel of silver to Daraš.

transliteration: pí-ri-kà-ni ša ta-ša-a-ma-
translation: He must check the pirikannu-textiles that you buy.

transliteration: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
translation: From Kuziziya to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 2 TÚG ra-qá-tim ù hhu-sà-ra-am šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-ÌR-dí ub-lu-nim
translation: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī brought me 2 thin textiles and some lapis lazuli.

transliteration: (TÚG)ra-qá-tí-kà a-šùr-e-mu-qí i-na ma-ri-it-hhi-im i-dí-ší-na-ma
translation: Aššur-emūqī sold your thin textiles in Marithum,

transliteration: ší-im-ší-na ù-lá ub-lam
translation: but he has not brought the proceeds from their sale.

transliteration: i-na a-lá-ki-šu ší-im-ší-na ù-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: When he comes I shall send you the proceeds from them.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-a lá ma-qí-it-ma me-ehh-ra-tim lá ú-šé-bi-lá-kum
translation: No silver has fallen into my hands, so I did not send you a corresponding amount.

transliteration: hhu-sà-ar-kà ku-nu-ki-a ù 4.33333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-nu-ki-a-ma ší-im ra-qá-tim ša pí-lá-ahh-IŠTAR šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-ÌR-dí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: Your lapis lazuli is under my seal and Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī bring you 4 ⅓ shekels of gold, also under my seal, the proceeds from the thin textiles belonging to Pilah-Ištar.

transliteration: a-x x x na-ru-uq x x x-ru-tum x x x x-tám a-ma-kam a-na a-wi-il₅-tim dí-in
translation: ... a sack ... give that to the lady there.

translation: Iddin-Šamaš brings you 1 shekel of silver.

transliteration: šál-ma-ni

transliteration: mì-ma ú-lá ni-iš-me
translation: We have heard nothing."

translation: If you have not come to Kanesh within 5 months, after the month Ša-sarrātim and answered me in court,

translation: Šu-Laban seized me in Ulama before the witnesses Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ennam-Anum and Pilah-Ištar, and he said:

translation: Further, I entrusted a certified tablet concerning 50 minas of good copper belonging to the merchant to Ennānum son of Abiya;

translation: he will make my merchant pay 50 minas of -copper and send it to me."

translation: To Amurrum-bāni, Aššur-imittī, Ṣilulu, Aššur-dan, Šar-Adad, Puzur-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur from Šalim-Aššur;

translation: specifically to Puzur-Aššur: When you went down to the City I said:

translation: Abu-šalim has taken silver from my silver in exchange and given it to you to carry out purchases,

translation: Since you received my silver, I seized you and set witnesses for you as you left for the City,

translation: But today you take me for a non-gentleman, since you have released the goods you led out of the City for my silver to Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen, Iddin-abum's sons.

transliteration: 0.5 GÍN a-na GUDU₄

a-na en-na-nim ma-ma-ḫi-ir ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šùr-ma

translation: As to the textiles that Šar-Adad brings, of those 2 textiles for Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, belonging to me, have been sealed as a favour.

translation: 3.3333 textiles have been sealed for you.

translation: Send one of your servants before me.

translation: My dear brother and lord, send me word to inform me.

transliteration: šu-ma lá a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU du-dí-ki ma-ma-an ú-lá i-de₈-ú
translation: They do not know anyone other than Ali-ahum son of Dudiki.

translation: It is he who brings the tablet.

transliteration: a-ma-kam li-ni-dí
translation: and let it be deposited there.

transliteration: i-na … e-ma-… ú-šé-ra-a-ma i-ta-pu-lu-ni-šu
translation: ... I shall release, and they will balance it with him.

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim e-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šùr-ma
translation: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum, Enah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: a-dí ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma

transliteration: a-na kà-ri-im er-ba-ma bé-et-kà a-šu-ur-ma ù iš-tí me-er-e-kà zu-ku-ma qá-qá-ad-kà lá ta-ta-na-dí
translation: Enter the colony and bring your house in order, and then, clear the affairs with your sons and do not hang your head all the time.

transliteration: ki-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru-a a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim iš-lu-ṭù-ni-ma a-ṣé-er SIG₅-pí-a-šur lá e-tí-qú-ni-ma lu-qú-tí a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ú-ta-e-ru-ni a ší-a-tí li-bi im-ra-aṣ-ma
translation: Since my servants have acted high-handedly until this day and have not travelled to Damiq-pī-Aššur, and have not converted my goods to silver - for that reason I became worried,

transliteration: ki-ma ṣú-ba-tí sà-sà-am il₅-pu-tù um-ma a-na-ku-ma

translation: Let me enter with my goods and collect my assets, so that I may receive some 10 minas of silver that may be collected from my customers.

transliteration: a-na kà-ni-iš i bu-lá-tí-a le-ru-ba-am
translation: Let me enter Kanesh with my assets.

transliteration: a-ဦu-a a-t္-nu a-dအ ဧa a-za-ku-ဴ a-ma-kam iဧ-tအ ဧa ki-ma me-er-e um-me-a-nim ဧa a-ma-kam wa-အဧ-bu-ni a-we-li i-na a-wa-tim ma-qအ-ta-ma pအ-ဧu-nu li-im-dအ-nim-ma uဵ-me-e ဧa ဧa-kအ-nim li-iဧ-ku-nu-nim-ma a-na kအ-ri-im qအ-ri-ba-ni
translation: My dear brothers, until I clear myself, you there - together with the representatives of the affiliated traders who are staying there - should pester the men for the case, learn what they have to say and let them set terms, and make me approach the colony.

transliteration: i-be-sa-e ú ma-na-aḫ-tí šu-nu-ma i-dí-ú ù ba-lu-um um-me-a-ni-a
translation: They know the losses and the maintenance, but without permission from my investors.

transliteration: a-wa-tù-šu-nu ša šál-ma-a-šùr šu-bé-lúm ki-ma DAM i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im ra-bi-ṣum ù šu-be-lúm KI ša-lim-a-šur ni-iš a-lim(ki) it-mu-ú-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu gám-ra
translation: Their case concerning Šalim-Aššur - Šu-Bēlum for the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik and the daughter of Iddin-abum, the attorney and Šu-Bēlum swore an oath on the City with Šalim-Aššur and their case was concluded.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-a le-qé-ma a-šar ku-wa-tí li-ib-ší-ú
translation: "Take my tablets and let them be with you."

transliteration: šu-ma ṭup-pu-a a-šar ku-wa-tí i-ba-ší-ú ṭup-pu-a ku-nu-ki-a pè-té-ma 6 GÍN a-mu-tum ku-nu-ku ša DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in i-na qé-ra-áb ṭup-pè-a na-ad-a-at
translation: If my tablets are with you, then open my sealed tablets and see that six shekels of iron sealed by Puzur-Suen's son is placed with my tablets.

transliteration: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta DUMU um-me-a-ni-im ke-ni-im a-gu₅-ur-ma a-mu-tám a-ṣé-ri-a lu-ub-lu-nim
translation: My dear father and lord, hire a reliable agent and have him bring the iron to me.

transliteration: ù i-na ri-iš a-mu-tim ší-be šu-ku-un ki-ma a-šu-mì DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in a-mu-tám GÁN-lam₅ e-tí-qú
translation: Also, set witnesses for the iron, to the fact that it must pass overland in the name of Puzur-Suen's son.

transliteration: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu-um ke-nu-um lá ša ša-ḫa-tim i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a e-pu-lá-ni
translation: Here a reliable agent who is not to be feared guaranteed for my silver.

transliteration: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta a-dí en-um-a-šur úz-ni pè-té
translation: My dear father and lord, inform me with respect to Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: a-nu-pí-a ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr a-na ga-al-ga-li-a ù ḫa-ar-šú-nu-ma-an iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur, Anupiya seized us against Galgaliya and Haršumnuman.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-šú-nu iš-me-ú
translation: And they heard a tablet concerning 10 minas of silver, their debt.

transliteration: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma ṭup-pu-um la ku-nu-ku-kà
translation: Anupiya said: "Does the tablet not bear your seals?"

transliteration: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lu a-na šál-ma-a-šùr KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-qú-ul lu a-na me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr ta-áš-qú-ul a-na a-né-e-ma ru-a-am
translation: Anupiya said: "We are inheritors. Produce evidence for this, that you have paid the silver to Šalim-Aššur or to his sons."

transliteration: um-ma ḫa-ar-šú-nu-ma-an-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ša ṭup-pí-ni šál-ma-a-šùr ú-ša-bi
translation: Haršumnuman said: "I personally satisfied Šalim-Aššur with the silver of our tablet."

transliteration: um-ma dan-a-šur ša-lim-wa-ar-dí-e ú šu-nu-nu-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: i-na lu-qú-tim pá-ni-tim 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ šu-nu-nu ub-lá-kum
translation: In the previous shipment Šu-Nūnu brought you 3 talents of good copper.

transliteration: 1.5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ŠU.NÍGIN 4.5 GÚ x x x x x mu-šu [...]
translation: (plus) 1.5 talents of good copper—in all 4.5 talents...

transliteration: ša-lim-wa-ar-dí … ú šu-nu-nu i-ta-x x nim … a-dí lu-qú-tim ša a-ḫi-kà
translation: Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu ... concerning the goods of your brother.

transliteration: a-na-kam sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
translation: We seized Salliya here.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma na-áš-pé-er-ta-am a-lá-ḫu-im bi-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-ta-am lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
translation: He said: "Bring me a missive then I shall release the goods to you."

transliteration: a-na-kam a-dí ša a-ḫi-kà sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at
translation: Here we seized Salliya concerning your brother.

transliteration: um-ma né-nu-ma a-na kà-ni-iš pá-x … a-dí 10 u₄-me im-ta … a-ta ma-lá-kà
translation: We said: "To Kanesh ... within 10 days ..."; make up your mind.

transliteration: a-na 4 GÚ AN.NA a-wi-it e-l!-ma 4 ma-na 15 GÍN.TA da-tum 17 ma-na AN.NA ik-šu-sú
translation: On 4 talents of tin, the declared value of Elamma('s merchandise), the road-tax at 4 minas 15 shekels tin per talent amounted for him to 17 minas of tin.

transliteration: 5 ma-na AN.NA a-na ANŠE me-tim ku-na-a iš-ku-ni-a-tí
translation: 5 minas of tin Kunnāya charged us for a donkey that had died.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 7.5 GÍN a-na ta-ší-a-tim áš-qùl
translation: I paid 27.5 shekels of tin as costs of transport.

transliteration: 2 ma-na ú-ku-ul-tum 15 GÍN qá-qá-dum ik-šu-sú
translation: 2 minas of tin for food and fodder, the head-tax amounted for him to 15 shekels.

transliteration: ta-ší-a-at 10 TÙG.ḪI.A wa-at-ru-tim 1.5 ma-na AN.NA il₅-qé
translation: As costs of transport of 10 extra textiles he took 1.5 mina of tin.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-la-tù-šu
translation: 0.5 mina of silver was his working capital.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na pá-ni-šu tù-šé-bi₄-lu 10 GÍN.TA a-na AN.NA ŠA-dí-in-ma mì-ma a-nim ga-am-ru-um
translation: The 1/3 mina of silver you sent him en route was sold for tin at a rate of 10 shekels per mina, and this is the total of the expenses.

transliteration: 2.5 ma-na AN.NA ni-pu-ul-šu-um
translation: We made him a balance payment of 2.5 minas of tin.

transliteration: a-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR nu-ku-ra-im ù 1.5 ma-na AN.NA ta-ší-a-tim ša il₅-qé-ú da-ni-tí a-qá-bi₄-šu-um
translation: For the 5 shekels of silver that were disputed and the 1.5 mina of tin he took as transport costs I will state to him my harsh conditions.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sú-sá-a a-šu-mì a-al-DU₁₀ áš-qùl
translation: 23 shekels of silver I paid to Susāya on behalf of Āl-ṭāb.

transliteration: IGI en-na-nim na-pá-ḫ i-im IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU bu-ut-qí-im IGI a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim DUMU zu-ba
translation: In the presence of Ennānum the blacksmith, of Ennam-Aššur son of Butqum, and of Aššur-bēl-awātim son of Zuba.

transliteration: 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ša ší-im lu-qú-tim ša ṭ up-pì-a ḫ a-ar-mì-im na-áb-sú-in ù e-ri-mu-ša na-áš-ú-ni-ku-um
translation: Nab-Suen and Ewarimuša bring you 9 minas of refined silver under my seal, from the proceeds from the goods mentioned in my certified tablet.

transliteration: SAG.BA 1.5 ma-na 1.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ḫ u-sà-ri-im
translation: Therein, 1.5 mina 1.666 shekels of silver was the price of lapis lazuli.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 8.5 GÍN ḫ u-sà-ru-um a ší-mì-im ta-dí-in
translation: 0.5 mina 8.5 shekels of lapis lazuli was offered for sale.

transliteration: a-ḫ i a-ta be-li a-ta a-ša ak-lu-ú li-ba-kà lá tù-lá-ma-na-kum
translation: My dear brother and lord, do not let your heart be angry with me because I held back.

transliteration: a-we-lúm lá da-am-qú-um i-na e-ni-kà a-na ba-ú-ší-a i-za-az
translation: A man who is no good stands ready to defame me in your eyes.

transliteration: i lá i-dim URUDU 7 GÚ É kà-ri-im uš-ta-aṣ-bi₄-it
translation: For no reason he caused the colony to seize some 7 talents of copper.

transliteration: a-dí ki-zi ak-lá iš-tí kà-ri-im ú-ta-na-na-an-ma a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: I held back until... I keep imploring the colony, and I shall set out and come.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫ i-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-i-a-šur-ma ù MAN-a-šur
translation: To Ali-ahum, thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur:

transliteration: i-na ḫ a-ḫ i-im ú-nu-ut-ni nu-ša-li-ḫ a-ku-ni
translation: In Hahhum we set aside our goods for you.

transliteration: i-na za-al-pá ù a-na-kam ni-iš-ta-na-me-ma ḫ a-ra-an sú-ki-nim dan-na-at
translation: In Zalpa and here we keep hearing that the Narrow Track is difficult.

transliteration: lá na-ṭ ù-ma lá né-ra-áb
translation: It is not appropriate for us to enter.

transliteration: a-ḫ u-ni a-ta ki-ma AN.NA 10 ma-na x ù 10 TÙG
translation: Our dear brother, (see) if 10 minas of tin and 10 textiles...

transliteration: KIŠIB i-dí-(d)IM DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀
translation: Seal of Iddin-Adad son of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-…
translation: Seal of Šu...

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šur-…
translation: Seal of Aššur-...

transliteration: x x-šu-um … ša a-lu-lá-a … ša a-dí … x x … [...]
translation: ... to him ... of Alulaya ... until ...

transliteration: a-na šál-ma-a-šur KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫ ir
translation: To Šalim-Aššur; sealed by Man-mahir.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu-nu ú-ra-dí
translation: I have added 1.5 mina of copper to their account.

transliteration: i-šu-šu-um um-ma i-na-aḫ -DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul
translation: ...he has against him. Inah-ilī said: "Pay the silver!"

transliteration: a-we-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-x-qá-lá-ni
translation: The man wants to make me pay the silver.

transliteration: a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ik-ta-na-lu-ú-ni um-ma šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫ i-kà lá ta-ša-qá-al-ma lu-mu-ul-li-bi₄-im a-na a-ḫ i-kà lá ta-ra-ší
translation: Šu-Ištar and Ištar-lamassī keep holding me back here, saying: "Do not pay your brother's silver and incur his anger!"

transliteration: um-ma i-na-aḫ -DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na té-pu-uš-ma tù-ub-lam
translation: Inah-ilī said: "You have acquired and brought here some 10 minas of silver."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-lá ṭ up-pí-kà ḫ a-ar-mì-im šu-qú-ul
translation: Pay the silver in accordance with your certified tablet.

transliteration: šu-ma a-dí 10 u₄-me-e lá ta-tal-kam ú-lá tí-ir-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí lá i-tal-kam KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-na-aḫ -DINGIR a-ša-qal
translation: If you have not come within 10 days or sent word to your representatives, I shall pay the silver to Inah-ilī.

transliteration: [...] a-na-kam x … ù me-er-ú … ša-bu-ú x …
translation: ... here ... and the sons ... have been paid ...

transliteration: a-na ṭ up-pì-im ta-da-nim IGI ṣa-bi₄-im 10 a-šur-ma-lik e-pu-li-…
translation: In order to give a tablet, Aššur-malik answered me before 10 men...

transliteration: ṭ up-pá-am li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma iš-tí id-na-a šé-bi₄-lá-ni-šu šu-ma mì-ma [...] ù a-ṣé-er …
translation: Let him give you the tablet and give (it) to me and send it to me, if whatever [...] and to...

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na
translation: 2 shekels of silver are owed by Itū r-ilī son of Puzur-Anna.

transliteration: 2 ší-ni-šu ší-né-en ša wa-aḫ -šu-ša-na SIG₅ iš-tù wa-aḫ -šu-ša-na ú-šé-ba-lam
translation: He must send from Wahšušana two pairs of good shoes.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qá-lam
translation: If he has not sent them, he is to pay 6 shekels of silver.

transliteration: IGI kà-ba-tim DUMU a-šùr-GAL
translation: Witnessed by Kabātum son of Aššur-rabi.

transliteration: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU en-na-nim KIŠIB PUZUR₄-(d)IŠKUR DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
translation: Seal of Zuba son of Ennānum, seal of Puzur-Adad son of Iddin-Ištar.

transliteration: a-lá-bu-um DUMU zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
translation: Ali-abum son of Ziya was our companion.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-áš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: For these words the Kaneš colony made us available.

transliteration: ṭ up-pá-am IGI IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: This tablet we gave as our testimony rendered before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-ta-mu-zi e-la-a en-um-a-šùr DUMU e-la-ma ù lá-ma-sí a-na en-um-a-šùr
translation: Sealed by Šu-Tammuzī, Elaya, Ennam-Aššur son of Elamma and Lamassī; to Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: i-ri-šum da-dí-a iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma i-ri-šum-ma ig-ri ša 4 ANŠE.ḪI.A ša ta-as-ri-du KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-am
translation: Irišum seized Dādiya and Irišum said: "Give me the hire in silver for the 4 donkeys that you packed!"

transliteration: um-ma da-dí-a-ma a-ma ANŠE-ri sí-ri-id
translation: Dādiya answered: "There, pack the donkeys (yourself)!"

transliteration: um-ma i-ri-šum-ma a-dí ma-la ù ší-ni-šu e-ri-iš-kà-ma lá ta-dí-na-am
translation: Irišum said: "I have asked you once or twice, but you have not given it to me."

transliteration: ANŠE.ḪI.A-ri a-na sà-ra-dí-im ta-sà-na-li-a-ni
translation: You keep cheating me on the packing of the donkeys.

transliteration: ú-dí ANŠE.ḪI.A a-na 10 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-gu₅-ra-ku-um
translation: Yet I did rent the donkeys to you for 10 shekels of silver each.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-am
translation: Give me the silver.

transliteration: ú-ul i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà a-ṣa-ba-at
translation: Or I shall seize it from your silver.

transliteration: a-ma a-ta lu tí-de₈
translation: There, know this!"

transliteration: a-na da-da-a-a a-lá-ḫi-im ù (d)EN.LÍL-ba-ni qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
translation: To Dadaya, Ali-ahum and Illil-bāni from Puzur-Aššur:

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im li-iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí a-na (d)EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik šu-uq-lá-ma ṭup-pí šé-ṣí-a-ma li-it-a-ma a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im i-na li-bi-i ṭup-pé-e-a šu-uk-na
translation: Šu-hubur son of Iddin-abum should pay you 0.3333 mina 2 shekels of silver, and then pay this silver to Ilill-bāni son of Aššur-malik, obtain the release of my tablet, split it and place it with my other tablets with Ali-ahum.

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur ša-áš-qí-lá-ma ṭup-pí-i šé-ṣí-a-nim
translation: My dear brothers, take care to have Šu-hubur pay the silver and obtain the release of my tablet for me.

transliteration: 18 TÚG šu-ru-tim ù 10 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni 2 GÚ AN.NA ù li-wi-sú ku-nu-ki-šu ša a-lim(ki) 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me ú ú-nu-sú-nu ša a-lá-ḫi-im a-na a-šur-iš-tí-kál áp-qí-id
translation: 18 dark textiles and 10 kutānu-textiles, 2 talents of tin with its wrapping, under his seals applied in the City, 2 black donkeys with their harness belonging to Ali-ahum, I entrusted to Aššuriš-tikal.

transliteration: 16 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ŠÀ.BA 6 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ší-im KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ì-lí-dan a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ù a-lá-ḫu-um il₅-qé
translation: The attorney Ababa and Ali-ahum received 16 talents 13 minas of good copper; thereof 6 talents 40 minas of good copper, the price of silver - from Ilī-dan.

transliteration: [...] a-… lu-… DUMU … KÙ.BABBAR … ša … ku-nu-ki KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR ni-ip-qí-id
translation: ... sealed by Šalim-Aššur we entrusted to Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī.

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 7 ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
translation: Further, Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī received 7 minas 13 shekels of refined silver from Šalim-Aššur's silver.

transliteration: IGI ú-ra-a IGI pu-šu-ke-en₆
translation: Witnessed by Uraya, by Pūšu-kēn.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-a-am ki-ma šál-ma-a-šùr MAR.TU-ba-ni ù a-šùr-SIPA ip-qí-du
translation: Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-rē'ī entrusted this silver on behalf of Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša tám-kà-ri-im a-na i-li-a ù ša ki-ma lá-qé-ep
translation: 10 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, belonging to the merchant, for Iliya and the representatives of Lā-qēp.

transliteration: ù a-ḫa-ma 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ad-mì-iq-tí-šu ša i-li-a 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-ul-tù-šu a-na er-ra-ili₅
translation: And separately 0.3333 mina of silver from Iliya's free loan; 1 shekel of silver, his consignment for Erra-ilī.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša 3 (TÚG)e-pí-šé-e 3 GÍN šé-bu-ul-ta-ša a-na ší-ša-ra mì-ma a-nim ša lá-qé-ep
translation: 0.3333 mina of silver for 3 epīšum-textiles, 3 shekels of silver, her consignment for Šī-šarra, all this belonging to Lā-qēp.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na da-dí-a 0.33333 ma-na a-na en-nam-a-šur 0.33333 ma-na a-na a-šur-re-ṣí 3 GÍN a-na a-šur-re-ṣí
translation: 0.6666 mina of silver for Dadiya, 0.3333 mina for Ennam-Aššur, 0.3333 mina for Aššur-rēṣī, (and) 3 shekels for Aššur-rēṣī.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 4 ri-ik-sú ša e-lá-ma mì-ma a-nim ša lá-qé-ep a-na šu-be-lim áp-qí-id
translation: In all 4 packets of Elamma, all this belonging to Lā-qēp I entrusted to Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-na-da DUMU a-šùr-i-dí IGI šu-su-in DUMU šu-ḫu-bu-ur
translation: In the presence of Aššur-nādā, son of Aššur-idī, (and) of Šu-Suen, son of Šu-hubur.

transliteration: a-na a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma id-na-a-ma
translation: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Idnaya.

transliteration: áš-ta-na-me-ma a-na ší-ip-ru-tim a-lá-ḫu-um a ša da-me-e i-lá-ak
translation: I keep hearing that Ali-ahum will function as envoy in the case of blood-money.

transliteration: šu-ma a-ḫi a-ta a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a KÙ.BABBAR 5 GÍN ni-iq-a-am ša-ar-ší-a-ni-ma
translation: If you are truly my brother, provide me with some 5 shekels of silver as sacrifice in addition to my silver.

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta e-né-kà i-na GÁN-lim me-at bi-re-e a-ta-mar
translation: My dear brother, I shall constantly see your eyes from a hundred miles away.

transliteration: ni-iq-a-am ša-ar-ší-ma-e IGI IŠTAR kà-ki-bi₄-im i-li-ni lá-ak-ru-ba-am
translation: Provide me with a sacrifice and I shall pray to Ištar-the-Star, our god.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma mì-nam ša a ší-ip-ru-tim ta-am-gu₅-ru-ni
translation: To Ali-ahum: Why have you agreed to service as envoy?

transliteration: i-dí-in me-xxx lá ta-áš-qú-ul a kà-ri-im xx x tù-dí lá ak x bi
translation: According to the verdict of ... you have not paid ... to the colony ...

transliteration: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi₄ i-ku-nu šu-IŠTAR i-šu
translation: 1 mina and 10 shekels of refined silver are owed by Ikūnu(m) to Šu-Ištar.

transliteration: IGI a-da-da DUB.SAR IGI im-li-kà-a
translation: Witnessed by Adada, the scribe, and by Imlikaya.

transliteration: 1 (TÚG)ku-sí-tám a-ḫa-ma e-zi-ib-šu-ma
translation: 1 kusītu-textile, separately, I left to him.

transliteration: um-ma ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma a-na ša ki-ma en-um-a-šur-ma 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL ḫa-bu-lam
translation: Mannum-balum-Aššur said to Ennam-Aššur's representative: 'Puzur-Anna son of Šu-Illil owes me 4 minas of silver.

transliteration: PUZUR₄-a-na GÁN-lam i-lá-ak-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma ša-zi-za-am ša KÙ.BABBAR-pí-i-kà
translation: Since Puzur-Anna would go overland, I said: 'Appoint someone responsible to me for your silver.'

transliteration: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma ma-nam lu-šá-zi-za-ku-um
translation: Puzur-Anna answered: 'Who shall I appoint for you?

transliteration: a-ma ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL le-qé-ma qá-at-kà lu šá-ak-na-at-ma a-šùr-ták-lá-ku šá-áš-qí-il₅-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú le-qé-ma
translation: Here, take a certified tablet worth 5 minas of silver, the debt of Aššur-taklāku son of Šu-Illil, lay claim to it and make Aššur-taklāku pay, take the silver and the accrued interest paid.

transliteration: ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku
translation: And then I personally shall take the silver.

transliteration: 3 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša i-ku-pí-IŠTAR DUMU i-ku-a-a a-na ì-lí-a-LIM DUMU sú-kà-li-a áp-qí-id
translation: Three minas of tin under the seals of Ikūn-pī-Ištar, son of Ikū'aya I entrusted to Ilī-ālum, son of Sukkalliya,

transliteration: IGI šu-ku-bi-im DUMU qá-a-tim IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
translation: in the presence of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum (and) of Aššur-mālik, son of Ali-ahum.

transliteration: 7 ma-na AN.NA ša ku-ni-lim a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bi-il₅
translation: Seven minas of tin belonging to Kūn-ilum Aššur-ṭāb brought away.

transliteration: um-ma a-šur-ma-sú-wi-ma a-na a-šur-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma
translation: From Aššur-massu'ī to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur;

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma DAM a-šùr-na-da lu-ṭá-ib-kà
translation: specifically to Ennam-Aššur: Aššur-nādā should satisfy you with regard to the wife.

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na lu-bu-ší-ša ù ep-ri-ša a-na mu-lá i-ta-dí-ší-im
translation: Give regularly 5 shekels of silver for her clothes and her provisions to Mula.

transliteration: a-ma ša šé-bu-lim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-um-ma KÙ-áp-kà šu-ta-bi
translation: I shall send what there is to send to you, so you can be satisfied with the silver you are entitled to.

transliteration: ṭup-pì-a ša-ṣí-ir
translation: Guard my tablets.

transliteration: té-er-ta-kà za-ku-tám iš-tù a-lim a-šá-pá-ra-kum
translation: I shall send you a complete report from the City.

transliteration: šu-be-lúm DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU da-da iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum seized us in his case against Puzur-Ištar son of Dada,

transliteration: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma 16 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-bi-a ḫa-bu-lá-tí
translation: and Šu-Bēlum said to Puzur-Ištar: You owe 16 minas of silver and its interest to my father.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú im-tí-da-kum 1 ma-na-um 0.33333 ma-na i ša-tim tù-ṣa-áb
translation: The silver and the interest on it has become a great sum for you: You pay 0.3333 mina per mina per year as interest.

transliteration: um-ma PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma a-bu-kà maš-ke-e il₅-ta-qé-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu
translation: Puzur-Ištar answered: 'Your father has already received hides so he has been paid the silver.'

transliteration: ki-ma šu-bé-lim nu-ší-ib-ma ni-iš a-lim(ki) it-mu-ú-ma a-na 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-mì-ig-ru
translation: We sat down (to negotiate) on behalf of Šu-Bēlum and they swore an oath by the City and agreed on 6 minas of silver.

transliteration: IGI ni-mar-IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr a-šùr-na-da DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL tap-pá-i-ni
translation: Witnessed by Nimar-Ištar, by Ennam-Aššur; Aššur-nādā son of Šu-Illil is our partner.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: 8 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im ku-la i-šu
translation: Iddin-abum owes 8 minas of refined silver to Kula.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫa-pì-aḫ-šu ù sú-kà-lí-a a-na 25 ḫa-am-šá-tim a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak-ma iš-tí um-me-a-ni-šu 2 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì ku-lá i-lá-pá-at
translation: Reckoned from the week of Happiahšu and Sukkalliya he must go to the City within 25 weeks and together with his investors he must book Kula's name for 2 minas of gold.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu a-na a-lim(ki) lá i-ta-lá-ak KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku lá i-šá-qal
translation: If he has not left for the City within his stipulated term, he must repay the silver to Kula.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na 1 ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he has not paid (in time), he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI i-dí-sú-in
translation: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni, by Iddin-Suen.

transliteration: KIŠIB i-pí-lí-is KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-sú KIŠIB la-qé-pí-im ša e-la-ma ù id-na-a ma-aḫ-ri-ni ni-kà-sé i-sí-ú-ma
translation: Seal of Ippilis, seal of Aššur-nādā, son of Amur-ilūssu, seal of Lā-qēpum, that Elamma and Idnāya settled accounts in our presence (with the following result):

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ù 13.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-lí-bi na-a
translation: 35 shekels of refined silver and 13.5 minas of refined copper are due by Idnāya.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša am-ri-a ù e-lá-lí ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-ak-šum
translation: They become interest-bearing for him at the rate stipulated by the colony from the week-eponymy of Amriya and Elālī.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tum pá-ni-tum 0.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR gám-ru-um ša iš-ta-pu-ru-šu-ni i li-bi₄-šu-ma
translation: 1.5 mina of silver, an earlier interest, (and) 0.83333 mina of silver, expenses, about which he wrote him repeatedly, he also owes.

transliteration: 10.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li tù-mì-li-a-i-im a-lā-ḫu-um i-šu
translation: Alili, the man from Tumlia, owes 10.75 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im 1 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ú-ṣa-áb
translation: Reckoned from the week of the kassum-official he will pay interest at the rate of 1 shekel per month.

transliteration: ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-kà-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šùr-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im
translation: Month Bēlat-ekallim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī, the skipper.

transliteration: IGI wa-al-dí-DINGIR IGI i-na-ar
translation: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

transliteration: 36 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ša ì-lí-dan ša i-na É ir-i-bi₄-im i-ba-ší-ú en-um-a-šur iṣ-ba-at
translation: Ennam-Aššur has seized 36 talents of wool belonging to Ilī-dan that was in Ir’ibum's house.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma lá tù-šar
translation: He said: You must not release it.

transliteration: tù-šar-ma i-na É-tí …
translation: If you release it, in the house...

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na … KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um KI a-we-lá-tim
translation: 0.3333 mina ... of refined silver is owed by the ladies.

transliteration: 22 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-er a-al-DU₁₀ ša tù-ùḫ-pì-a a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-šu
translation: 22 minas of copper Āl-ṭāb from Tuhpiya owes to Āl-ṭāb, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: IGI (d)IŠKUR-ba-ni lá-qé-ep URUDU a-na mì-šu-GAL iš-qú-ul
translation: In the presence of Adad-bāni La-qēp paid the copper to Mīšur-rabi.

transliteration: a-na a-šur-re-ṣí da-dí-a ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
translation: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur, thus Elamma:

transliteration: 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a dan-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Dān-Aššur is on his way to you with 24 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seals.

transliteration: šu-ma AN.NA 15 GÍN.TA ù e-li-iš 2 GÚ AN.NA ša-ma-nim
translation: If the rate of the tin is 15:1 or even more, then buy 2 talents of tin;

transliteration: šu-ma la ki-a-am ku-ta-nim ša-ma-ni-im
translation: if not, then buy kutānu-textiles.

transliteration: 11.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR (TÚG)lu-bu-šé ra-qá-tim ù šu-lu-up-ki-e ša ma-nim-ma iš-tí pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-la-nim
translation: Use 11.66666 minas of silver to buy lubušu-garments, thin textiles and Šulupkian ones and send them with the first available caravan.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-la-at be-lúm-ba-ni šu-ut-ma na-ší
translation: Half a mina of silver, the working capital of Bēlum-bāni, he himself has with him.

transliteration: šu-ma i-nu-mì lu-qú-tum a-ni-tum ú-ṣí-a-ni u₄-mu-ú kà-ṣú a-bu-ša-lim iš-tí ma-ma-an i-na a-ḫe-ni ša ú-ša-lá-ma-šu-nu pì-iq-da-šu-ma lu-ṣa-am
translation: If, when this merchandise leaves, the weather is cool, then entrust Abu-šalim to the care of one of our brothers who will bring them here safely, then he can leave.

transliteration: šu-ma u₄-mu-ú e-mu-ú la ú-ṣí-a-am
translation: If the weather is hot he must not leave.

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-bi₄-a a-na dan-a-šur a-dín
translation: I gave 5 shekels of silver of my votive offering to Dān-Aššur.

transliteration: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU e-dí-na-a KIŠIB i-ri-ší-im DUMU a-mur-(d)UTU KIŠIB (d)UTU.DU₁₀ DUMU am-ri-a
translation: Seal of Ikūn-pīya son of Eddinaya, seal of Irišum son of Amur-Šamaš, seal of Šamaš-ṭāb son of Amriya.

transliteration: x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er (d)UTU.DU₁₀ ḫu-dí-da tí-šu
translation: Šamaš-ṭāb owes x minas of refined silver to Hudida.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša pu-šu-ke-en₆ ù PUZUR₄-a-šur a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
translation: Reckoned from the week of Pūšu-kēn and Puzur-Aššur he must pay within 3 weeks.

transliteration: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um e-lá-lí
translation: Month Ṣip'um, eponymy Elāli.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im
translation: The silver belongs to a merchant.

transliteration: a-na dam-qá-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-at-a-na-ma
translation: To Damqaya from Šāt-Anna:

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: You wrote concerning the 10 shekels of silver that I gave to you, saying:

transliteration: iš-tí ša bé-ú-lá-tí-a ší-ma-am áš-a-ma a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-bi-il₅
translation: "I made purchases together with the money from my working capital and sent it to Purušhaddum."

transliteration: ší-ma-am ša té-pu-šu a-na a-lim(ki) ṭá-ba-tum-ma šé-bi-lam
translation: Be so kind as to send the purchase you made to the City,

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta ú a-na-ku ga-ma-al-kà
translation: for you are my brother and I can do you favors.

transliteration: KIŠIB pá-ru-ur-tim
translation: Seal of Parrurtum;

transliteration: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU na-ar-me-a
translation: to Iddin-abum son of Narmea.

transliteration: x GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A x 5 maš-ku x 22 na-ru-qá-tum 4 ANŠE ṣa-la-mu 3.TA ú-kà-pu ù ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim a-na e-wa-ri-mu-ša a-dín
translation: x talents of wool, x + 5 hides, x + 22 sacks, 4 black donkeys, 3 saddle-rugs for each, plus their harness - all this I gave to Ewarimuša.

transliteration: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu a-dín
translation: 4 shekels of silver I gave to him for his disposal.

transliteration: IGI ib-ni-(d)IM IGI a-šur-e-mu-qí DUMU ku-zi-zi-a
translation: In the presence of Ibni-Adad and Aššur-emūqī son of Kuzizia.

transliteration: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma dan-a-šur ù ša-lim-wa-rdí-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur and Šalim-wardī to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 2 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ dan-a-šur iš-qú-ul-ni-a-tí
translation: Dan-Aššur has paid us 2 talents of good copper.

transliteration: 3 ša-áb-ra-tim lá iš-bi-ir-ma
translation: He did not break the 3 blocks,

transliteration: 15 GÍN ša-qá-lá-am qá-bi
translation: and he promised to pay 15 shekels.

transliteration: nu-ša-aḫ-li-il₅
translation: We filtered (the copper).

transliteration: ṭup-pu-šu šé-bi-lam
translation: Send his tablet.

transliteration: 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i ší-im AN.NA-kà ù TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà 5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-ni šu-nu-nu na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Šu-Nūnu brings you 3 talents of good copper from the proceeds from your tin and your textiles, (in all) 5 talents of good copper under our seals.

transliteration: URUDU ša ki-ma sá-li-a né-ri-iš-ma ta-dá-na-am lá i-mu-ú
translation: We asked for copper from Salliya's representatives but they would not give it.

transliteration: a-du-um lu-lá-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni lu-lá-um lá-šu
translation: As to the antimony you wrote about, there is no antimony.

transliteration: a-dí 5 u₄-me ša-lim-wa-rdí i-za-ku-ma ni-ṭá-ra-dam
translation: Within 5 days Šalim-wardī will be cleared and we shall send him.

transliteration: 3 ma-na URUDU a qá-tí-šu ni-dín
translation: We gave him 3 minas of copper to dispose of.

transliteration: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a
translation: Seal of Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikūn-pīya,

transliteration: KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur
translation: seal of Dān-Aššur, son of Puzur-Aššur,

transliteration: KIŠIB pè-ru-a DUMU šu-up-ip-ra
translation: seal of Peruwa, son of Šuppibra,

transliteration: KIŠIB pè-ru-a DUMU a-ra-wa
translation: seal of Peruwa, son of Arawa,

transliteration: KIŠIB za-ba DUMU ḫa-nu
translation: seal of Zaba, son of Hanu,

transliteration: KIŠIB lu-lu DUMU ḫa-bi
translation: seal of Lullu, son of Hapi,

transliteration: lu-lu DUMU ḫa-bi ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí DAM ku-ni-lim e-ḫu-zu
translation: Lullu, son of Hapi, who had married Ištar-lamassī, wife of Kūn-ilum.

transliteration: iš-tù a-wi-il₅-tum me-ta-at-ni a-wa-tù-šu-nu i-gi₅-im-ra-ma lu gám-ra-am
translation: After the lady had died, their affairs were settled and for the full amount

transliteration: ša a-na a-wi-il₅-tum ig-mu-ru lu a-na ì-lí-a ša a-na ki-šar-ší-im i-ni-id-ú
translation: spent for the lady or for Iliya, who had been thrown into jail,

transliteration: lu-lu gám-ra-am ig-mu-ru lu ša a-wi-il₅-tum lu a ša ì-lí-a
translation: for which Lullu paid the expenses, whether for the lady or for Iliya,

transliteration: a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu a-na me-er-e ḫa-ni-im lu-lu DUMU ḫa-be lá i-tù-ar
translation: Lullu, son of Hapi, will not raise any claims against the sons of Hanum for anything whatsoever.

transliteration: 8 GÚ 16.5 GÍN AN.NA a-wi-it i-dí-sú-in
translation: 8 talents 16.5 shekels of tin the declared value of Iddin-Suen's merchandise.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 41 ma-na 15 GÍN AN.NA qá-dì ša ú-ku-ul-tim
translation: Thereof: 41 minas 15 shekels of tin, including expenses for fodder.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù tí-mì-il₅-ki-a ANŠE i-mì-ḫi-iṣ-ma áš-qúl
translation: 2 shekels of silver and 2 shekels of tin I paid from Timilkiya because a donkey suffered a stroke.

transliteration: 6 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma a-dí kà-ni-iš áš-qúl
translation: 6 shekels of tin I paid from Hurama until Kanesh.

transliteration: 3.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na tí-ib-nim i-na kà-ni-eš áš-qúl
translation: 3 3/4 shekels of silver I paid in Kanesh for straw.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-mì i-dí-sú-in áš-qúl
translation: All this I paid in the name of Iddin-Suen.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 34.5 ma-na AN.NA a qá-tí-a i-dí-nu-nim
translation: Thereof 34.5 minas of tin they had given me for my disposal,

transliteration: 3.6666600000000003 ma-na 7 GÍN.TA bi-il₅-tám ik-šu-dam
translation: which amounted to 3 minas 47 shekels per talent.

transliteration: PUZUR₄-a-šùr ù ir-ma-a-šur i-na a-lim(ki) iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Puzur-Aššur and Ir'am-Aššur seized us in the city.

transliteration: um-ma ir-ma-a-šùr-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr-ma
translation: Ir'am-Aššur said to Puzur-Aššur:

transliteration: ṭup-pé-a i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ta-áp-té-ma
translation: "You gained access to my tablets in Wahšušana,

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša pí-lá-ḫa-a-nim DUMU da-nu-um-ì-lí tal-qé
translation: and you took a tablet of 45 shekels of silver of Pilahānum, son of Dannum-ilī,

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-as-kà-nu-i-il₅ tal-qé
translation: and you took a tablet of 15 shekels of silver of Kaskanu'il."

transliteration: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma ke-na al-qé
translation: Puzur-Aššur answered: "Indeed, I took them."

transliteration: ša-zu-uz-ti a-ta ù PUZUR₄ (d)UTU DUMU šu-nu-nu ší-sí-a
translation: You, as my representative, and Puzur-Šamaš, son of Šu-Nunu, summon me!

transliteration: lá-lik-ma me-eḫ-ri-a ù ta-aḫ-sí-sà-ti-a lá-mur-ma
translation: Then I will go and inspect my copies and my memos.

transliteration: xx-nim-ma xxxxxx x xxxx-lá DUMU šu-nu-nu na-áš-a-kum
translation: ... ... the son of Šu-Nunu is bringing to you.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er x ma-na 1.3333300000000001 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na ú-ra-da-ma ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-ma
translation: To your x minas 1.3333 shekels of silver I will add 1 mina and send it to you.

transliteration: ù i-na e-lá-i-kà lu ni-iz-ku
translation: And when you come here, we must clear accounts.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-ma
translation: For these words the Kanesh colony made me available,

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-dín
translation: and before the dagger of Aššur I gave my testimony.

transliteration: IGI bu-za-zu DUMU pu-šu-ki-in

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a tù-um-li-a-i-am nam-gi₅-ra-ma mì-iš-lá-at KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a le-qé-a-nim
translation: My dear brothers, reach an agreement with the man from Tumliya and take my share of the silver.

transliteration: ṣí-ba-tám lá-šu-ma
translation: I do not need the interest.

transliteration: ú-lá ma-ma-an ša-ni-am nam-gi₅-ra-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša nam-gu₅-ru-ni le-qé-a-ma tù-um-li-a-i-im e-li-it-ma
translation: Or reach an agreement with someone else and take the agreed amount in silver, and let the man from Tumliya be responsible for this.

transliteration: be-lu-a a-tù-nu a-dí lá-qé-im na-áp-ší-a-ni
translation: My dear lords, save me while I can still be saved.

transliteration: šu-ma a-dí-da a-ma-kam i-li-kam i-na i-ḫi-id-ma iš-tí … sú-ḫa-ri-a ṭur₄-da-ní-šu
translation: If Adida has arrived there, take care to send him with ... my servants.

transliteration: … ší-it-tám …
translation: ... the balance ...

transliteration: 8.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im É-tí-šu a-šùr-mì-tí a-na sú-ub-ri-ga iš-qú-ul
translation: 8.1666 shekels of silver, the price of his house, Aššur-imittī paid to Subriga.

transliteration: šu-ma ma-ma-an a-na É-tí-im i-tù-wa-ar 0.33333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sú-ub-ri-ga a-na a-šùr-mì-tí i-ša-qal
translation: If anybody claims the house, Subriga will pay 22.5 shekels of silver to Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: IGI ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr IGI sí-ki-le-i IGI IR
translation: In the presence of Uṣur-ša-Aššur, of Sikile'i, and of Wardum.

transliteration: a-pu-tum ri-iš lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR ša-ṣí-ir
translation: Urgent, guard the goods of the merchant;

transliteration: ú a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà um-ma a-ta-ma ṣú-ba-tù an-ḫu-tum i-ba-ší-ú
translation: and with regard to your message where you said: "There are some old textiles"

transliteration: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-i ta-ša-me-ú i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im ša ib-ri-im a-ta ú i-lá-áš-ra-ni ṣú-ba-tí kà-lá-šu-nu-ma na-pí-ša-ma
translation: urgent, the very day you hear my letter you and Ilī-ašrannī should air all of the textiles in the store-room of a friend,

transliteration: 3 u₄-me-e ú 5 u₄-me-e li-bi-ší-ú-ma šu-ta-áb-lá-ki-ta-šu-nu
translation: and leave them for 3 or 5 days before you turn them over.

transliteration: ma-ma-an ša-ni-am lá tù-ṭá-ḫa-a
translation: Do not let anyone else approach (them).

transliteration: a-dí 10 u₄-me-e lá ta-ḫa-ta-ar
translation: Do not hesitate for 10 days!

transliteration: a-ṣé-er e-ni-ša-ri-im a-dí AN.NA-ki-kà ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR áš-ta-pá-ar
translation: I have sent Uṣur-ša-Ištar to Enišārum concerning your tin.

transliteration: iš-tù za-al-pá i-tù-ru-nim a-lá-ḫum a-ṭá-ra-dam
translation: When they come back from Zalpa, I shall send Ali-ahum.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú ša 3 GÍN sà-bi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-a ili₅-tù-ra-am ú-šé-bi₄-lá-kum-ma
translation: I sent Ilī-tūram to you with 0.5 mina of refined silver and small goods worth 3 shekels under my seal,

transliteration: 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-kà id-na-a ú a-lu-wa na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: and Idnaya and Aluwa are bringing you 17 shekels of silver under my seal, the proceeds from your textiles.

transliteration: e-ma-ru-kà lu ak-lu
translation: Your donkeys should be fed.

transliteration: KIŠIB a-šur-dan DUMU i-ku-pì-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR KIŠIB a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU ḫu-li-a
translation: Seal of Aššur-dān, son of Ikūn-pīya, seal of Iddin-abum, son of Itūr-ilī, seal of Aššur-taklāku, son of huliya.

transliteration: 30 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A na-ar-ba-tim xxxx-tim ša-kà-ki-iš i-ṣé-er a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU ḫu-li-a lá-ma-sà-tum tí-šu
translation: 30 minas of soft wool for making the weft Aššur-taklāku, son of huliya, owes to Lamassutum.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-qá a-na ITU.2.KAM ú-šé-ba-lam
translation: He will send it from haqa within two months.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ú-uš-té-bi₄-lam-ma a É a-lim(ki) i-ta-lá-ak i-na tù-wa-ri-šu 1 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A na-ar-ba-tim ša-kà-ki-iš i-ša-qal
translation: If he has not sent it and has departed for the City, he will weigh out on his return one talent of soft wool for making the weft.

transliteration: ITU.1.KAM ku-zal-lu li-mu-um a-šur-na-da DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na
translation: Month XI, Kuzallu, eponymy of Aššur-nādā, son of Puzur-Anna.

transliteration: um-ma ir-ma-a-šùr-ma a-na i-ku-pì-a-šùr lá-ma-sà-tim ú en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus Ir'am-Aššur, say to Ikūn-pī-Aššur, Lamassutum and Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a ša sú-en₆-na-da a-ma-kam a-na šu-lá-ba-an ú ku-ra-ra dí-na-šu
translation: 1 mina of silver under my seals, belonging to Suen-nādā, you must give there to Šu-Labān and Kurara

transliteration: ú ší-bé šu-uk-na ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša sú-en₆-na-da il₅-qé-ú-ni
translation: and you must set witnesses that they received Suen-nādā's silver.

transliteration: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR ku-nu-ku-a a-na ṣé-er a-šur-GAL (d)EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU ḫa-na-nim ú-šé-bi-lam
translation: With 3 minas of silver of the trader, under my seals, I sent Ellil-bāni, son of hannānum, to Aššur-rabi.

transliteration: a-ša-me-ma a-dí-ni a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb
translation: I hear that he is still staying there

transliteration: šu-ma a-na pá-ni a-šur-GAL lá i-li-ik KÙ.BABBAR pu-uṭ-ra-ma AN.NA lu 9 GÍN.TA lu ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni ša-ma-ma (d)EN.LÍL-ba-ni ú (d)UTU-e-nam KI a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma ṭur₄-da-nim
translation: and if he has indeed not left to meet Aššur-rabi, then unpack the silver and buy for me tin at 9 shekels per (shekel of silver) or as favorably as you can and send Ellil-bāni and Šamaš-ennam here with the first caravan.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ṭup-pé-a ša a-na i-na-a DUMU e-lá-lí en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU šu-IŠTAR ú a-šur-ma-lik DUMU qá-a-tim KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫi-ib-lu KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lá-šu-nu-tí ša-bu-ú
translation: As for my tablets recording that I became indebted for silver to Innāya, son of Elālī, to Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Ištar and to Aššur-mālik, son of Qa'ātum, I have sent them the silver, they are satisfied.

transliteration: ṭup-pé-a iš-tí lá-ma-sà-tim i-ba-ší-ú lu ma-ma-an i-na ša-zu-uz-tí-a ú-kà-al-šu-nu
translation: Are my tablets with Lamassutum or does someone from my representatives have them in his possession?

transliteration: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí
translation: I have written you several times.

transliteration: mì-šu-um ma-tí-ma té-er-ta-ku-nu lá i-li-kam-ma úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí-
translation: Why has no report of yours ever reached me and do you not keep me informed?

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR ú zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum, Uṣur-ša-Ištar and Zukuwa from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: 15 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR ú ṣí-li-a na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: Uṣur-ša-Ištar and Ṣilliya bring you 15 minas of tin under my seal.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 5 ma-na AN.NA ik-ri-bu ša a-šur
translation: Of that 5 minas of tin are votive offerings for Aššur.

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni la-ma ILLAT-tum e-ru-ba-ni AN.NA-ki a-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im dí-na-ma
translation: My dear brothers, sell my tin for refined silver as well as you can before the caravan arrives,

transliteration: ší-im 5 ma-na AN.NA ša ik-ri-be KÙ.BABBAR lu ša-li-iṭ
translation: and the proceeds from the 5 minas of tin from the votive offering must be available in silver.

transliteration: a ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a pì-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim wa-as-mu-tim ša-ma-ma li-ib-ší
translation: Buy pirikannu-textiles, soft and pleasant, for the rest of my silver and let them be.

transliteration: šu-ma pì-ri-kà-nu lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-ki-šu li-ib-ší
translation: If there are no pirikannu-textiles, then let the silver remain under seal.

transliteration: um-ma bu-zu-a DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur ú a-lá-bu-um-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: From Buzuwa, Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur and Ali-abum to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

transliteration: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-ku-nu TÚG-ṣú-ba-tí-ku-nu nu-na-pì-iš-ma TÚG-ṣú-ba-tù-ku-nu šál-mu
translation: In accordance with your instructions we aired your textiles and your textiles are in order.

transliteration: 4 ku-ta-ni 12 ša a-ki-dí-e ku-nu-ki ša šál-ma-a-šùr ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: Your servants are bringing you 4 kutānu-textiles and 12 Akkadian ones sealed by Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: 2 ku-ta-ni 1 ša a-ki-dí-e 1 ra-qá-tám a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà a-na a-lá-bi₄-im ú i-dí-a-šùr ni-ip-qí-id
translation: We entrusted 2 kutānu-textiles, 1 Akkadian one and 1 thin textile to Ali-abum and Iddin-Aššur in accordance with your instructions.

transliteration: ší-tí TÚG-ba-tí-kà 14 mu-ta-tum 2 e-li-té-en ku-nu-ki ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ú ša-lim-wa-ar-dí
translation: The rest of your textiles: 14 half-packs and 2 top-packs sealed by Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī.

transliteration: DINGIR-pì-lá-aḫ lá-šu-ma a-na DAM DINGIR-pì-lá-aḫ IGI 3 me-er-e um-mì-a-ni ni-ip-qí-id-ma
translation: Ilī-pilah is not here so we entrusted them to Ilī-pilah's wife witnessed by 3 affiliated traders.

transliteration: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni SÍG.ḪI.A ni-iš-a-ma-kum
translation: For 1 mina of silver that you sent we bought wool for you.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 4.25 GÍN it-ba-al
translation: It cost 0.6666 mina 4 1/4 shekels.

transliteration: 5 pá-li-lu 10.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
translation: 5 palilu-textiles cost 10.6666 shekels of silver.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ma-kam lu pá-li-li lu SÍG.ḪI.A ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: The rest of your silver is 5 shekels of silver; your servants there bring you both the palilu-textiles and the wool.

transliteration: … a-šar TÚG-tù-kà ša-ak-nu-ni a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu a pá-lá-ší-im i-zi-iz-ma a-ta ma-lá-kà
translation: Wherever your textiles were placed, he stood ready once or twice to make a break-in; make up your own mind.

transliteration: … i-ḫi-id-
translation: Take care and make a decision concerning your entrusted goods.

transliteration: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: Why did you write me as follows:

transliteration: AN.NA a-na ni-ip-lá-tim al-qé-ma 7 GÍN.TA a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pá-i a-dí-in
translation: 'I took the tin as balance payment and I have promised a rate of 7 shekels to 1 in silver.'

transliteration: AN.NA-kam tù-ub-lá-šu-ma tù-pá-ṭé-er-šu tù-BA-li-ih
translation: You the tin and unpacked it, you have ... ...

transliteration: šu-ma a-ta AN.NA a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-lá-qé-am mì-šum sú-re té-ta-na-pá-áš-ma
translation: If you want to take tin for silver why do you keep practicing deceit,

transliteration: ša tù-BA-li-hu li-bi₄ ú-lá ma-ri-iṣ
translation: so that I cannot fail to be angry because you have ... ...

transliteration: ù a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša té-ri-šu-ni li-bi₄ ú-lá ma-ri-iṣ
translation: and angry too about the silver that you requested?

transliteration: mì-šum TÚG ša a-ha-tí a-na li-ta-áb-ší-a tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni ta-ak-lá
translation: Why have you held back the garment my sister had sent me to wear?

transliteration: ù (TÚG)lu-bé-ri ša ta-ak-lu-ú šé-bi₄-lam
translation: Send me also the garments that you held back.

transliteration: x a-ta-al-kam-ma xx KÙ xxxx
translation: then leave and come here ...

transliteration: [...] ù … 4 x … ša té-zi-bu … ku-nu-ku-šu-nu …
translation: ... 4 ... which you left behind ... their seals ...

transliteration: ù ša ka-sà-tim ša DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr ù 1 …
translation: and those of the cups of Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur and one ...

transliteration: a-bi-we-du DUMU x … i-ra-dí-a-ku-um
translation: Abī-wedu(m), son of ... is leading to you.

transliteration: ší-tí lu-qú-tim ša a-pí-im lá-ta-ra-ak iṣ-ba-at
translation: [The rest?] of the merchandise Latarak seized in Apum.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tim da-na-am al-qé-ma
translation: I ac[quired] a powerful tablet of the El[ders]

transliteration: ù ší-ip-ra-am áš-pu-ur-ma lu-qú-tám ú-ší-ir-ma a-bi-we-du i-ra-dí-a-ku-um
translation: and I sent a messenger and so obtained [the release of] the merchandise, which Abī-wedu is now bringing to you.

transliteration: 11 GÍN … x-… … nu-ta-e-er
translation: 11 shekels [of silver ...] ... we gave back.

transliteration: a-hi a-ta a-šu-mì (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni pá-ší-ri-a ù KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ša ú-na-hi-du-kà
translation: Please, my brother, as for Amurrum-bāni, my retail agent and the price of my textiles for which I called your attention,

transliteration: x x ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi-i šál-ma-a-šur … x a-pu-tum i-x …
translation: [and the ...] mina(s) 3 shekels of silver owed by Šalim-Aššur ... please ...

transliteration: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-nu-mì ku-da-tum a-na a-lim(ki) i-li-ku ak-ru-ub-šum
translation: When Kudātum went to the City I dedicated 4 shekels of silver as a blessing for him.

transliteration: KIŠIB DINGIR-tap-pá-a DUMU id-na-a KIŠIB a-ba-ta-na-nim DUMU a-šur-UTU-ši KIŠIB i-di-sú-in DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀
translation: [Seal of Ilī-tap]pā, son of Idnāya, seal of Abatanānum, son of Aššur-šamšī, seal of Iddin-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: xx GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-ba-ta-na-nim e-lá-ma i-šu
translation: [x she]kels of refined silver Abatanānum owes to Elamma.

transliteration: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-nu li-mu-um DINGIR-šu-GAL DUMU ba-zi-a
translation: Month V, eponymy of Ilšu-rabi, son of Baziya.

transliteration: a-na x ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
translation: [Within x] weeks he shall pay;

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ú-ṣa-áb
translation: if he does not pay he will add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

transliteration: 3 GÚ URUDU ma-as-am ku-nu-ki-a a-ha-ma 20 ma-na URUDU ma-as-am šu-ut il₅-qé
translation: 3 talents of washed copper under my seal, and further, 20 minas of washed copper he received.

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 3 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU ma-as-a-am ù 2 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì ša PUZUR₄-sú-in a-na i-ku-pì-a DUMU da-dí-a áp-qí-id
translation: Total: 3 talents 20 minas of washed copper and 2 black donkeys of Puzur-Suen I entrusted to Ikūppīya, son of Dadiya.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU lá-am-ni-a-nim IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku IGI DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim NU.BÀNDA
translation: Before Puzur-Aššur, son of Lamniānum, before Puzur-Ištar, son of Aššur-taklāku, before the son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, the overseer.

transliteration: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur ú i-ku-pì-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: Say to Puzur-Aššur and Ikūn-pī-Aššur,

transliteration: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
translation: thus Šu-Ištar:

transliteration: be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-hi-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú-ú id-na-a ša-áš-qí-lá
translation: Please, my lords, take care to make him pay the silver and the interest on it.

transliteration: a-le-e KÙ.BABBAR id-na-a 10 GÍN e-li-a-ni mì-li-ik
translation: Consider where silver of his, even if only 10 shekels, may turn up.

transliteration: šu-ma a-wi-lu-um KÙ.BABBAR i-šu-ú (d)UTU-ba-ni na-hi-da-ma a-na ma-e ša-tá-e-em lá ú-ša-ar-šu
translation: If the man indeed has silver, then warn Šamaš-bāni that he must not allow him even to drink water.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pu-um KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà
translation: (For) the silver is your silver!

transliteration: a-wi-lu-um la-mu-un e ú-ni-ku-nu-ma ih-da
translation: The man is a crook, let him not cheat you; be careful.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá
translation: Make sure to have him pay the silver and its interest!

transliteration: a-pu-tum a-pu-tum i-na (d)UTU-ši ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ú ANŠE.ḪI-ú e-ra-ba-ni ú-ma-kál lá ta-bi-tá
translation: Urgent, urgent, do not tarry a single day from the day Šēp-Ištar and his donkeys arrive!

transliteration: URUDU 1 GÍN ba-áb-tám lá ta-ra-ší-a
translation: Do not acquire an outstanding claim of a single shekel of copper!

transliteration: lu a-na pu-ru-uš-ha-dim lu a-na ša-lá-tù-ar a-li KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a-na DAM.GÀR tù-šé-lá-a-ni er-ba-ma URUDU-ak-nu ma-hi-ir DAM.GÀR-ru-tim i-za-zu
translation: Enter either Purušhaddum or Šalatuar, wherever you can realise a single shekel profit for the merchant, so your copper is at the current merchant rate.

transliteration: ú ba-tí-iq ú DIRI dí-na-ma tí-ib-a-nim-ma a-tal-kà-nim
translation: So, sell either cheap or dear, set out and come!

transliteration: ha-ra-ni ku-nu-tí ú-qá-a
translation: I wait for you for my journey.

transliteration: ù ANŠE.ḪI.A a-na ší-mì-im dí-na-ma ší-im ANŠE.ḪI.A KÙ.BABBAR lu ša-li-iṭ
translation: Also sell the donkeys and have the price of the donkeys be available in silver.

transliteration: ih-da-ma a-tal-kà-nim
translation: Pay attention and come here!

transliteration: um-ma a-šur-ma-lik-ma a-na a-al-DU₁₀ ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
translation: Thus Aššur-mālik, say to Āl-ṭāb and Ennum-Aššur:

transliteration: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: Aššur-taklāku is bringing you 7 shekels of silver under my seal.

transliteration: a-ma-kam ší-it-ri ša pu-ki-im dam-qú-tim wa-at-ru-tim ša-ma-ma ku-nu-kà-ma a-na a-šur-ták-lá-ku dí-na-ma
translation: Buy there scarfs? of eave of extremely good quality, seal them and hand them over to Aššur-taklāku.

transliteration: šu-ma e-eb-ru a-tù-nu iš-tí pá-ni-im-ma pì-iq-da-ma ṭù-ur-da-ni-šu-nu
translation: And if you are really friends, convey them to me with the first caravan.

transliteration: a-hu-ú-a-tù-nu ih-da-ma ú a-na-ku a-wa-at-ku-nu a-ša-me
translation: Heed my request, my brothers, and I too can listen to what you say!

translation: Tūraya, Ennam-Suen and Muti-Aššur, these men acted as judges.

translation: I brought 8 minas of good quality copper to the man Išpunahšu.

translation: Total: 0.6666 mina 5.5 shekels of silver is in the possession of the Tumliyayan.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma i-ku-pí-a ú zu-ku-a
translation: To Ali-ahum from Ikūn-pīya and Zukuwa:
