translation: They brought your tin, 1 talent 30 minas.

transliteration: ú-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma 0.5 ma-na im-ṭí
translation: We checked it and 0.5 mina was missing.

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na AN.NA i wa-ah-šu-ša-na il₅-qé-ú
translation: They took 0.5 mina tin in Wahšušana.

transliteration: 7.66666 GÍN 7.5 ŠE.TA ta-dí-in KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 11.33333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN
translation: It was sold at the rate 7.6666 shekels 7.5 grains; in silver: 11.3333 minas 2.5 shekels.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ma-e-im ni-dí-in
translation: Of that we gave 10 shekels of silver for the 'water-man'.

transliteration: 11 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni šu-hu-bur na-áš-a-kum
translation: Šu-Hubur brings 11 minas 12.5 shekels of silver under our seals to you.

transliteration: 24 pí-ri-kà-ni-kà ha-nu ub-lam ú a-na a-lá-ni ú-šé-ṣí-šu-nu
translation: Hanu brought 24 pirikannus and he led them out into the villages.

transliteration: ší-im-šu-nu ha-nu ub-ba-lá-kum
translation: Hanu will bring you the proceeds from them.

transliteration: i-na ša ṭup-pí-šu ša šu-ki-tim 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR nu-ša-áš-qí-il₅
translation: We made Šukkutum pay 4 minas of silver out of what was in his tablet.

transliteration: ku-nu-ki-šu šu-hu-bur-ma na-áš-a-kum
translation: Šu-Hubur brings it to you under his seal.

transliteration: GÁN-lam₅ a-šu-mì šu-ki-tim-ma e-tí-iq
translation: It passes overland in the name of Šukkutum as well.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà ša li-bi šu-ki-tim nu-ša-áš-qá-al-šu-ma iš-tí ší-im pí-ri-kà-ni-kà nu-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: We shall make Šukkutum pay the rest of your silver owed by him and send it to you with the proceeds from your pirikannus.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum from Zukuwa:

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-dí 5 ha-am-ší-šu áš-pu-ra-ni-ma úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí
translation: Why is it that I have written five times but you do not inform me?

transliteration: a-hi a-ta úz-ni pè-té
translation: My dear brother, inform me!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša i-dí-a-šur ha-bu-lá-ni ša-qí-il₅ lá ša-qí-il₅ tí-ir-ta-kà
translation: Send me word whether the silver owed by Iddin-Aššur has been paid or not.

transliteration: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-hu-wa-qar-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar:

transliteration: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pu-um i-hu-lá-pí-im lá-wi pá-nu-šu KIŠIB a-lá-hi-im a-na hi-na-a ú e-lá-ma lá-pí-it
translation: You wrote me as follows: '(There is) a tablet wrapped in a rag, on the face of which is written: 'Seal of Ali-ahum to Hinnāya and Elamma'.

transliteration: i li-bi₄ ṭup-pé ša a-šur-DU₁₀ né-mu-ur-ma lá-šu
translation: We looked for it among the tablets of Aššur-ṭāb, but it is not there.

transliteration: a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ni-iš-tap-ra-am
translation: We have now sent a letter to Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: té-er-tù-šu li-tù-ra-am-ma a-šar ša-ak-nu nu-šé-ba-lá-ku-šu
translation: When his message telling where it has been placed comes back we will send it to you.

transliteration: a-šu-mì am-tí-im ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni dan-a-šur ni-iš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-im GÉME a-na-ku i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qúl
translation: As for the slave-girl of Aššur-taklāku, about whom you wrote us, we asked Dān-Aššur and he said: 'It was me who paid the price of the slave-girl out of my own means.'

transliteration: LUGAL-(d)IŠKUR a-na wa-ah-šu-ša-na i-lá-ak ší-be ú-ša-a-lá-ma za-ku-sà ni-ša-pá-ra-kum
translation: Šarrum-Adad will go to Wahšušana, he will interrogate the witnesses and then we will send you definite information.

transliteration: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-na hu-bu-li-a ša É a-bi-a ú-bi₄-il₅
translation: I brought 10 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, for my debt to my father's house.

transliteration: a-ha-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am x ša a-lá-hi-im ša e-li-tí-šu ku-nu-ki-a a-na a-šùr-dan DUMU zu-ú NU.BÀNDA áp-qí-id
translation: Further, I entrusted 1 mina of refined silver belonging to Ali-ahum from his caravan, under my seal to Aššur-dan son of Zu'u, the lieutenant.

transliteration: IGI (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na IGI a-mur-(d)UTU DUMU mì-šu-GAL IGI ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
translation: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Amur-Šamaš son of Mišu-rabi, by Ṣilulu son of Uku.

transliteration: [...] i-dì-in-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ú DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR [...]
translation: ... the colony rendered a verdict, and Šalim-Aššur and Amur-Ištar's son ...

transliteration: en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr a-na a-gi-a DUMU i-ku-nim iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr a-na a-gi-a-ma
translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur seized us against Agiya son of Ikūnum, and Ennam-Aššur said as follows to Agiya:

transliteration: ṭup-pí ha-ru-mu-tim ša a-bi-kà i-na kà-ni-iš ku-a-tí-ma URUDU
translation: ... certified tablets of your father's in Kanesh ... for you and copper.

transliteration: me-ra me-tim a-na-ku a-šé-e
translation: I am an heir. ... I sue ...

transliteration: ištù ITU.1.KAM li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-ma-lik a-na ša-na-at ha-ru-mu-tim
translation: Reckoned from the month ..., eponymy after Aššur-malik, within 1 year, certified tablets.

transliteration: ú-la ta-tù-ar-ma mì-ma la ta-na-pu-uš
translation: Do not raise claim and do not complain at all.

transliteration: um-ma a-gi-a-ma i-na kà-ni-iš ṭup-pí ša hu-bu-ul a-bi-a a-ta lu ša-zu-úz-ta-kà lu a-hu-kà kà-li-ma-ni-ma
translation: Agiya answered: Show me, either you yourself or your agent or your brother, the tablets concerning my father's debt in Kanesh.

transliteration: šu-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-bi-kà ú-lá ší-bi a-na ma-lá u₄-me-a ú-la ušté-li-a-ku-nu-tí a-na ma-lá ṭup-pí-a ša ku-nu-uk a-bi-ni hu-bu-li-ni ú-la a-tù-ar-ma lá a-na-pu-uš
translation: If I have not produced the tablet sealed by your father or the witnesses within my term, then it is indeed our debt in accordance with my tablet sealed by our fathers, and I shall not raise claim and I shall not complain.

transliteration: IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur DUMU a-li-li IGI bé-lu-um-ba-ni DUMU kà-sí-a IGI a-šur-ma-lik
translation: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur son of Alili, by Bēlum-bāni son of Kasiya, by Aššur-malik.

translation: Puzur-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar brought here; thereof 4 textiles were deducted.

translation: For the rest of the textiles and the black donkeys, they paid 5 minas and 7.5 shekels of silver as transport-tax and food for the donkeys.

transliteration: 3 e-ma-re ṣa-lá-me ú me-at 70 ma-na URUDU ša kà-ni-iš a-ba-an ma-tim ma-tim ša a-šùr ir-de₈-a-ku-nu-tí-ni ŠÀ.BA 1 TÚG a-na li-tab-ší-šu
translation: 3 black donkeys and 170 minas of copper of Kanesh, according to the local weight standard, which Aššur lead to you, 1 textile thereof was for his own clothing.

transliteration: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-ú-šu 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-ma ku-li-a il₅-qé
translation: 3 minas of silver became available for him; 6 minas of silver which were cleared Kuliya took.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim wa-bar-tum ša ša-lá-tù-wa-ar i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: For this affair the trading-station of Šalatuwar made us appear in court and we gave our testimony in the presence of the dagger of Aššur.

transliteration: um-ma a-a-ar-tí-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma
translation: From Ayarti to Enna-Suen:

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.GI iš-tí-ku-nu i-hi-id-ma a-ta ú e-lá-lí KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: Pay attention to the gold in your possession so that you and Elāli send me good gold.

transliteration: a-we-lúm lá i-qá-bi um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.GI lá šé-bi-lá-ma i-hi-id-ma KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: The man should not say: 'Do not send any gold!' - but do take care to send me good gold.

transliteration: a-lá-ku-nu lá tù-qá-a gi-mì-lam ra-bi-am i-ṣé-ri-a šu-ku-ma
translation: Do not wait until you leave yourself; do me a great favour!

transliteration: um-ma pá-ru-ur-tum-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: From Parrurtum to Iddin-abum:

transliteration: a-ha-at a-bi-kà me-ta-at
translation: Your father's sister is dead.

transliteration: um-ma a-hu-ni-ma ap-lúm la-šu É-bé-tám né-nu ni-tá-ru
translation: Our brothers say: 'There is no heir. Let us take away the house.'

transliteration: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-ta-al-kam
translation: Set out and come here when you have heard the letter.

transliteration: É a-bi-kà a-na kà-nu-nim ba-li-im iš-ta-ak-nu
translation: They have turned your father's house into an extinguished fireplace.

transliteration: a-na a-šur-re-ṣí en-um-a-šur da-dí-a ú a-ta-a qí-bi₄-ma
translation: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, Dadiya and Ataya:

translation: '17 minas of copper from the price for a house-plot of Nūr-ilī is still due from Aššur-rēṣī.

transliteration: 8 ma-na URUDU ša DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí KI a-ta-a
translation: 8 minas of copper belonging to Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī, is due from Ataya'.

transliteration: URUDU ma-lá i-na li-bi₄-šu-nu i-ba-ší-ú šé-ṣí-a-ma li-qí-a
translation: Settle accounts for all the copper they still owe and collect it.

transliteration: ú a-ṣé-er ša KÙ.GI ṭí-ih-a-ma
translation: And add it to that derived from the gold.

transliteration: ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a mì-ma tal-qé-a ku-ta-ni ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
translation: Moreover, if you have collected anything of my outstanding claims, buy kutānu-textiles and send them to me.

transliteration: a-na a-ta-a qí-bi₄-ma
translation: Say to Ataya:

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am na-áš-pár-tam ša a-šur-la-ma-sí ša a-šu-mì tá-ad-mì-iq-tim ša a-na a-bi₄-kà ip-qí-du na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: "The tablet with the letter of Aššur-lamassī concerning the free loan he entrusted to your father, which they are bringing to you,

transliteration: a-ma-kam ṭup-pá-am ší-me-ma li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mì-in
translation: read that tablet over there, but do not get angry.

transliteration: a-hi a-ta i-na ša-ha-at ša-zu-úz-tí-a i-zi-iz-ma
translation: Please, my brother, assist my representative(s).

transliteration: i-na a-lá-ak ma-áš-kà-tí-a TÚG.HI.A iš-té-na ú ša-na šé-bi₄-lam-ma lá-ag-mì-il₅-kà
translation: And send me, when a shipment of mine starts its journey, each time one or two textiles, then I will do you a favor (in return)."

transliteration: KIŠIB lá-qé-pí-im DUMU i-zi-za-am-DINGIR
translation: Seal of La-qēpum, son of Izzizam-ilī.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-na-ni-ma
translation: For these words the Kanesh colony made me available.

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr …
translation: And before Aššur's dagger [I gave my testimony].

transliteration: 16 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šùr-eš-tí-kál ù i-dí-a-bi₄-im i-sú-riki₁₃ i-šu
translation: Aššur-ištikal and Iddin-abum owe 16 minas of refined silver to Issu-arik.

transliteration: IGI a-ku-za IGI ib-ni-sú-in
translation: Witnessed by Akuza, witnessed by Ibni-Suen.

transliteration: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
translation: To Šalim-Aššur say:

transliteration: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
translation: thus Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ha-dim tù-šé-ṣí-a-ni i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma i-a-tí-ma li-ni-dí
translation: The silver that you have brought out from Burušhaddum should be deposited under the seals of my representatives."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-ba-ší
translation: The silver is available under the seals of your representatives.

transliteration: a-šu-mì ba-a-ba-tí-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
translation: As to your outstanding loans, that you wrote about,

transliteration: a-na-kam ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-na 10.5 GÚ URUDU ší-ki-im a-ha-ma 40 ma-na ha-bu-ra-ta-i-im 7 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-me ù 2 ṣú-ha-ri qá-at-kà i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša sá-li-a ù ì-lí-dan ha-bu-lu-ni ú-ša-áš-ki-nu-ma ù lu-qú-tám a-na sà-ah-ri-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim ip-qí-du
translation: here your representatives made you lay claim to the 10.5 talents of copper, also 40 minas of (copper) from haburat, 7 black donkeys and 2 servants, i.e. the yield in silver that Salliya and Ilī-dan owed, and they have entrusted the goods to Sahri-ilī and Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: šu-ma lu-qú-tám sá-li-a i-na ma-ah-ri-kà lá iš-ta-kán
translation: If Salliya has not placed the goods before you,

transliteration: ší-a-ma-at a-lim a-šùr sá-li-a a ša-lim-a-šùr i-da-an
translation: Salliya must give purchases in the City of Assur to Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: a-na-kam ì-lí-dan aṣ-ba-at-ma 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
translation: Here I seized Ilī-dan and made him pay 2 minas of silver.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša da-tí-a ni-il₅-qé
translation: We received 2 minas of silver of my fees.

transliteration: 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI da-tí-kà ša tù-um-li-a-i-im x x x x
translation: 2 minas 15 shekels of silver with your fees from the man of Tumliya...

transliteration: a-na-kam i-re-ší ba-áb-tí-kà a-za-az
translation: Here I keep a close watch over your outstanding loans.

transliteration: ù sú-in-na-da i-na wa-ah-šu-ša-na wa-ša-áb
translation: Also, Suen-nādā is staying in Wahšušana;

transliteration: e-ra-ba-
translation: when he enters [here I shall make him pay the silver and its interest].

transliteration: 2 né-pí-šu 15 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-nu
translation: 2 packages of refined silver, 15 minas each was their weight;

transliteration: a-ha-ma 2 né-pí-šu 13.25 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-nu
translation: further, 2 packages of refined silver, 13 1/4 minas each was their weight;

transliteration: ù iš-tí-in né-pí-šu-um 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um
translation: plus one package with 3 minas of refined silver,

transliteration: ŠU.NÍGIN 59.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a a-na šu-IŠTAR áp-qí-id
translation: in all: 59.5 minas of refined silver under my seal I entrusted to Šu-Ištar.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šùr ù DAM.GÀR ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi-il₅-šu
translation: I sent the silver under my seal with him to Šalim-Aššur and the merchant.

transliteration: ša-du-a-at KÙ.BABBAR a-nim šu-IŠTAR ša-bu-ú
translation: Šu-Ištar has been paid the transport tariff for this silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša en-um-a-šùr
translation: The silver belongs to Ennam-Aššur.

translation: Šalim-Aššur's attorney questioned Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, Šalim-Aššur's sons:

transliteration: lá tù-na-ha-ni ra-bi-ṣa-am i-a-tí
translation: Do not obstruct me, me, the attorney!

translation: Since they kept petitioning me I said: 'Come on, take me (to court),'

transliteration: bu-lá-tí KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-ku-nu lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
translation: then I shall release the assets, your father's silver to you.

transliteration: šu-nu a-lá-kam ú kà-lu-mì-i lá i-mu-ú-ni
translation: But they refused to come, or to show me.

transliteration: a-lá-ak a-na a-lim(ki)

transliteration: tù-ta-ni-ha-ni

transliteration: uš-kà-in a-na ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) ú ra-bi-ṣí-im ša be-lí-a
translation: "I submit to the tablet of the City and the attorney of my lord.

transliteration: a-na bu-lá-té-e ša a-bi-ni pá-hu-ri-im lu ta-li-kam

transliteration: ú a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu ta-áš-e-li-ma qá-at-kà ú-lá am-ha-ṣ
translation: and once or twice you have questioned me, and I have not rejected you.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ba-a-am a-šar bu-lá-tù ša a-bi-ni i-ba-ší-ú-ni
translation: I said: 'Come on, (let's go to) where our father's assets are,

transliteration: a-na du-ur-hu-mì-it lu ni-li-ik-ma lu nu-pá-hi-ir
translation: let us go to Durhumit and let us collect it.'

translation: 1 šulupkaean-textile and 2 kutānu-textiles were lost.

translation: Five textiles they took for their clothing.

translation: 117 dark textiles entered the palace,

translation: two of which are the share of Kurub-Ištar.

transliteration: um-ma bé-li-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ú lá-qé-ep
translation: From Bēliya to Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp:

translation: specifically to Lā-qēp:

translation: As to the 8 minas of refined silver - its import duty added, its transport tariff paid -

translation: silver belonging to a merchant, that I gave you for purchases with Ṭāb-ahi and Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadū'e as witnesses -

translation: the merchant is Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: lu-qú-tám ma-lá ta-áš-a-ma-šu-ni a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šur dí-in-ma
translation: Any goods you have bought for him you must give to Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur,

translation: and let him leave me a message from you (plural).

translation: From Iddin-Aššur to Ali-ahum, Hanunu, Ennanātum and Kibal:

translation: If you have had Ennam-Adad's tin paid, then convert it to silver,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ki-ba-al dí-na-ma
translation: give the silver to Kibal,

translation: and let him act in accordance with my instructions.

transliteration: ú tí-ir-ta-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ta-dí-na-šu-ni li-li-kam
translation: Also, send me word about how much silver you have given him.

transliteration: ṭup-pì-a ú hu-ur-ša-am a-tù-nu-ma ku-un-kà
translation: You have to seal for my tablets and the store-room.

transliteration: e-na-na-ta-am na-hi-da-ma ba-lu-ku-nu ṭup-pè-e-a ma-ma-na lá i-pá-té
translation: Give Ennanātum instructions that no one must open for my tablets without your permission.

transliteration: ma-ma-an e is-li-ší
translation: No one must deceive.

transliteration: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: To Puzur-Aššur, speak:

transliteration: um-ma a-ni-i-a-ni-ma
translation: Thus says Ani-ani:

transliteration: x ma-na 13 GÍN ni-ga-li DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur i-dí-nam
translation: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur gave me x mina 13 shekels of sickles.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na 0.66666 GÍN a-na a-ki-a ni-dí-in
translation: Of that we gave 0.5 mina 0.6666 shekels to Akiya.

transliteration: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-la-ni 1.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
translation: Of the silver you sent I took 1 1/4 shekels.

translation: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 2 3/4 shekels of silver.

transliteration: šu-ma be-lí a-ta iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-i-ma sà-ḩe-er-tám šé-bi-lam
translation: If you are indeed my lord, send me small goods with the first transport.

transliteration: [...] mì-ma a-nim a-šu-ú-ma-an ù ki-kà-ar-ša-an i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: ... Ašu-uman and Kikaršan lead all this to you.

translation: They carry a weight-stone of 10 minas ... under my seal.

translation: If I have not reached it, they shall check the safe wool for you.

translation: ... they should count ...

translation: 15 minas of washed copper is owed by Aššur-kāšid son of Ikraya.

transliteration: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 14 ma-na URUDU-i-a ša i-na wa-aḩ-šu-ša-na i-na ba-áb-tí-a en-na-num DUMU ku-um-ri-im il₅-qé-ú KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi-šu
translation: Ennānum son of Kumrum took 6 shekels of silver, the price of my 14 minas of copper which was in my outstanding assets in Wašhušana; the silver is owed by him.

transliteration: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḩi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: To my representatives, Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, speak:

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur
translation: Thus says Šalim-Aššur:

transliteration: i-na té-ga-ra-ma wa-áš-ba-ku a-dí ú-nu-tám ú-ša-lu-ḩu
translation: I am staying in Tegarama until I take away the goods.

transliteration: a-pu-tum a-dí a-lá-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na pá-ḩi-ra-ma i-na É-tí-a li-ib-ší
translation: Urgent! - before I arrive, collect every mina of silver and let it be in my house.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma a-na a-lim(ki) lá tù-šé-bi₄-lá
translation: Do not send any silver to the City.

transliteration: i-na (d)UTU-ši x ṭúp-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni a-lá-ḩu-um lu a-na ḩu-ra-ma lu a-na ku-ša-ra a-na ṣé-ri-a li-li-kam
translation: On the day you hear my letter Ali-ahum should come to meet me either in Hurama or in Kuššara.

translation: and he should bring every mina of silver that is at my disposal.

translation: ... 221 textiles ... cost 14.5 minas 1 shekel of silver;

translation: 5 black donkeys cost 1.83333 mina of silver;

translation: 12 shekels of silver: harness for the donkeys;

translation: 24 minas of tin I gave to Lataya for expenses;

transliteration: KÙ.BI 1.66666 ma-na 5.66666 GÍN

translation: I paid 0.6666 mina of silver for a packer and half a packer, working capitals;

transliteration: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu-bu-šu-nu
translation: 3 shekels of silver: their clothes;

transliteration: 3.83333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-köl-tí ANŠE.ḩI.A
translation: 3.83333 shekels of silver: fodder for the donkeys;

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na li-mì-im ša šu-da-a ḩa-bu-lá-tí-ma áš-qöl
translation: you owed 2 shekels of silver to the eponym Šudaya, and I paid it;

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-ší-tí-kà
translation: 2 shekels of silver for your wife;

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-tám sí-ḩa-ar-ì-lí il₅-qé
translation: Sihar-ilī received 15 shekels of silver as transport tariff;

transliteration: 1 me-at 6.5 ma-na URUDU ša en-um-a-šùr i li-bi₄ kà-ri-im
translation: 106 ½ minas of copper belonging to Ennam-Aššur is owed by the colony.

transliteration: ší-im URUDU a-nim i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša wa-bar-tim ša ša-lá-tù-ar ki-ma en-um-a-šùr ku-da-tum i-lá-qé
translation: Kudātum will receive the price of this copper in silver from the station at Šalatuwar on behalf of Ennam-Aššur.

translation: ItŦr-ilī deposited 5/6 mina 3 ½ shekels of lapis lazuli worth 2 2/3 minas ½ shekel with the sons of Šakri-uman.

translation: Of the 2 minas 15 shekels of lapis lazuli that he sent with Šu-Ištar, thereof he sent 1 ½ mina 2 shekels of silver, the price of ½ mina 7 ½ shekels of lapis.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki a-na da-šùr áš-lu-uṭ
translation: The sealed silver I placed under Aššur's authority.

translation: The rest of the lapis lazuli remains in Šu-Ištar's possession.

translation: We made an accounting for all the silver,

translation: and after I have paid in full the silver that I owe ...

translation: the sealed silver ...

translation: 9 2/3 shekels of lapis lazuli, an extra, is in Ennam-Aššur's possession.

transliteration: i-nu-mì ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR li-tí-iz e-pu-šu-ni 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-i-šu ú-šé-bi-il₅-šu-um
translation: When Uṣur-ša-Ištar performed the rite, I sent him 2 shekels of silver for his sacrifices.

translation: When the mahhū-priests of the temple of Išhara came up, I gave him 5 shekels of silver for his sacrifices.

transliteration: i-nu-mì be-lúm-ba-LIM DUMU NU.BÀNDA 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-i-šu a-dí-in
translation: When Bēlum-bani son of the laputtum-official (came), I gave 2 shekels of silver for his sacrifices.

translation: I gave 1 shekel of silver to each of his brothers.

transliteration: a-na a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-i-šu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 2 shekels of silver for the sacrifices of Aššur-bāni son of Kutaya.

translation: I gave 2 1/2 shekels of silver for the sacrifices of Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU i-dí-(d)IM ni-qí-i-šu a-dí-in

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-i-šu a-na šu-zu-zu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 1 shekel of silver for his sacrifices to Šuzuzu.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šùr-x-ri ni-qí-i-šu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 1 shekel of silver for his sacrifices to Aššur-x-ri.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ab-ša-lim ni-qí-i-šu ak-ru-ub
translation: I dedicated 1 shekel of silver for the sacrifices of Ah-šalim.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-na-sú-in a-dí-in šu-a-nim
translation: I gave 1 shekel of silver to Inā-Sîn, those were the payments.

transliteration: i-na 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša e-lá-lí DUMU IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḩ i-na ḩa-ḩi-im en-um-a-šur i-qí-pu-ma i-na ṭúp-pì-šu DAM.GÀR lá-áp-tù a-šur-lá-ma-sí a-šùr-SIG₅ ù a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim i-na ṭúp-pì-šu na-lu-ni
translation: Of the 8 minas of refined silver that Elalī, son of Ištar-pilah, in Hahhum had given as trust to Ennam-Aššur, on whose tablet the tamkārum was written and on which Aššur-lamassī, Aššur-damiq and Aššur-bēl-awātim were witnesses:

transliteration: i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma e-lá-ma i-na-aḩ-DINGIR il₅-qé ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-ma-sà-tim i-dí-in
translation: from that silver Ēnah-ilī collected 2 minas 15 shekels in the name of Elamma and gave it to Lamassutum.

transliteration: ITU.KAM ma-ḩu-ur-DINGIR li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí
translation: Month IV, eponymy of Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: šu-ma a-na 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim um-mì-a-nu IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḩ ù me-er-ú IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḩ ma-ma-an a-na e-na-aḩ-DINGIR i-tù-a-ar
translation: If for these 2 minas 15 shekels and its interest Ennum-Aššur, the investors of Ištar-pilah, or his sons, raise a claim against Ēnah-ilī;

transliteration: lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma en-um-a-šur pì-lá-aḩ-IŠTAR me-er-ú e-lá-ma a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bu-bu-šu
translation: Lamassutum, the sons of Elamma, and Aššur-imittī will clear him.

transliteration: a-na a-la-ḩi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur a-ni-na DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ú a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḩi-im
translation: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur, Annina son of Puzur-Anna and Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum;

transliteration: KIŠIB zu-ku-a a-ḩu-ú-a a-tù-nu
translation: seal of Zukuwa; O my brothers,

transliteration: a-na a-wa-at ṭúp-pí-im iḩ-da
translation: pay attention to the words of the letter!

transliteration: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ni-wa-a-ni-ma
translation: To Puzur-Aššur, speak: thus says Ani-wani.

transliteration: iš-tù 3 ITU.KAM ta-ta-lá-ak-ma mì-ma ú-lá tù-šé-bi₄-lam
translation: You left three months ago and you have sent me nothing.

transliteration: a-na-kam dan-a-šur 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-nam šu-ut-ma
translation: Dan-Aššur has given me 2 shekels of silver here, he himself.

transliteration: a-ba-ru-um ma-ma-an lá-qá-am lá i-mu-a-šu
translation: As to the lead, no one is willing to take it.

transliteration: 4 né-nu mì-nam ni-kà-al
translation: Us four, what are we to eat?

transliteration: qá-du-um ṣú-ha-ri-im ša SIG₅-a-a mì-šu-um KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá tù-šé-ba-lam-ma ma i-na bu-bu-tim ni-mu-a-at
translation: With Damqaya's servant, why do you not send any silver, for we are dying from hunger!

transliteration: a-ma hu-bu-ru-um i-ta-al-kam
translation: Indeed, the Netherworld has arrived.

transliteration: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a lá tù-šé-ba-lam a-ta-be-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: If you do not send me silver for my food I shall set out and come!

transliteration: šu-ma be-lí a-ta i-hi-id
translation: If you are truly my lord - take care!

transliteration: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-bu-ša-lim-ma

transliteration: a-pu-tum ki-ma tup-pí-ni ta-áš-me-a-ni iš-té-na mu-qá-ri-bé a-na a-sá-num dí-na-ma
translation: Please, as soon as you have heard our letter, give an escort to Asānum.

transliteration: kà-ru-um kà-ri-im a-dí kà-ni-iš(ki) lu-qá-ri-bu-šu
translation: Each colony must escort him to the next, all the way until Kanesh.

transliteration: u₄-ma-kàl lá i-sà-hur
translation: He must not suffer a delay of even one single day!

transliteration: a-na a-la-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ha-nu-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum speak, thus says Hanu:

transliteration: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šu-hu-bu-ur ù a-na-ku ni-zi-iz-ma a-lu-lá-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma
translation: In accordance with your instructions, Šu-hubur and I stood up and we seized Alulaya and said:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu šu-qú-ul
translation: "Pay the silver and its interest!"

transliteration: um-ma a-lu-lá-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ITU.1.KAM bur-sú-in ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-šu-um
translation: Alulaya answered: "I sent the silver to him a month ago with Būr-Suen."

transliteration: a-dí ta-ah-sí-is-tim ša tù-ša-hi-zi-ni a-lu-lá-a a-áš-al-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: With respect to the memorandum that you instructed me about, I questioned Alulaya, and he answered:

transliteration: la-qé-pum DUMU šu-ašur ú-kà-al-ší
translation: "Lā-qēpum son of Šu-Aššur has it."

transliteration: ù a-hu-wa-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur a-áš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: I also questioned Ahu-waqar son of Zurzur, and he answered:

transliteration: ta-ah-sí-is-tám ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-li ú-kà-al-ší
translation: "Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilī has the memorandum."

transliteration: a-zu aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: I seized Azu and he answered:

transliteration: ki ma-ṣí lu KÙ.BABBAR lu pì-ri-kà-ni-kà 5 GÍN.TA a-lá-qé
translation: "I shall take enough, either in silver or from your pirikannu-textiles at 5 shekels per piece."

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma ba-áb ha-ra-ni-kà KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú a-kà-na-kà-ma
translation: He said further: "At the start of your journey I shall seal the silver and its interest for you."

transliteration: a-dí ší-li-ip-kà-im šu-kà-tám aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-li-ip-kà-um i-ba-ší
translation: Regarding the šilipka’um-textile I seized Šukkutum, and he answered: "The šilipka’um is available."

transliteration: a-dí-ni-ma be-lí a-ta a-ma-kam tù-na-hi-da-ni um-ma a-ta-ma a-na u₄-me-šu ú-šé-ra-kum
translation: It still is, and you cautioned me there, my lord, saying: "I have released them to you for its term."

transliteration: u₄-ma-am ta-áš-ta-na-me ki-ma ší-mu-um kà-sú
translation: Today you keep hearing that trade is at a standstill.

transliteration: ší-mì a-da-ma a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: I shall sell my goods, set out and come.

transliteration: ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur a-na qá-ta-tim a-da-ku-nu
translation: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur I hand you over to guarantors.

transliteration: tup-pá-am ša ša-lá-ša-at a-tù-nu ha-bu-lá-tù-nu-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-ku-nu ra-ak-sú nu-kà-al
translation: We have in our possession a tablet stating that you three owe silver and that you are jointly liable.

transliteration: lu ša pá-e a-na ša-lim-a-šur tí-šu
translation: If you have oral witnesses against Šalim-Aššur,

transliteration: lu a-na a-ba-e-ni tí-šu-ú
translation: or if you have some against our fathers,

transliteration: lu tup-pá-am ša ša-ba-e ša ku-nu-uk a-ba-e-ni tù-kà-al
translation: or if you hold a tablet of satisfaction with the seal of our fathers,

transliteration: lu ší-be-e tí-šu
translation: or if you have witnesses,

transliteration: a-na a-né-en-ma ru-a-ma mì-nam ni-qá-bi₄
translation: then produce the evidence to these men, and what can we then say?

transliteration: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lá tù-ba-ar-ni-a-tí
translation: We are inheritors. Do not drag us to court.

transliteration: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul PUZUR₄-(d)EN.LÍL ša tup-pí-šu ha-ar-mì-im ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-ha-ma a-dí-šu-ni ŠÀ.BA 4.5 GÚ 4.5 ma-na URUDU al-qé
translation: Of the 4 minas of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil, recorded in his certified tablet, and of the 0.5 mina of silver I had given him separately, thereof I obtained 4.5 talents 4.5 minas of copper.

transliteration: i-na 1 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ù 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul PUZUR₄-(d)EN.LÍL ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI ša-lim-a-šùr DUMU up-ha-qí-im aṣ-ba-at
translation: Of the 1 talent 50 minas of copper and 10 shekels of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil, thereof I seized 1 mina of silver from Šalim-Aššur, son of Uphāqum.

transliteration: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša na-pá-hu iš-qú-lu-ni-ni 0.83333 ma-na 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ma-sú-ha-am qá-dum 3.33333 GÍN mu-ṭá-e i-na li-bi-šu-nu a-hu-ur
translation: Of the 4 minas of silver that the smiths paid to me, 0.83333 mina 3.3333 shekels of silver of inferior quality together with 3.3333 shekels underweight remain as owed by them.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur ša šu-ì-lí-a áš-qúl
translation: Thereof I paid 0.5 mina of silver to Puzur-Aššur of Šu-Iliya.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà ša i-na tí-me-el-ki-a al-qé-ú
translation: 2 minas of silver from the proceeds on your tin which I received in Timelkiya.

transliteration: 10.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a be-a-lim ta-dí-nu-šu-ni a-na šé-ep-IŠTAR a-dí-in
translation: I gave 10.33333 shekels of silver, which you gave him for use, to Šēp-Ištar.

transliteration: 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-áp-tí-nim a-na am-tí-kà a-dí-in
translation: I gave 5.5 shekels of silver for a saptinnu-textile to your maid-servant.

transliteration: x x x x x x TÚG SIG₅ i-na x hu-ra-ma a-dí-na-ku-um
translation: ... fine textile in ... Hurama I gave to you.

transliteration: 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì šé-ep-IŠTAR a qá-tí-kà tù-ṭá-hi-ú
translation: 5.25 shekels of silver which you added to your share on account of Šēp-Ištar.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na a-bu-a áš-qú-lu-ni
translation: 2 shekels of silver which I paid to my father.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-i-bi₄-im áš-qúl
translation: I paid 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver to Ir-ibum.

transliteration: 5 ma-na AN.NA ù 3 ku-ta-ni i li-bi₄-kà i-šu
translation: I have a claim of 5 minas of tin and 3 kutānu-textiles against you.

transliteration: a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-la-hi-im a-na i-dí-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-ma a-na i-dí-a-šùr-ma
translation: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative, seized us against Iddin-Aššur and the attorney Ababa said to Iddin-Aššur:

transliteration: tup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) ta-áš-me
translation: You have heard the tablet from the City.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šur ú-pá-ha-ar
translation: I collect Šalim-Aššur's silver;

transliteration: ù na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur iš-tù ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mì-im a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im ub-lá-kum ša 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ip-qí-du-ni-ku-ni tù-šé-ra-am
translation: also, I brought you a missive from Šalim-Aššur's investors from the month Hubur, eponymy of Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum, stating that you must release 40 talents of good copper that they entrusted to you,

transliteration: ù a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur la ta-tù-ar
translation: and you must not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

transliteration: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur ta-pu-lu-ni a-na ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu iš-tù ITU.1.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im URUDU al-qé
translation: I have received the 40 talents of good copper about which you reached an agreement with Šalim-Aššur's investors, in accordance with their missive dated month Hubur, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

transliteration: a-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum lu i-de₈-ú
translation: Indeed, may these men know!

transliteration: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni IGI a-ni-ú-tim ší-me-ma a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur lá ta-tù-ar
translation: Listen to the missive from the investors before these witnesses, and do not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

transliteration: … ma-lá ga-me-er a-wa-tí-ni …
translation: ... as much as those who settled our case ...

transliteration: i-na na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu … ú-ša-hi-it-kà
translation: I have cleared you with their missive.

transliteration: i-dí-a-šur ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša
translation: Iddin-Aššur answered the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya.

transliteration: 5 ma-na hu-ša-e i-na kà-ṣí-im a-na ta-ší-a-tim
translation: 5 minas of scrap (copper) in the steppe for transport.

transliteration: iš-tù qá-ṭá-ra a-dí ha-mì-za-nim 0.33333-ma-na AN.NA a-ta-ší-a-tim
translation: From Qaṭṭarā until hamizānum 0.3333 mina of tin for transport.

transliteration: ANŠE uš-pá-il₅-ma 1-ma-na 15 GÍN AN.NA a-pu-ul
translation: I replaced a donkey and had to balance 1 mina and 15 shekels of tin.

transliteration: iš-tù bu-ra-li-im a-dí bi-ir-tù-im 17 GÍN AN.NA a-na ta-ší-a-tim
translation: From Burallum until Birtu'um 17 shekels of tin for transport.

transliteration: 7 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù a-al kà-ni-ší-e a-dí tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na ig-re e-re-qí-im
translation: 7 shekels of tin from the Town of the Kaneshites until Timilkiya as hire for a wagon.

transliteration: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR KIŠIB ú-nu-ba KIŠIB a-ší-a-at
translation: Seal of Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī, seal of Unuba, seal of Ašiat.

transliteration: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am i-ṣé-er ú-nu-ba ú a-ší-a-at wa-ar-dí ša dan-a-šur lu-zi i-šu
translation: Unuba and Ašiat, Dan-Aššur's slaves, owe 15 minas of washed copper to Luzi.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni ú a-šur-na-da a-na 4 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
translation: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

transliteration: i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They must pay using our weight stones.

transliteration: ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bum
translation: Month hubur eponymy Iddin-abum.

transliteration: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù bé-lá-nim KIŠIB en-um-a-šur
translation: To my representatives and Bēlānum; seal of Ennam-Aššur.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú i-ku-pì-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma
translation: To Alāhum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur, speak: thus (says) Aliya.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-ú ša a-bi₄-ni iš-té-en-x ta-ma-lá-kum ku-nu-ku-a ù ku-nu-ku-ú ša a-gu₅-a
translation: The tablets of our father (are in) one tablet-container, (under) my seal and Aguwa's seal.

transliteration: ù a-ḫa-ma i-na ṣí-il₅-a-ni ki-lá-li-in ú xxxx-tum xx-a ù iš-té-en-x ta-ma-lá-kum ku-nu-ku ša a-bi₄-ni … a-na …-dan …-ku a ša ki-ma … … ip-qí-id …-nu …-du …-dan x [...]
translation: And furthermore, in both containers and ... and one tablet-container, the seal of our father ... for ... which ... he entrusted ... [...]

transliteration: i-na 75 ku-ta-ni ša en-na-sú-in ša i-na a-lim(ki) a-na lá-ta-a ip-qí-du-ni ŠÀ.BA 6 ku-ta-ni i-na tí-me-el-ki-a e-zi-ib
translation: Of the 75 kutānus belonging to Enna-Suen that they entrusted to Lataya in the City, thereof he left 6 kutānus in Timelkiya.

transliteration: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI.A 69 ku-ta-ni ša en-na-sú-in 3 ku-ta-nu ša kà-ṣa-ri-im ŠU.NÍGIN 72 ku-ta-nu ša en-na-sú-in a-na É.GAL-lim e-ru-bu
translation: The remainder of the textiles, 69 kutānus of Enna-Suen and 3 kutānus of the packer, in total 72 kutānus of Enna-Suen, entered the palace.

transliteration: 3.5 TÚG.ḪI.A ù 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tum ik-šu-sú
translation: 3.5 textiles and 1.5 shekels of silver, the nisḫātum-tax, reached him.

transliteration: 7 TÚG.ḪI.A ša ší-mì-im ik-šu-sú 1.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na-pu-lu-šum
translation: 7 textiles for the price reached him; 1.75 shekels of silver they will pay him as balance.

transliteration: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI.A 61.5 TÚG.ḪI-tù-šu iz-ku-ú-nim
translation: The remainder of the textiles, 61.5 textiles of his, were cleared.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 3 TÚG.ḪI.A kà-ṣa-ru-um il₅-qé
translation: Thereof the packer took 3 textiles.

transliteration: 5.5 TÚG.ḪI.A en-nam-a-šur i-na-pá-al
translation: Ennam-Aššur will pay 5.5 textiles as balance.

transliteration: 4 TÚG.ḪI.A É kà-ri-im i-na-pu-lu-šum
translation: The office of the kārum will pay him 4 textiles as balance.

transliteration: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI-tí-šu 49 ku-ta-ni a-na im-dí-lim lá-qé-pì-im ù ṣí-lu-uš-da-ga-an a-na ša ki-ma i-ku-pì-a áp-qí-id
translation: The remainder of his textiles, 49 kutānus, I entrusted to Imdī-ilum, Lā-qēpum, and Ṣilluš-Dagan for my representatives and Ikūn-pīya.

transliteration: 1 ku-lu-ma-a 1 a-ta-a ma-nu-ba 1 šu-IŠTAR 1 DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur 1 ba-al-ṭù-a 1 a-lá-ku
translation: 1 Kulumaya, 1 Ataya, Mannuba, 1 Šu-Ištar, 1 Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, 1 Balṭuwa, 1 Alāku.

transliteration: 8.33333 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku il₅-qé
translation: 8.3333 minas 4.5 shekels of silver of the caravan of Pūšu-kēn, Aššur-taklāku took.

transliteration: 13.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in LUGAL-sú-in na-dí
translation: 13.3333 minas of silver in the caravan of Pūšu-kēn, Šar-Suen deposited.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà SÍG il₅-qé
translation: Your servant took the wool.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà li-dí-nam
translation: Let him give me the silver under your seal.

transliteration: šu-ma da ni ik-šu-da-ni KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-e-ra-kum-ma
translation: If ... reached me, I shall return the silver to you.

transliteration: ù a-na ku-ša-ra e lá ší-ta e tám
translation: And then to Kuššara ...

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma
translation: To Alāhum, speak: thus (says) Aliya.

transliteration: i pá-ni-tí áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma
translation: I wrote to you previously, saying:

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šur a-na 1.3333300000000001 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-pár-tim ti-dí-i
translation: As for the tablet of 4 minas 12 shekels of silver, you know (it was given) to Šu-Aššur for 1.3333 minas 3 shekels of silver as a pledge.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul-ma ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá-tal-kam
translation: Pay the silver and then let your message come to me so I may depart.

transliteration: be-lí a-ta a-ṣé-er ṭup-pí-im ša i-ṭí-áb-ší-na-tí ša iš-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú ù ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul i-ṭí-ib-ší-na-tí-ma ša 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù li-mì-im ib-ni-(d)IM i ša-tim 0.5 ma-na.TA ú-ša-qú-lu a-na-ku ú-kà-al
translation: My dear lord, in addition to the tablet of Iṭī-abšināti that is with you, I hold the tablet of the debt of Iṭī-abšināti of 3 minas of silver, of which he will pay 0.5 mina per year from the eponymy of Ibni-Adad.

transliteration: a-ta-ta me-ra-šu iš-tí a-mur-ša-ra-sà a-mì-šam i-ta-al-kam
translation: His son Atata has come there with Amur-šarrassa.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na SIG₅-x-x i-ra-dí
translation: He will bring 1 mina or 2 minas of good silver.

transliteration: iš-tù wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-dí kà-né-eš da-tum 1.3333300000000001 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ik-šu-dí
translation: From Wahšušana to Kanesh, the road-tax reached 1.3333 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 1 GÍN a-na kà-ší-im
translation: 1 shekel for the official.

transliteration: i-na kà-né-eš áb-ri-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ku-ul
translation: In Kanesh I passed (time) and I consumed 10 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na É wa-áb-ri i-na ḫu-ru-ma
translation: 1 shekel of silver for the inn in Hurama.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na É wa-áb-ri
translation: 1 shekel of silver in Timelkiya for the inn.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḫa-ḫi-im a-na É wa-áb-ri
translation: 2 shekels of silver in Hahhum for the inn.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na bu-ru-lim a-na É wa-áb-ri
translation: 1 shekel of silver in Burullum for the inn.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù kà-né-eš a-di a-lim(ki) a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a ag-mu-ur
translation: 10 shekels of silver from Kanesh to the City I spent for my food.

transliteration: a-na ší-ip-ri ša a-lim(ki) ù kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er-GAL qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
translation: To the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony, speak: thus (says) Šalim-Aššur.

transliteration: bē-lu-a a-tù-nu
translation: You are my lords.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ṣa-ḫe-er GAL ù ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ší-na-lam DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim DUMU i-ba-a ù ṣú-ḫa-ru-um ša ú-ší-na-lam a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL a-šu-mì a-bu-šalim ÌR ub-lu-nim-ma
translation: The son of Ibaya, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony, and the servant of Ušinalam brought a tablet of the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony and a tablet of Ušinalam to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony concerning the slave Abu-šalim.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma 16 li-me 40 ma-na URUDU ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A a-bu-šalim ÌR a-na ú-ší-na-lam ḫa-bu-ul
translation: They said: 'The slave Abu-šalim owes 16,040 minas of copper, the price of wool, to Ušinalam.'

transliteration: 30 li-me URUDU ša nam-e-dim ša e-kál-lim ḫa-bu-lu ú-ší-na-lam ú-ṣa-li-im
translation: Regarding the 30,000 minas of copper that they owe to the palace, he has angered Ušinalam.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma a-bu-šalim li-li-kam
translation: They said: 'Abu-šalim must come.'

transliteration: šu-ma a-bu-šalim lá-šu be-el-šu li-li-kam
translation: If Abu-šalim is not (here), his master must come.

transliteration: a-na-kam a-na na-áp-šatí-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR-áp x x a-bu-šalim ni-ša-ḫu-ut
translation: Here we fear for our lives and the silver of Abu-šalim.

translation: 8 shekels of silver was either Abuwa's fees or expenses here.

translation: In all you have received 1 mina 24 shekels of silver.

translation: My dear brothers, assist Ennam-Aššur in this, buy for me, seal it and send it to me with Aššur-bāni.

translation: To Ennam-Aššur:

translation: If you are my sister, do not keep writing me things that are not true

transliteration: ú-ul i-na ba-áb-tí-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lá i-ba-ší

transliteration: ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN ma-lá gám-ri
translation: And if they are not, let her ask ten shekels of silver for her expenses.

translation: I have concluded their matter with Hanunu, Šu-Ištar and Aššur-malik as witnesses,

translation: Pay [...] to Haššu-uman's son

transliteration: ú ṭúp-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu ú ku-nu-uk um-mì-šu ù a-ḩi-šu ḩi-ir-ma-ma

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-na a-ḩi-a x x x x-x-tim dí-na
translation: and there give ... to my brothers.

translation: From Šu-Bēlum to Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum:

transliteration: 11 TÚG qá-du-um ša ṣú-ḩa-ri-im ú ší-na ma-áš-ku-nu zu-ba ù (d)IM-ba-ni mu-pá-zi-ru-ú na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: Zuba and Adad-bāni, the smugglers, bring you 11 textiles, including those belonging to the servant, and two covers.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ig-ri-šu-nu dí-na-šu-nu-tí
translation: Give them their wages, 10 shekels of silver;

transliteration: ú 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR xx a-dí šé-bi₄-lá xx-bu-ma ṣú-ḩa-ru-um lá i-sà-ḩa-ur ṭù-ur-da-ni

translation: Urgent, as for the textiles, sell them as well as you can.

translation: so he may send 50 textiles here.

transliteration: 1 (TÚG)a-bar-ni-a-am 1 (TÚG)bu-ra-a-am a-na ku-ku-zi DUMU sà-aḩri-ì-lí ša ša-lá-tù-a-ar a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
translation: I gave 1 Abarnian textile, 1 burā'u-textile to Kukuzi son of Sahri-ilī from Šalatuwar for purchases.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša eq-lim a-na-ku pá-ḩu-ra-am qá-bi₄-a-ku

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma al-qé a-dá-gal-šu lá i-ba-ší
translation: He answered: "I shall look whether I took any, but there is nothing."

transliteration: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-li IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im IGI

transliteration: 3 (TÚG)tí-sà-bi ša na-aḩri-a

transliteration: 5 (TÚG)ni-ib-ra-ru ša za-al-pá

transliteration: 3 ma-na AN.NA

transliteration: 1 pí-ri-kà-nu-um ša kà-ni-iš

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim tám-kà-ru-um a-na šu-IŠTAR …

transliteration: i-nu-mu wa-áš-ba-ku-ni aṣ-ba-sú-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-nu-tí a-dí-ni lá e-ru-ba-am
translation: When I stayed there I seized him, but he said: ''My  merchandise has not arrived yet."

transliteration: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ma-lá wa-as-mu ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: My dear brothers, seize him and make him pay the silver and as much interest as is fitting.

transliteration: a-na am-tim dí-na-šu
translation: Give it to the maid.

transliteration: nu-ḫe-en₆ a-ša-ma-ma ANŠE ì-GIŠ ma-li-a-ma še-bi₄-lá-nim
translation: Buy two leather pouches, load a donkey with oil, and send it to me.

transliteration: ù ma-la ki-lá-le-ma šé-pé-a
translation: Do send as much as both can contain.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-na la-ma-sí ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na ša šu-bu-ul-tim 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ki-is-ḫa-nu-il₅ 13 GÍN ša KÙ.BABBAR ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A-tí-šu ša šé-ep ú-ra-ni ša a-šùr-ba-ni ù šál-ma-a-šùr 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qé-šu ša a-ni-nim 5 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um a-na im-ra-a ŠU.NÍGIN 7 ri-ik-sí a-na ku-lu-ma-a ap-qí-id
translation: 1 1/2 minas silver - its excise added and shipping paid to Lamassāi, therein 1/2 mina for š, and 1/2 mina for kišĭhanuil, 13 shekels of the silver is revenues of (her!) textiles from Urāni's shipment from Aššur-bāni and Šalim-Aššur, 5 shekels silver to (her!) niqe of Anninum, 5 minas washed copper to Imraya-- in total I entrusted 7 bundles to Kulmaya.

transliteration: IGI i-ku-pì-a-šùr DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šál-mì-ḫi-im
translation: Witnesses: Ikūn-pī-Aššur s. Puzur-Ištar, Ennam-Aššur s. Šalim-aḫum.

transliteration: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša a-lim{ki} a-na e-nam-a-šur DUMU a-ni-nim iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um ša a-lim-KI-ma lá li-bi DINGIR-ma sú-e-a ša-nu 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-šu sú-e-a a-na na-ab-ší-im i-dí-na-kum lá i-dí-na-kum
translation: The chief of the city seized us against Ennam-Aššur son of Anninim and the chief of the city said, "Unfortunately Suaeyya has changed. Did Sueyya give to you 40 minas silver under his seal for nabšum or not?"

translation: Before these men, our seed?, the chief of the city myself and the the extensive assets I requested??

transliteration: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr-ma tí-ma-li-ma i-ku-pí-a ki-ma sú-e-a iš-a-lá-ni u₄-ma-am ra-bi-ṣú-um iš-ta-la-ni uš-kà-in a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ù bé-li-a ú-la ša ma-la pu-šu-ke-en₆ a-na-ku a-na kà-ri-im ṣa-ḫe-er GAL a-wa-ti bi-la
translation: Ennam-Aššur said, "you filled? and Ikūn-pīya when Sueyya asked, on that day the governor asked, he established. To the governor and my lord, do not carry my matter concerning Pūšu-kēn, I myself?, to general assembly ...."

translation: Concerning these matters the large and small assembly of Purušḫattum gave to us and we gave our testimonies before the dagger of Aššur.

translation: Winesses: Bēlum-bāni son of Naram-Su(en), Idī-Suen son of Ennānum.

translation: From Aššur-šamšī to Šū-Anum:

transliteration: a-na a-šùr-na-da 20 5 TÚG ŠÀ.BA 15 ku-ta-num 4.5 GÚ URUDU it-bu-lu 1.5
translation: They brought 5 textiles within the package of 15 kutānum textiles and 4 1/2 talents of tin for Aššur-nādā.

transliteration: GÍN ú-nu-ut ANŠE 5
translation: 1 1/2 shekels for the gear for the donkey.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ri-dim ni-dí-in 2.5
translation: We gave 5 shekels silver to the driver.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-lim-a-šùr DUMU me-me-na-nim ni-pu-ul 4
translation: We balanced 2 1/2 shekels silver to Šalim-Aššur s. Memenānum.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU AB-ba-ni ša URUDU SIG₅ ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ni ni-ìš-qúl 10
translation: We paid 4 shekels silver to the son of Nabu-bāni for the fine copper which you owed.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i ma-sà-im im-ṭí 15
translation: 10 shekels silver were lost from the cleaning procedure.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ANŠE 2
translation: 15 shekels silver, the price of the donkey.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR wa-ṣí-tum 4 ma-na 11 GÍN AN.NA x GÚ 0.33333 ma-na a-na qá-tim ni-dí-in
translation: 2 shekels silver - the exit tax; 4 minas 11 shekels (hand) tin we gave for the share.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na 9 GÍN 1
translation: The remainder of the silver was 1 mina 9 shekels.

transliteration: ma-na AN.NA a-mur-DINGIR ú-bi₄-il₅ 0.66666
translation: Amur-ilī brought 1 mina tin.

transliteration: ma-na URUDU wa-ṣí-tum
translation: 2/3 minas copper was the exit tax.

transliteration: gám-ra-kum
translation: Your funds are exhausted.

transliteration: šu-ma ta-lá-kam KÙ.BABBAR i-a-am ša ḫa-na-nim ù ša DUMU a-bar-zi-zi-im bi₄-lam
translation: If you come, bring my silver, Hananum's, and that belonging to the son of Abarzizum.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ta-lá-kam KÙ.BABBAR iš-té-ni-ìš ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi₄-lam 1
translation: If you do not come, seal the silver altogether and send it to me.

transliteration: TÚG a-na i-ku-nim tù-bi-il₅
translation: You brought(?) 1 textile for Ikūnum.

translation: From Pūšu-kēn and Aššur-ṣulūlī to Ennum-Bēlum:

translation: Apparently, you sent some silver to me surrepticiously.

transliteration: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na É-bé-tí áš-qú-lu KÙ.BABBAR-pì a-na É-bé-tí šé-bi-lam
translation: My dear brother, send the silver which I paid out for the houses, my silver for the houses.

transliteration: a-na x-x-e É ma-ma-an
translation: ... house ... someone? ...

translation: Šezizi and Šū-Kūbim owe Enna-Bēlum 2 minas refined silver.

transliteration: IGI šu-bé-lim IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur
translation: Witnesses: Šū-Bēlim, Puzur-Aššur

transliteration: a-na pu-šu-ke-en₆ qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-pu-ul-tum-ma
translation: To Pūšu-kēn from Šubultum:

transliteration: ì-lí-ba-ni iš-tù iš-tí ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šùr uš₁₀-bu ar-bi-i-šu ḫa-ra-nam i-li-kam 5 GÍN
translation: Ilī-bāni, after he stayed with Uṣur-ša-Aššur, arrived on four trips.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR i-na bé-ú-lá-tí-šu ú-lá al-qé
translation: I did not take even 5 shekels silver from his capital fund.

transliteration: ú-lá šu-ut
translation: It was not him.

transliteration: i-na lá ma-ṣí um-mì-a-ni-šu KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ú-lá ir-ší
translation: When it was not sufficient, his investor did not redeem for him even a single shekel of silver.

transliteration: ú-lá a-na-ku
translation: It was not me.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 5 GÍN ú-lá áb-lá-aṭ
translation: I did not live on a mere 5 shekels silver

transliteration: šu-ma a-bi a-ta bé-ú-lá-tí-šu ta-e-er-ma a-na ṣé-ri-kà ṭá-ḫi-šu
translation: My dear father, return his capital fund and draw him near to you.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ru-um li-il₅-qé-šu-ma
translation: Take the youth.

transliteration: ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà sí-ni-iq-šu
translation: Supervise him as your youth.

transliteration: bé-ú-lá-tí-šu a-na qá-tí-šu lá tù-ša-ar
translation: Do not return his capital fund to his account.

transliteration: i-ga-ma-ar
translation: He will spend it off.

transliteration: a-dí qá-sú ta-mu-ru-ni šu-ma da-mì-iq ú da-mì-iq-ma a-na ḫu-bu-li-a bé-ú-lá-tù-šu li-tù-ra-am
translation: Until you see his account, if it is all well and good, let his capital fund return to my debt.

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ku-ra i-tur₄-DINGIR i-šu-ú
translation: Kura owes Itūr-ilī 1 mina refined silver.

transliteration: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur DUMU kà-sá-sá ITU.KAM áb ša-ra-ni li-mu-um DINGIR-šu-GAL a-na 10 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay 10 weeks from the ḫamuštum of Pilaḫ-Aššur s. Kasasa, month of Ab šarrānē, eponymate of Ilšu-rabi.

transliteration: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-em ú-ṣa-áb
translation: If he does not pay (on time), he will add 1 1/2 shekels per mina per month (as interest).

transliteration: IGI DINGIR-na-da IGI a-mur-a-šùr IGI pá-na-kà
translation: Witnesses: Ilī-nādā, Amur-Aššur, Banaga.

transliteration: a-na pu-šu-ke-en₆ i-na-a ù ki-li-a SIG₇.A qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-ku-bu-um-ma
translation: To Pūšu-kēn, Innāya, and Kilya the yellow one(?) from Šū-Kūbum:

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-na me-tim ta-áš-ku-na-ni-ma iš-tù MU.2.ŠÈ té-er-ta-ku-nu za-ku-tum la i-lá-kà-ni
translation: Why is it that you write to me as if I were marked for death and your full report has not come to me for two years?

transliteration: i pá-ni-tim ta-áš-pu-ra-nim
translation: Previously you wrote to me.

transliteration: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša a-pá-ta-na-nim ni-il₅-qé-ma ki-ma u₄-mu DAM.GÀR-ri-kà qúr-bu-ni a ṣí-ib-tim ni-dí-šu um-ma né-nu-ma iš-té-ni-iš KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí {d}UTU-tap-pá-i lu nu-šé-bi-il₅ x-x-x
translation: “We received the silver of Apatanānum and since the terms of your merchants draw close, we will give him for interest. We will say, 'Let us send the silver all at once with Šamaš-tappa’ī.'"

transliteration: u₄-mu DAM.GÀR-ri-a a-na war-ki-šu-nu i-tù-ru-nim
translation: The terms of my merchant turned to me already (?).

transliteration: ma KÙ.BABBAR ša a-pá-ta-na-nim iš-tí ki-li-a tù-šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: Indeed, you did send me the silver of Appatanānum with Kiliya.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR-ri-a lá tù-šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: (But) you did not send the silver of my merchant!

transliteration: a-ša-me-ma TÚG.ḪI-tù-a ša šé-ep DUMU ú-za-ri-a a-na i-ta-aṭ-lim ta-ad-nu
translation: I hear that my textiles from the

transliteration: a-na-kam ša ma-aḫ-ri-šu TÚG.ḪI-tí-a i-dí-nu-ni iq-bi-a-am
translation: He told me here that they sold the textiles in his presence.

transliteration: a mì-nim KÙ.BABBAR lá tù-šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: Why did you not send the silver?

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma lu ša ba-ab-tí-a ša u₄-me lu ša i-ta-aṭ-lim lu ša ni-kà-sí-a iš-tí ba-tí-qí-im za-ku-tám šu-up-ra-nim
translation: My dear brothers, take heed to send a detailed message about my assets(?) on credit, in cash, and in my account by express messenger.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ÌR-dí-a ki-ma e-ru-bu-ni-ni ṭur₄-da-nim
translation: I said, "Dispatch my servants as soon as they arrive."

transliteration: a-tù-nu ma-ṣí-be-lí ù i-šar-lu-ba-la-aṭ tù-uḫ-ta-li-qá
translation: But you (pl.), squandered Maṣi-bēlī and Išar-lu-ballaṭ.

transliteration: šu-ma a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu {d}UTU-tap-pá-i ma-nu-ki-a-bi-a ù a-da-a i pá-nim-ma ṭur₄-da-nim
translation: If you are truly my brothers, dispatch Šamaš-tappāʾī, Mannu-kī-abiya and Ataya to me immediately.

transliteration: šu-ma lá šu-nu a-na še-im ša-a-mì-im ma-ma-an lá i-šu
translation: Besides them, there is no one to by grain for me.

transliteration: šu-ma i pá-nim-ma lá ta-aṭ-ru-da-nim-šu-nu ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí 1 GÚ tù-ḫa-li-qá-ni li-bi i-lá-mì-na-ku-nu-tí
translation: If you do not dispatch them to me immediately, you will make as angry as if you had lost a talent of silver of mine.

transliteration: i-na ni-kà-sí-a ma-lá i-pu-lu-ni-ni x-x šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: Send me as much as they balanced me at accountings.

transliteration: iḫ-da-ma qá-tí i-ta-dí-a
translation: Take care to deposit my share.

transliteration: ma-lá lá ša-ḫa-tim tù-uš-ta-am-ri-ṣa-ni
translation: Will you take pains to make me fear?

transliteration: um-ma šu-ḫu-bu-ur ù me-er-ú a-šùr-i-mì-tí-ma a-na bu-zu-ta-a pu-šu-ke-en₆ ù im-dí-DINGIR qí-bi-ma
translation: From Šū-Ḫubur and the sons of Aššur-imittī to Buzutaya, Pūšu-kēn and Imdī-ilum:

transliteration: šu-ma a-ma-kam ta-da-ga-lá-ma a-wi-lúm e-mu-qám i-šu a-wi-lúm i-na ṣé-er É a-bi-ni lá i-ša-lá
translation: If you come to an agreement there and the man is well, then the man must not harm our father's house.

transliteration: a-na ma-lá ta-le-a-ni KÙ.BABBAR ša lu-qú-tí-im em-da-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-lim{ki} lu ra-ki-is
translation: As much as you are able, lean on him for the silver from the goods so that the silver is bound in the city.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ki-a-am a-wi-lam e-bi-ba-šu
translation: If it is not so, clear the man of it (the obligation).

transliteration: ni-iš-ta-na-me-ma a-wi-lúm ma-ru-uṣ x
translation: We keep hearing that the man is ill.

transliteration: iḫ-da-ma e-bi-ba-šu 15
translation: Take care to clear him.

transliteration: ma-na AN.NA a-ḫa-ma a-na li-bi lu-qú-tí-šu ša ik-ri-bi-a
translation: 15 minas tin, separately, that are in the midst of his goods, are my ikrībū-funds.

transliteration: i-nu-mì lu-qú-sú É-sú a-dí ù 5 ma-na AN.NA a-šùr-SIPA ḫa-nu-nu-um a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU i-ku-a i-dí-nu-šum
translation: When his house deposited his goods, Aššu-rēʾī, Ḫannunum, and Aššur-imittī son of Ikuwa gave to him 5 minas tin.

transliteration: ší-im AN.NA-ki-a ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: Have him pay the price of my tin.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-gu₅-za a-šùr={d}UTU i-šu
translation: Aguza owes Aššur-šamšī 25 shekels refined silver.

translation: He will add 2/3 shekel and 15 grains per month.

transliteration: IGI sú-kà-li-a IGI ga-zi-a
translation: Witnesses: Sukkallīya, Gaziā.

transliteration: 20 GÚ AN.NA pu-šu-ke-en₆ 20 GÚ dan-a-šùr 5 GÚ la-qé-ep DUMU i-li-a 6 GÚ i-na-sú-en₆ 4 GÚ šu-sú-en₆ 6 GÚ i-dí-sú-en₆ 5 GÚ ì-li-šu-GAL 8 GÚ a-ta-ta ša ILLAT-at pu-šu-ke-en₆ ŠU.NÍGIN 74 GÚ AN.NA 14 na-ru-qá-tum 1 me-at 21 TÚG i-lu-ku
translation: 20 talents tin belonging to Pūšu-kēn, 20 talents belonging to Dān-Aššur, 5 talents belonging to Lā-qēpum son of Iliya, 6 talents belonging to Enna-Suen, 4 talents belonging to Šū-Suen, 6 talents belonging to Idī-Suen, 5 talents belonging to Ilišu-rabi, 8 talents belonging to Atata-- for the caravan of Pūšu-kēn-- altogether 74 talents tin, and 14 sacks (with) 121 textiles, will go.

transliteration: KIŠIB {d}en-LÍL-ba-ni DUMU GAL-a-šur KIŠIB LUGAL={d}IŠKUR DUMU nu-ur-sú 12
translation: Seals: Enlil-bāni s. Rab-Aššur, Šar-Adad s. Nūr-Suen.

transliteration: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er LUGAL={d}IŠKUR DUMU nu-ur-sú DAM.GÀR i-šu
translation: Šar-Adad s. Nūr-Suen owes the merchant 12 shekels refined silver.

translation: He will pay 8 weeks from ḫamuštum of Ḫanaya, month Kuzalli, eponymate Enna-Suen s. Šū-Aššur.

translation: If he does not pay, he will add 1 1/2 shekels per mina per month as interest.

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pé-e ša na-áš-pá-ra-tí-kà ù ša šu-ut KÙ.BABBAR uš-té-bi₄-lá-ku-ni ì-lí-iš-tí-kál wa-šu-ra-am ù-lá i-mu-a
translation: You said, "As for the tablets of your naspartum and the goods (arising from) that silver which I sent to you, Iliš-tīkal does not want to release them."

transliteration: té-er-tí a-na ku-a-tí ú ì-lí-iš-tí-kál i-li-kam
translation: My instructions to you and Iliš-tīkal have come.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma er-ba-ma ṭup-pé-a a-ta-ma-ra
translation: I said, "Take out and thoroughly inspect my tablets.

translation: If you are my brothers, when you see my tablet, let your report come quickly so that I may discuss it with my investor.

transliteration: ṭù-ur-da-šu

translation: Šū-Suen owes Puzur-Anna 3 minas 27 1/3 shekels refined silver.

translation: Witnesses: Puzur-Anna, Adad-rabi.

translation: Witnesses: Qarwiya, Dān-Aššur

translation: As for the 15 shekels silver which Idī-Suen owes to the Anatolians and which Muza in his(?) guarantor, he gave the territories of the followers of the household(?) to Muza and the Anatolians for the 15 shekels silver.

translation: If anyone approaches the Anatolians or Muza concerning the territories, Idī-Suen with clear them.

translation: To Idī-abum, Aššur-mālik, Aššur-imittī, Šū-Anum, Enna-Suen, and Puzur-ilī, from Pilaḫ-Ištar:

transliteration: i-li-kam a-šu-mì DINGIR-na-da DUMU ba-zi-a
translation: The message of the amtum wife has come to me once or twice.

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-ma-kam am-tám ik-ta-na-tù-ú ú É-bi-tám a-na kà-na-ki-im i-za-zu ú ni-ší-a up-ta-na-ru-du mì-nam a-bi ú-lá a-na-ku ú a-ḫu-ú-a ḫa-bu-la-ni-ma ru-gu₅-ma-e a-na am-tí-a i-ta-na-dí
translation: Regarding Ilī-nādā s. Baziya, why is it that over there he constantly threatens to distrain my amtum-wife, attempts to seal the house and constantly frightens my people?

translation: My father was alive ten years ago, during the plague.

transliteration: mì-šu-um a-bi lá iṣ-ba-at
translation: Why did he not seize my father?

translation: Or not deposit memoranda to my father?

translation: Iliš-tikal assembled my father's silver.

transliteration: mì-šu-um i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-a iṣ-ba-at ú-lá a-na ra-bi₄-ṣí-im ú-lá a-na ì-lí-iš-tí-kál nu-du-a-e lá i-dí
translation: Why did he not take from my father's silver, or from the attorney or give a memoranda to Iliš-tīkal?

transliteration: a-na-ku ú a-ḫu-ú-a a-dí 5-ší-šu iš-tí-šu lu i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dum lu i-na ú-lá-ma lu i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na iš-tí-šu ni-na-me-er
translation: I and my brothers met five times with him, in Purušḫattum, Ulama, and Waḫšušana!

transliteration: mì-šu-um nu-du-a-e lá i-dí-ni-a-tí
translation: Why didn't he give us any memoranda?

transliteration: ú ma-tí-ma té-er-tù-šu lá i-li-kam
translation: And how is it that his messages never came?

transliteration: ú-lá a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí lá iš-pu-ra-ma la il₅-pu-tù-ni
translation: Nor did he send messages to his representatives with the result that they did not write (anything) down.

translation: Also, his son, Šū-Bēlum, served as caravan driver with me, and he was constantly taking 1 or 2 minas silver in his bundle to him in Ulama and he did not 'ripen' the merchandise in the house of his own father.

transliteration: mì-šu-um i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a lá i-ṣa-ba-at
translation: Why did he not seize from my silver?

transliteration: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu lá té-dí-a ki-ma i-nu-mì a-bi₄ me-tù-ni mì-iš-ḫu-um i-ší-ik-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ma-dum ú ṭup-pì ša a-bi₄-a im-ta-áš-ḫu-ni
translation: My dear fathers and lords, do you not know that because a robbery occurred when my father died, much silver and my father's tablets were stolen?

translation: My dear fathers, my brothers opened the strongroom five years ago and since then it has been deposed for a matter.

transliteration: a-ḫu-ú-a i-na e-lá-tim ša-am-ú
translation: As for my brothers, it is heard they are on the caravans.

transliteration: ú a-na-kam a-na-ku ša KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú 2 ma-na a-na u₄-mì a ba-ab ma-ḫi-ri-im ú-šé-er-ma a-šu-mì ki-a-am pá-aḫ-ra-ku
translation: But here, I myself have released 1 or 2 minas silver each day at the gate of the market and because of this I am thus made to assemble.

transliteration: šu-ma a-ma-kam DINGIR-na-da ri-ig-ma-am i-té-dí-ma a mì-ma i-ṭé-ḫi
translation: If Ilī-nādā prosecutes the case there, he will claim everything.

transliteration: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu DUMU me-tim a-na-ku
translation: My dear fathers and lords, I am the son of a dead man!

translation: I will come to [GN] and we will set [the matter before] the colony so that they will raise [the matter] to the city and [resolve this?].

transliteration: a-na-kam lá-az-ku-ma lá-li-kam-ma ma-ṣa-ar-tám ša a-bi₄-ni lu ni-ip-té-ma lu ṭup-pé lu ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim sí-sà-tim lu ni-mu-ur-ma a-na a-wi-lim a-wa-tám uk-tí-in ú a-na-kam ša i re-eš₁₅ a-bi₄-ni i-zi-zu-ni ar-ni iš-tí-ú ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-mì-um ḫu-bu-lu-šu-ni a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mì-im ni-il₅-pu-tù-šu-ni
translation: Here I will clear myself and will come so that we can open my father's strongroom and inspect the tablets and the memoranda and clear the matter for the man, and those that stood at the head of my father here (will) search.

transliteration: i-ṣé-er x-kà-lá-lu-wa lá i-ba-ri-a-šu-um ṭup-pu ša a-bi₄-a
translation: Becasue that silver is his debt, and we wrote him down for that silver, he will not (return)? it to Kalaluwa for him.

transliteration: ma-du-tù-ma ša-ar-qú
translation: A great many of my fathers tablets were stolen!

translation: Siegel des A[ll]u, des Sohnes des Adūdu; Siegel des Takniš, des Sohnes des Talaš; Siegel des Aššurmalik, des Sohnes des Aššurnādā; Siegel des Šamašbāni, des Sohnes des Šū’ištar.
